shoeName: Nike Mind 001 Slide Black Chrome
description: The Nike Mind 001 'Black Chrome' was developed by the Nike Mind Science Department. This mule has an outsole with 22 nodes that move independently to activate sensory areas of the brain. Red accents complement the black/chrome design, while the foam midsole brings a plush feel. Perforated details provide breathability, so you can slip them on and be on your way.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Low White ‘07 features an all-white leather upper with a perforated toe box and Swoosh overlays. A Nike heel embroidery and white sole completes the design.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low White ‘07 originally released in 2007, but since it is an essential colorway to the brand, it consistently restocks.

To shop all Nike Air Force 1 shoes, click here.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Black
description: Originally debuting as part of Supreme's Spring/Summer 2020 collection, the Supreme x Air Force 1 Low 'Box Logo - Black' released in March 2020. The shoe's full-grain leather upper appears in black, accented by Supreme's red box logo on the lateral heel. The custom sockliner and additional set of laces sport further Supreme branding, while the midsole houses the usual Air for cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Pink Foam
description:
Nike Ja 3 Valentines Day brings emotion and personality into Ja Morant’s signature line with a colorway built around connection and expression. The Valentines Day theme adds warmth and contrast to the Ja 3’s aggressive shape, creating a look that feels playful without losing performance driven energy. It reflects Ja’s ability to balance intensity with individuality on and off the court.

Fans appreciate how this release uses color and theme to tell a story. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on motion, and this version feels expressive and alive, appealing to collectors who enjoy sneakers that carry narrative alongside function. It stands out as a reminder that performance shoes can still feel personal and culturally relevant.

The Nike Ja 3 Valentines Day was released on12/20/2025 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Mind 001 Slide Light Smoke Grey
description: The Nike Mind 001 'Light Smoke Grey' slides activate your senses through an innovative 22-node outsole. Each node moves by itself, stimulating sensory areas of the brain. The upper has a series of perforations that bring an airy feel, ideal for wearing before the game or for post-game recovery. The red foam midsole has a plush and responsive feel, helping you stay engaged throughout the day.

shoeName: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Black
description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus 'Triple Black' keeps true to the silhouette's heritage with a blackout knit upper taken from the Air Max Plus and a cage that nods to palm trees swaying in the wind. Reflective details land on the tongue and vamp, while a yellow 'Vm Air' badge embellishes the insoles and the nubuck heel overlay. The AM Plus' whale tail-inspired shank plate is embedded in the foam midsole, which is anchored by the VaporMax platform for a resilient feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme White
description: The Supreme x Air Force 1 Low 'Box Logo - White' released as part of the New York brand's Spring/Summer 2020 collection. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in white and highlighted by Supreme's signature box logo on the lateral heel. The custom sockliner and a second set of laces sport further Supreme branding, while Air in the heel of the midsole provides cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Dodgers
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'Dodgers' rocks a blue synthetic upper accented with a pale grey Swoosh and red baseball stitching. Kobe Bryant's Sheath logo lands on the tongue, while his signature is present on the heel counter. This Protro version has a Cushlon midsole, tooled with a glass-based, carbon fiber shank plate and a springy Zoom Air forefoot unit for a responsive feel.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Mambacurial (2026)
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Mambacurial' brings back a 2013 release that nods to the Nike Mercurial soccer cleat. Just like the OG, the mesh upper has a gradient blend of fuchsia and purple. A large, electric green Swoosh decorates the forefoot, while a white Nike wordmark adorns the opposite side. This Protro edition has a Phylon midsole that gets a drop-in React foam insert for a plush feel. The green, partially see-through rubber outsole showcases an exposed glass-based carbon fiber shank plate for midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike Mind 001 Slide Black Chrome (Women's)
Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid
colorway: Lemon Venom/Light Photo Blue/Deep Royal Blue/Light Green Spark/Pink Beam/Hyper Pink
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid is the second collaboration between Memphis Grizzlies point guard Ja Morant and the iconic flavored beverage brand, following the mismatched Ja 2 Kool-Aid pair from May 2025, and it doubles down on everything that made the first collab so unexpected and so memorable: the asymmetrical colorway strategy, the candy-bright palette, the Kool-Aid Man character detail, and the emotional personal story behind why Morant chose Kool-Aid in the first place. Released May 20, 2026, the Kool-Aid x Nike Ja 3 Pink Lemonade deploys a full mismatch concept where the left shoe arrives in Pink Beam, representing the pink in the lemonade, and the right shoe in Lemon Venom, representing the yellow, the two colors splitting the pair down the middle as a visual joke on the flavor they reference together. Both shoes share a Light Photo Blue and Deep Royal Blue tongue, lining, lace treatment, and icy translucent outsole, the aquatic trim functioning as the one element that visually ties the mismatched pair together, an effect Sneaker Shouts described as the blue of a pitcher already mixed and ready to pour. Water droplet texture effects hit both tongues above the Ja logo on the Lemon Venom shoe and the Kool-Aid Man character on the Pink Beam shoe, the branding split between collaborators the same way the colorway itself is split. The insoles arrive with the Kool-Aid Man's signature "Ohhh Yeahhh!!" printed across them, while the full-length Hybrid ZoomX foam midsole delivers the energy return and court responsiveness appropriate to one of the NBA's most explosively vertical guards. Style code IW1159-700, available in adult, GS, and PS sizing.

The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid is the collaboration sneaker for the basketball fan and collector who wants the most summer-ready, most personally motivated, and most unapologetically fun pair in Morant's signature line, a shoe that wears its childhood inspiration and candy-color boldness as proudly as Ja himself does.

The Nike Ja 3 Kool-Aid was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Caitlin 1 Midnight Fever (Women's)
description:
The Nike Caitlin 1 Midnight Fever (Women's) brings Hot Punch and Neo Pink to Caitlin Clark’s first signature basketball silhouette. The bright colorway references her first WNBA rookie triple-double, a milestone achieved while wearing her team’s flame-red uniform. Its textured upper and personal branding connect that moment to a performance design developed with Clark’s involvement, giving the edition a story beyond its saturated pink finish.

The Nike Opticast upper uses flexible cast-PU material for lightweight containment. A forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit pairs with Cushlon foam, while a midfoot plate adds stability during pivots and changes of direction. The rubber outsole incorporates a C-inspired traction pattern. Double Swooshes reference Clark’s initials and the three-point arc, with molded 22 and CC details adding further personal touches across the upper.

The milestone-inspired colors and signature details give collectors several connections to Clark’s game, while the cushioning supports the shoe’s court-focused purpose. Released on October 14, 2026, the Nike Caitlin 1 Midnight Fever (Women's) retailed for $140.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Supreme Snow Camo
Nike Air Foamposite Pro Oregon Mummy Duck
Nike Caitlin 1 Caitlin Blue (Women's)
description:
The Nike Caitlin 1 Caitlin Blue (Women's) introduces Caitlin Clark’s first signature basketball shoe in a Racer Blue-led colorway. The textured upper incorporates personal details tied to Clark’s initials, jersey number, and shooting range. Stacked Swooshes and her CC logo establish the signature identity, while the molded surface gives the shoe a distinctive appearance from both sides.

Nike Opticast construction uses polyurethane nodes of varying heights to provide lightweight support. C-shaped details appear on the lateral side, with repeated 2s on the medial side referencing Clark’s number 22. A forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit pairs with Cushlon foam for responsive cushioning. Cement-inspired sockliners connect the design to the driveway court where Clark developed her game, adding a personal reference inside the shoe.

This launch colorway marks the beginning of Clark’s Nike signature line, combining her recognizable blue palette with details drawn from her basketball story. The textured construction makes those references part of the design itself. Released on October 1, 2026, the Nike Caitlin 1 Caitlin Blue (Women's) retailed for $140.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia is the GT Cut 1's contribution to Nike Basketball's DMV-inspired Unseen Hours collection, a three-shoe pack released May 22, 2026 that honors the basketball legacy of Washington D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, the tri-state area known in basketball culture as the DMV and recognized as the birthplace of Kevin Durant, Carmelo Anthony, Angel Reese, Azzi Fudd, and a generational roster of elite players stretching back through Allen Iverson, Moses Malone, and Alonzo Mourning. The Unseen Hours series began with a tri-state New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut pack and expanded south along the I-95 corridor for this DMV chapter, with cherry blossom pink driving the entire collection's color story as a reference to one of the region's most recognizable seasonal landmarks, the pink blooms that blanket the DMV each spring serving as the palette's primary cultural anchor. The GT Cut 1 in Pinksicle with White and Hyper Pink accents brings the same bold pink base to the collection's most performance-specific silhouette, the cut-first basketball shoe that Nike developed for guards and wings who need explosive lateral movement support, with the pink upper covering the smooth toe area, molded overlays, and open mesh side panels while white hits on the Swoosh, heel support piece, and midsole provide the contrast that keeps the colorway from reading as flat. The Unseen Hours branding is hidden behind the tongue in the series' signature concealed detail, while the hourglass logo stamps the right heel and the left heel carries a cherry blossom at the center of its Unseen Hours emblem. Virginia-specific details include the VA text and the 703 area code on the inner and outer tongue, referencing Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax, and the surrounding communities that define Virginia's contribution to DMV basketball culture. Style code CZ0175-600, available in unisex sizing.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia is the DMV pack's performance silhouette, the cherry blossom-colored GT Cut 1 for the player or collector who wants their basketball shoe to carry the regional pride and hidden storytelling of the Unseen Hours series' most geographically specific Virginia chapter.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Unseen Hours Virginia was released on May 22, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

shoeName: Nike GT Cut Academy Black Alabaster
description: The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Academy 'Black Alabaster' rolls out a black mesh upper with off-white decorative stitching. The side panel has a glossy black Swoosh piped in off-white details. The dual-density foam midsole contains a Zoom Air forefoot unit. The rubber outsole gets a modified herringbone pattern for swift cuts on the court.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 11 Protro Mamba Day
description: The Nike Kobe 11 Protro Low 'Mamba Day' nods to Kobe Bryant's final NBA game. These shoes have a black mesh upper wrapped in metallic gold numerology references, including the dates of Bryant's first and last NBA games, along with mentions of his five titles and 81-point game. This Protro edition has a drop-in ReactX foam midsole packed with Zoom Air cushioning in the heel. The see-through rubber outsole has a revised pattern for steady traction.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Protro ASG Hollywood 3D (2026)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro '3D All-Star' returns the shoes Kobe Bryant wore during the 2011 NBA All-Star. These kicks have a stereoscopic-print micromesh upper which can be seen in full thanks to the 3D glasses included in the box. A red Swoosh adorns one side, while an aqua blue Swoosh decorates the opposite end. Red and blue hues take turns on the heel counter, while the Sheath logo graces the tongue. These shoes ride on a new version of the Cushlon midsole, equipped with a Zoom Air forefoot unit. A carbon fiber shank plate enhances arch support and midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time celebrates achievement and momentum through a bold mix of turquoise, safety orange, and vivid purple that feels energetic and unapologetic. The colorway gives the Ja 3 a vibrant and almost celebratory look, highlighting the silhouette’s speed and fluidity. It feels expressive and confident, designed to match Ja Morant’s ability to take over moments repeatedly.

Fans love this release because it feels triumphant. The Twelve Time theme suggests repetition of greatness, and the color execution reinforces that idea with fearless contrast and motion. Collectors appreciate how this pair pushes color while keeping performance front and center, making it a standout Ja 3 that feels symbolic, dynamic, and perfectly aligned with Morant’s rising legacy in the league.

The Nike Ja 3 Twelve Time was released on January 20, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer expands on the Jurassic Park-inspired storytelling seen in the Ja 3 lineup, this time leaning into a brighter, more adventurous palette. Featuring green spark with black, university red, and dynamic yellow accents, the colorway channels the lush, unpredictable environment of the franchise’s island setting.

Where the "Raptor" edition focused on intensity and aggression, the "Explorer" version shifts toward exploration and discovery, reflecting Ja Morant’s evolving presence as a player who continues to push boundaries. The Ja 3’s modern, angular design works naturally with this theme, allowing the contrasting colors to create movement and energy across the upper.

When the Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer released, it retailed for $135 and dropped on April 10, 2026. With its green spark, black, university red, and dynamic yellow colorway, this release offers a more vibrant take on the crossover, expanding the narrative beyond a single theme.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon (2025/2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Big Bubble - Neon' brings an upper comprised of grey, rippling synthetic suede side panels that scale down in a gradient. Rope-style laces feed through yellow webbed eyelets that reference human ribs. A 3M reflective finish covers the lace web and molded heel panel, debossed with a Nike Air logo. These shoes have a black foam midsole with neon-colored Air-Sole forefoot and heel units.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Metallic Silver (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Photon Dust Metallic Silver' is an old-school runner designed for long-lasting comfort and adorned with sparkling details. The upper is made of a combination of breathable mesh and synthetic leather in a sleek light grey hue. The toe box and iconic Swoosh are embellished with glossy chrome accents while the molded heel cage provides a stable and supportive fit. The shoe is equipped with a foam midsole with responsive forefoot and heel Zoom Air cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Mind 001 Slide Solar Red
description: The Nike Mind 001 'Solar Red' dons a red-colored upper. Crafted with Nike Mind technology, these shoes have 22 independent nodes that push against your foot to activate sensory receptors to keep you present with every step. The soft foam midsole pairs with a stretchy footbed, allowing the nodes to move freely upon impact. These slides are ideal for pre-game and post-game activities, facilitating recovery while keeping every step engaged.

shoeName: Nike P-6000 Metallic Silver
description: The Nike P-6000 'Metallic Silver' brings a silver mesh upper with chrome-colored synthetic leather overlays. A floating Swoosh is piped in black. The full-length foam midsole works with a black rubber, herringbone-patterned outsole.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda
description: The Dunk Low 'Black White' also known as 'Panda' brings a classic two-tone look to its classic basketball construction. The shoe's low-top build emerges in leather, with a white base contrasted by black overlays, with further black on the Swoosh branding. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, the two-tone look is matched by the tooling, which incorporates a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low What The LA
description: The Air Force 1 '07 LV8 'What The LA' showcases a mashup design that gives the nod to Los Angeles’ numerous major sports franchises: the Lakers, Clippers, Sparks, Dodgers, Angels, Rams, Chargers, Kings and Galaxy. Common details between the left and right shoe include speckled midsoles, an embroidered mini-Swoosh and a ‘Los Angeles’ wordmark on the lateral heel.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor merges Ja Morant’s explosive signature line with one of cinema’s most recognizable franchises. Dressed in anthracite with bright crimson and yellow ochre accents, the sneaker channels the aggressive color palette associated with the Raptors from Jurassic Park. The darker base allows the vibrant red and yellow hits to stand out, creating a design that feels both dynamic and cinematic.

This collaboration taps into the long-standing relationship between sneakers and pop culture storytelling. Jurassic Park has influenced design across multiple industries, and here it’s reinterpreted through the lens of basketball footwear. The Ja 3’s sharp lines and modern silhouette provide the perfect canvas for this theme, with color blocking that mirrors the intensity and unpredictability of both the Raptors and Ja Morant’s style of play.

When the Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Raptor released, it retailed for $135 and dropped on April 10, 2026. With its anthracite, bright crimson, and yellow ochre colorway and crossover appeal, this release stands out as a bold fusion of basketball culture and film-inspired design.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '01 NIGO x J-Hope
Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple Black
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Triple Black' sport a black mesh upper, tooled with synthetic leather overlays and a midfoot cage that's built into the lacing system. A lattice-like heel counter keeps the ankle in place. These shoes have a black Cushlon midsole equipped with springy Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and heel for an all-around plush feel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Goadome Low Foam SP Green Goblin
Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black
description:
The all-black Air Force 1 Low is a timeless classic in Nike's catalog of heritage sneakers.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Black features a triple black smooth leather upper with a matching Air sole and laces. Subtle Nike Air embroidery on the heel tab nods to the history of the AF-1 line. A metallic lace tag and woven tongue label complete the design.

The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 retails for $115.

shoeName: Nike Ja 4 Dark Mode
description:
The Nike Ja 4 Dark Mode brings a sleek, technologically inspired concept into Ja Morant's fourth signature basketball model, combining black, metallic silver, and cobalt bliss into a genuinely moody, sophisticated presentation. The Dark Mode naming references the popular digital display setting that has become culturally significant within contemporary technology use, giving this colorway conceptual connection to modern digital culture. Cobalt bliss accents add unexpected pops of cool blue energy against the darker black and metallic silver base tones.

Morant's signature line continues to reflect his explosive, highlight reel style of play through considered performance construction and thoughtful, culturally relevant color storytelling. This Dark Mode concept gives collectors a genuinely contemporary, tech inspired way to engage with Morant's signature line, tapping into broader digital culture references familiar to younger fans. Fans of both Morant's explosive playing style and conceptually driven, technologically inspired colorways find this Dark Mode release a compelling addition to their collection.

The Nike Ja 4 Dark Mode was released on September 4, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Indiana Fever
description: The Caitlin Clark x Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'Indiana Fever' rides on a Cushlon midsole, equipped with a forefoot Zoom Air unit and a midfoot shank plate. A navy synthetic and mesh upper uses Flywire technology to offer a secure fit. Kobe Bryant's shield logo adorns the red tongue, while the classic Swoosh is piped in a red and amber gradient, matching the color scheme on the heel counter.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 TB White Black Wolf Grey
Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Pink Foam (Women's)
description: The 2025 edition of the Nike Women's Air Max 95 OG 'Pink Foam' rocks a black foam midsole tooled with pink Max Air units for a lightweight feel underfoot. The wavy suede overlays on the side panels go from light grey to charcoal. Soft pink pops land on the webbed eyelets, Air Max tongue, the Swoosh and the Nike Air logo on the reflective heel panel

shoeName: Nike Kobe 10 Protro Low Halo
description:
The Nike Kobe 10 Protro Low Halo brings a celestial, luminous concept into the respected Kobe 10 Protro silhouette, finished entirely in white for a clean, ethereal presentation. The Halo naming suggests themes of radiant light and spiritual significance, giving this colorway conceptual depth tied to Kobe Bryant's enduring legacy and the reverence with which fans continue to honor his memory. The Protro construction preserves the original Kobe 10's performance characteristics, honoring the shoe's basketball heritage through this meaningful tribute colorway.

The Kobe 10 Protro has earned respect among basketball sneaker collectors for its faithful recreation of the original's traction and responsiveness, continuing Kobe's basketball legacy through genuine performance credibility. The Halo concept gives this release profound emotional significance, evoking themes of light, legacy, and lasting reverence that resonate deeply with Kobe's devoted fanbase. Collectors who appreciate both Kobe's enduring basketball legacy and conceptually meaningful tribute colorways find this Halo release a genuinely significant, emotionally resonant addition to their collection.

The Nike Kobe 10 Protro Low Halo was released on August 23, 2026 with a retail price of $190.

shoeName: Nike Caitlin 1 Warning Code (Women's)
description:
The Nike Caitlin 1 Warning Code (Women's) brings Yellow Zest and Racer Blue to Caitlin Clark’s debut signature basketball silhouette. The bright yellow foundation gives the textured upper a bold appearance, while blue accents create contrast across the branding. As one of the model’s launch colorways, Warning Code introduces the personal design language that runs throughout Clark’s first Nike signature collection.

The lightweight Opticast upper uses flexible cast-PU material for containment, with molded CC and 22 details connecting the construction to Clark. A forefoot Air Zoom Turbo unit works with Cushlon foam, while a midfoot plate adds stability during changes of direction. Underneath, a rubber outsole incorporates a C-inspired traction pattern and cutouts. Double Swooshes reference her initials and the three-point arc, with her signature appearing at the heel.

The yellow-and-blue combination gives this edition a clear identity alongside the launch collection’s blue-based counterpart. Its personal branding and court-focused construction provide details for both players and collectors to appreciate. Released on October 1, 2026, the Nike Caitlin 1 Warning Code (Women's) retailed for $140.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Coconut Milk Spruce
description: The Caitlin Clark x Nike Kobe 5 Protro 'Coconut Milk Spruce' consists of a glossy ivory synthetic leather upper tooled with dark teal overlays and a matching Swoosh. A red tongue is stamped with Kobe Bryant's Sheath logo. This Protro edition gets a Cushlon midsole with an articulated Zoom Air forefoot unit below. The rubber outsole contains an exposed glass-based carbon fiber shank plate attached underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (Women's)
description: A women's shoe, the Wmns Dunk Low 'Black White' also known as ‘Panda’ emerges with a classic two-tone look. Built entirely with leather, the shoe's upper sports a white base overlaid by black, with black also marking the Swoosh branding. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while white branding appears on the tongue and heel patch. Underfoot, the two-tone rubber cupsole includes a concentric outsole to provide traction.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro What The (2025)
description: The 2025 iteration of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'What The Kobe' throws it back to 2013, inspiring the color palette and details from former Kobe 8 colorways. The right shoe has a mesh upper in a red snakeskin print, contrasted by a yellow Swoosh and a lime green lining. The left shoe has a blue snakeskin print and a red Swoosh that matches the collar lining. A large, reflective Nike wordmark adorns the inside of the foot. These kicks are updated with a Cushlon midsole and a springy Zoom Air forefoot unit.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro Game Royal
description: Released as part of a 'Team Bank' pack, the Kobe 9 EM Protro TB 'Game Royal' trots out a speckled midsole that equips a drop-in React foam unit, while the rubber outsole uses a traction pattern based on a pressure map of the human foot. These basketball shoes have a blue engineered mesh upper, secured with Dynamic Flywire cables for a lockdown feel. A white Swoosh on the side matches Kobe Bryant's sheath logo on the tongue, maintaining the signature look.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Granite
description: The Nike Air Max 95 'Big Bubble - Granite' makes use of rope-style laces feed to secure the grey suede upper. The latter has a gradient design that showcases multiple tones in cascading fashion. The lace cover and molded heel panel are stamped with a debossed Nike Air logo, touched with a reflective matte silver coating. The black foam midsole equips Air-Sole cushioning for a plush feel underfoot, including the 'Big Bubble' heel unit, just like the OG.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 TB White University Red
description:
The Nike Ja 3 TB White University Red brings Ja Morant's third signature basketball model into a clean, high contrast palette, combining white, metallic silver, and university red for a genuinely striking presentation. The TB designation typically signals Team Bank pricing or configuration, often associated with team specific bulk ordering for school or league programs. This white and university red combination gives the shoe strong visual energy suited for team specific applications or general retail collecting.

Ja Morant's signature line continues to reflect his explosive, highlight reel style of play through considered performance construction and bold aesthetic choices season after season. White and university red together create a bold, high contrast color story that works well both for team specific ordering programs and general collectors who appreciate this energetic palette. Fans of Morant's continued signature shoe evolution find this Ja 3 TB release a compelling way to engage with his ongoing basketball footwear legacy.

The Nike Ja 3 TB White University Red was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Goadome 865031 Black
Nike Air Bakin OG (2026)
description: The 2026 edition of the Nike Air Bakin 'Varsity Red' remixes the Tim Hardaway signature sneakers, consisting of a varsity red mesh upper secured with matching laces. Red synthetic nubuck overlays and a black rubberized mudguard complement the design, along with a Nike Air signoff on the tongue and heel. The black rubber outsole engulfs part of the Phylon midsole, which packs an encapsulated Air-Sole forefoot unit and an exposed Max Air heel unit.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Total Orange
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro 'Total Orange' brings a full-length Cushlon midsole equipped with a Zoom Turbo forefoot unit. A see-through rubber outsole makes way for an exposed carbon fiber shank, which enhances midfoot stability.These shoes have an orange micromesh upper wrapped in a snakeskin texture comprised of raised 'islands.' A metallic silver Swoosh adorns the side, while Kobe Bryant's shield logo embellishes the tongue. His signature is etched on the molded heel counter as the final stamp of approval.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 10 Low Protro 5AM Flight (2026)
description: The Nike Kobe 10 Low Protro '5 AM Flight' nods to Kobe Bryant's 2013 leap from a diving platform as he recovered from Achilles surgery. These shoes have a lagoon blue, open-weave knit upper. The left heel panel is stamped with four red lines that represent Bryant's Achilles sutures, while his Sheath logo graces the right heel. The foam midsole packs a Zoom Air unit, anchored by a see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Scratch 3.0
description:
Nike Ja 3 Turbo Green injects high energy color into Ja Morant’s signature line, pairing bold green tones with the aggressive spirit that defines his game. The Turbo Green finish gives the shoe instant presence, reflecting speed, confidence, and momentum. It feels expressive and fearless, much like Ja’s playing style itself.

What makes this colorway hit is how naturally it complements the Ja 3 silhouette. The modern shape and performance focused design feel amplified by the vibrant color, making the shoe look fast even when standing still. Fans of the Ja line appreciate releases like this because they carry personality and storytelling, turning performance footwear into an extension of the athlete behind it.

The Nike Ja 3 Turbo Green was released on 11/05/2025 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl
description:
The Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl commemorates Kevin Durant's late aunt with its meaningful design and striking aesthetics. This edition continues the tradition of blending basketball performance with heartfelt storytelling, and combines unique materials and design elements in an unforgettable silhouette.

Aunt Pearl's version of the KD 17 NRG by Nike features a predominantly pink foam textile upper, accented with iridescent "KD" branding on the tongue and heel. Embroidered details on the heel overlay add depth and symbolize the emotional connection behind the design. The midsole integrates responsive Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot, complemented by an Air Strobel unit in the heel. This shoe was introduced to honor Durant's aunt and raise awareness for cancer research.

One thing we love about the Nike KD 17 NRG Aunt Pearl is its intricate embroidery that honors Kevin Durant’s family legacy. Additionally, the cushioning system blends advanced Zoom Air and Air Strobel technology, which offers impressive performance. Released on 15th November 2024, this heartfelt design retailed at $150.

shoeName: Nike KD 4 Aunt Pearl (2024)
description: This 2024 version of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Aunt Pearl' throws it back to the 2012 classic that paid tribute to Kevin Durant's late aunt. A hot pink mesh upper gets fused overlays and an adjustable midfoot strap stamped with a black Swoosh. A graphic design comprised of many pearls covers the tongue, collar, heel and side. A Phylon midsole works with a plastic shank for stability and a Zoom Air forefoot unit for lightweight cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Chrome Toe (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Chrome Toe' rocks a white mesh upper with matching leather overlays and a midfoot cage. A chrome-plated Swoosh decorates the side panel, matching the eyestay and the synthetic overlays framing the toe. The full-length Cushlon midsole packs Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel for springy cushioning.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Patent Black Spruce Gold
Nike Ja 3 Daybreak
description:
Nike Ja 3 Daybreak captures a lighter, more optimistic side of Ja Morant’s signature line while keeping the aggressive edge that defines his game. The Daybreak theme brings brighter tones and contrast into the Ja 3 silhouette, giving the shoe a sense of momentum and freshness that mirrors early morning runs and first tip energy. It feels uplifting without losing intensity.

What makes this colorway resonate is how naturally it complements the Ja 3’s fast and reactive design. The shape feels built for motion, and the Daybreak palette adds clarity and confidence to every angle. Fans of the line appreciate this release because it shows range, proving the Ja 3 can carry both bold personality and lighter emotion while staying true to Ja’s fearless identity.

The Nike Ja 3 Daybreak was released on 11/15/2025 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 270 Triple Black
description: Drawing inspiration from its predecessors (the Air Max 180 and Air Max 93), the monochromatic Air Max 270 ‘Triple Black’ features a mesh upper, contrasting materials on the toe and midfoot, dual-density foam midsole, and oversized Air Max heel unit—all dressed in black.

shoeName: Nike Ja 4 Rise
Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Michael Jackson Moonwalker (2025)
description: The 2025 iteration of the Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro 'Moonwalker' nods to none other than the King of Pop, Michael Jackson. The purple Flyknit upper works with Dynamic Flywire cables for a lockdown feel. A silver Swoosh matches Kobe Bryant's sheath logo on the tongue. The midsole has a carbon fiber panel and a drop-in React foam insole for enhanced cushioning. The see-through rubber outsole reveals an eye-catching moonrock graphic underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro WNBA All-Star (2026)
Nike Kobe 8 Protro Shanghai Fireworks (2026)
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Shanghai Fireworks' stays true to the original 2013 release, which launched exclusively in China. The mesh upper has a series of exploding firework graphics in a swirling mix of orange, red, and yellow. A black Swoosh on the side meets Kobe's Sheath logo on the tongue to keep the signature look. This Protro edition gets drop-in React foam cushioning, housed within a Phylon foam carrier. The see-through rubber outsole has an exposed glass-based carbon fiber shank plate underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Luxe University of Oregon Apple Green
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua
colorway: Bleached Aqua/Cashmere/Sport Gold/Chile Red/Metallic Silver/Glacier Blue
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua is the first colorway released from the three-pair Dusk 2 Dawn collaborative pack between Filipino sneaker retailer and barbershop Titan and San Antonio Spurs rookie guard Dylan Harper, featuring a light blue Bleached Aqua upper on the GT Cut 1 platform with a yellow-to-grey gradient on the tongue, Swoosh, and midsole, red accent detailing on the medial Swoosh and midsole support piece, Cashmere and Glacier Blue secondary tones, Metallic Silver accents, and Dylan Harper's personal flying D logo stamped on the heel as the PE-identifying detail that connects the shoe directly to the second-overall 2025 NBA Draft pick. The Daybreak colorway concept was designed to honor Harper's Filipino heritage through his mother, whose hometown is in Bataan, Philippines, with the light aqua blue representing the calm of a Bataan sunrise and the gradient color transitions evoking the gradual shift of morning light, making the shoe a cultural tribute as much as a performance basketball release. Titan, the Philippines-based sneaker retailer with a history of Nike and Jordan Brand collaborations, worked with Harper and Nike Basketball to develop the three-pair arc, with Bleached Aqua serving as the first chapter, followed by Black and White colorways planned for Fall 2026. Harper debuted the colorway during San Antonio's playoff run, wearing the shoe on court during the 2026 NBA Finals against the New York Knicks.

Released June 20, 2026 at $210 retail globally via nike.com and select retailers, following an exclusive Titan launch June 17 and an early Foot Locker release June 1, with style code IU0779-400 in unisex sizing.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Bleached Aqua was released on June 20, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike KD 4 Texas Longhorns (2025)
description: The 2025 iteration of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Texas' nods to Kevin Durant's alma mater. Loyal to the 2012 OG release, these kicks have a desert orange mesh and synthetic upper secured a hook-and-loop strap. The Longhorn graphic adorns the tongue, while the KD logo adorns the white synthetic leather panel that wraps around the midfoot. The Phylon midsole contains Zoom Air technology in the forefoot for a springy feel.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Murray State
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Murray State brings things back to Ja Morant’s roots, using a color palette that reflects his college journey. Pure platinum sets a clean base, while deep royal blue, lightening, and dusty cactus accents add depth and school inspired energy. The silhouette remains performance focused, built for speed and control.

This version stands out because of its story. It connects directly to Ja’s path, giving the shoe a personal edge that goes beyond design. Fans appreciate releases like this because they represent milestones, turning the sneaker into a piece of that journey rather than just another colorway.

The Nike Ja 3 Murray State was released on March 5, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Filbert Light Chocolate
Nike Kobe 5 Protro X-Ray
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'X-Ray' sports a glow-in-the-dark X-ray graphic resembling the bones of the foot. A deep royal blue synthetic upper works with a padded mesh collar and integrated Flywire cables for lockdown. A lightweight Cushlon midsole contains a responsive Zoom Air forefoot unit, while a blue see-through rubber outsole glows in the dark.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Animal Pack Tiger
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Animal Pack Tiger brings Ja Morant's high flying signature line into a bold, nature inspired Animal Pack theme, translating the tiger's fierce, energetic presence into a Safety Orange, Black, and University Red colorway. Morant's game has always been defined by explosive athleticism and fearless energy, making a tiger themed release a fitting tribute to his aggressive, attacking playing style. The Animal Pack concept gives Nike a chance to inject bold, thematic storytelling into the Ja line beyond standard team or city based colorways.

Collectors who follow Ja Morant's signature shoes appreciate how the line consistently finds creative, high energy ways to represent his personality and game through design. The Tiger colorway in particular captures that same relentless intensity through its striking orange and red combination. Fans of both animal inspired sneaker themes and Morant's explosive playing style will find this release a compelling addition to their collection.

The Nike Ja 3 Animal Pack Tiger was released on July 3, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Gold (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Metallic Gold' rocks an open-cell mesh, including gold synthetic leather overlays. The latter hue accents the Swoosh and heel counter. An off-white Cushlon midsole is enhanced with Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel, while a waffle-patterned rubber outsole provides reliable traction.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro Mambacita
description: The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro 'Mambacita' commemorates Gianna 'Gigi' Bryant, and her impact on women's basketball. Referencing the colors of Gigi's youth basketball team at the Mamba Sports Academy, these shoes have a white mesh upper bolstered with a lattice-like shell. Glossy black patent leather lands on the toe cap and heel overlay, which is stamped with 'GiGi' in metallic gold letters. A gold Sheath logo decorates the tongue. This Protro version has a black rubber cupsole housed within a Cushlon 3.0 midsole and a full-length Zoom Strobel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble ACG Cacao Wow Teal
Nike Air Foamposite Pro Glow-In-The-Dark
description: The Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Glow in the Dark' rocks a glow-in-the-dark white Foamposite upper, accented with a molded black Swoosh. More black pops connect on the mesh tongue, nubuck collar and eyestay, as well as the sock-like unit inside. The foam midsole contains a full-length Zoom Air unit stacked with a Zoom Air heel unit for all-around cushioning. The black rubber outsole has herringbone traction pods and a carbon fiber shank plate for steady footing.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro China
description: The 2025 iteration of the Nike Kobe 9 Low EM 'China' commemorates the connection Kobe Bryant had with Chinese basketball fans. A metallic gold Swoosh decorates the black engineered mesh upper, which has inner cables built into the lacing system for a locked-in fit. Bryant's sheath logo pairs with an embroidered floral print to adorn the tongue. A drop-in React foam midsole keeps every step soft, while carbon fiber plates underfoot bring stability.

shoeName: Nike Ja 4 Jaws
description:
The Nike Ja 4 Jaws gives Ja Morant’s signature shoe an ocean-inspired look. Shades of blue shift across the textured upper, with darker tones near the collar and lighter hues toward the forefoot. The tongue carries the defining detail: sharp white teeth surrounding a red Ja logo. Dark side accents and a pale, translucent-looking outsole extend the aquatic theme across the rest of the shoe.

The low-cut Ja 4 is built around quick movement, matching a responsive cushioned ride with support through the midfoot. Its upper keeps the shape streamlined for play, while the blue gradient and tooth graphic make this edition identifiable even off the court. The shark imagery plays on Ja’s name and gives the pair a distinct place among the more straightforward colors in his signature line. It is a performance basketball shoe with a design that also rewards a closer look.

Scheduled for release on September 25, 2026, the Nike Ja 4 Jaws has a retail price of $140. With its shark-tooth tongue, layered blues, and court-ready construction, this pair brings a memorable theme to Morant’s fourth signature model.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Dodgers
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro 'Dodgers' uses a bold royal blue upper to celebrate the MLB franchise, making use of 'islands' that create an eye-catching snakeskin texture. A white printed Swoosh graces the side panel, matching the heel cage and Kobe Bryant's shield logo on the tongue. The latter is touched with red baseball-style stitching, while a crimson '8' is embossed on the heel. A lightweight Cushlon midsole packs Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot for a propulsive feel.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island brings cinematic influence into Ja Morant’s signature line, using a metallic silver black white baltic blue palette that feels futuristic and bold. The reflective elements and layered design give the shoe a high energy presence, aligning with the intensity associated with Jurassic Park themes.

Fans are drawn to this release because it merges basketball performance with pop culture storytelling. The metallic finish adds a unique edge, making it stand out both on and off the court. It reflects the growing trend of signature sneakers tapping into broader cultural references, creating something that feels dynamic and collectible.

The Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Cloud Island was released on April 21, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Mind 002 Black Hyper Crimson
description: The Nike Mind 002 'Black Hyper Crimson' has a black knit upper tooled with engineered perforations to optimize airflow. Those 22 outsole nodes help engage sensory areas of the brain to keep you present as you move through your day. Red touches throughout along with chrome details give these kicks a futuristic touch. The molded foam heel and tongue help keep you comfortable along with a plush midsole underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Caitlin Clark Rookie of the Year
description: The Caitlin Clark x Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'Rookie of the Year' packs a Cushlon midsole fortified by a beefy Zoom Air forefoot unit. Inspired by a photo of Clark hoisting her Rookie of the Year award. These shoes have a metallic silver upper, contrasted by red touches on the collar, Swoosh, as well as Kobe Bryant's sheath logo on the tongue.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 TB White Game Royal
description:
The Nike Ja 3 TB White Game Royal continues Ja Morant's third signature basketball model line into another team specific colorway, combining white, metallic silver, and game royal for a genuinely fresh, energetic presentation. The TB designation typically signals Team Bank pricing or configuration, often associated with team specific bulk ordering for school or league programs. Game royal accents give this pair distinctive blue energy compared to the more neutral wolf grey version within this same TB release series.

Ja Morant's signature line continues to reflect his explosive, highlight reel style of play through considered performance construction and varied colorway options suited for team specific programs. White, metallic silver, and game royal together create a fresh, energetic color story that offers genuine variety compared to more neutral toned Ja 3 TB releases. Fans of Morant's continued signature shoe evolution and team specific ordering programs find this Game Royal release a compelling addition to the broader TB collection.

The Nike Ja 3 TB White Game Royal was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Army Camo (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Green Camo' stays loyal to the 2013 release. These kicks have a camo print that uses green, tan, and brown hues over the molded Foamposite upper. A 3D black Swoosh decorates the side, complementing the volt-colored Swoosh embroidered on the black nubuck eyestay. A concealed foam midsole packs full-length Zoom Air technology, along with a Zoom Air heel unit underfoot. The gum rubber outsole gets herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank plate below.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper White Multi
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper White Multi continues this collaboration with rising basketball star Dylan Harper, combining white, star blue, chile red, luminous green, aluminum, and metallic silver into a genuinely vibrant, multi tone alternative to the black colorway. This lighter execution gives collectors a fresh, energetic option within the Titan collaboration, showcasing an even broader range of colors compared to its darker counterpart. The GT Cut Titan line represents Nike's most advanced basketball performance technology, built for elite level agility and responsiveness.

Dylan Harper's emergence as a top basketball prospect has generated significant excitement within both basketball and sneaker collecting circles, and this white based colorway gives fans of his rising career an even bolder, more colorful way to engage with his signature collaboration. The extensive multi tone palette reflects genuine personality and energy befitting an emerging star's personal brand identity. Collectors who appreciate both cutting edge basketball performance technology and Harper's exciting rise find this White Multi version a compelling companion piece to the black colorway within this significant collaborative release.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper White Multi was released on August 6, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Girl Dad
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro ‘Girl Dad’ nods to the bond Kobe Bryant shared with his daughters. The muted teal suede upper has rolled edges and contrast black accents on the Swoosh, collar lining and inside the tongue. A chrome-plated heel counter reveals Kobe Bryant’s signature on the lateral side, while the inner tongue displays a ‘Girl Dad’ signoff. These sneakers have a lightweight Phylon midsole equipped with a responsive Zoom Air heel unit. A herringbone-pattern rubber outsole meets a carbon fiber shank plate to provide midfoot support and grippy traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Blazer Mid 77 Vintage 'White Black' sports a black retro Swoosh to contrast the white leather upper, touched with suede overlays along the toe as well as the midfoot. A Nike wordmark adorns the back tab, while a Nike tag is featured on the foam tongue. The herringbone-patterned rubber outsole is the same as the one used for quick cuts on the hardwood.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Pro SB Black White Gum
Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl
colorway: Pearl Pink/Laser Fuchsia/Tulip Pink/Playful Pink/Pink Foam/Glacier Blue
description:
Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl continues one of the most meaningful traditions in signature sneaker history, blending performance design with purpose driven storytelling. The Aunt Pearl series has always symbolized strength, hope, and remembrance, and this edition carries that message through soft pink tones and thoughtful detailing that feel respectful rather than decorative. It is emotionally grounded and visually powerful.

Beyond the message, the KD 18 silhouette reflects Kevin Durant’s precise and adaptable playing style. The shoe feels tuned for control and confidence, designed for players who rely on rhythm and finesse. Collectors value this release because it represents more than basketball, standing as a reminder that sneakers can carry real meaning while still delivering elite on court presence.

The Nike KD 18 Aunt Pearl was released on 10/07/2025 with a retail price of $170.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Premium Black Patent
Nike ST Charge Cade Cunningham Detroit Tough
description:
The Nike ST Charge Cade Cunningham Detroit Tough is the Detroit Pistons star's first official Player Exclusive colorway tied to the Nike ST Charge, Nike Basketball's Street Tough series silhouette designed for outdoor-ready performance and heavy court use, a release that places Cade Cunningham's identity and city at the center of the shoe's design narrative at the precise moment when the Pistons' resurgence under his leadership has made him one of the NBA's most discussed young stars. Cunningham debuted the ST Charge itself at the 2026 NBA All-Star Weekend in Inglewood before the silhouette gained its widest attention through this Detroit-themed PE, the player-exclusive that confirms the significance of his relationship with Nike Basketball as he awaits the formal launch of his own signature shoe. The colorway builds around Detroit's white, red, and blue municipal flag and Pistons team color palette in a way that feels restrained rather than decorative: a white reinforced mesh upper provides the clean base, while icy Thunder Blue translucent TPU armor overlays the toe, side panels, heel, and midsole for the elevated outdoor-style visual character that defines the ST Charge's design identity. Red and blue mismatched laces reference Pistons colors directly, silver eyelets and metallic Swoosh details sharpen the presentation, Cunningham's number 2 appears embroidered on the heel pull tab, and his CC monogram lands on the tongue as a personalized signature. Underfoot, Cushlon 3.0 midsole foam and Zoom Turbo forefoot cushioning deliver the responsiveness appropriate to outdoor courts and concrete surfaces, while the tougher outsole compound is built for long-term durability. Style code IZ6735-100, released May 20, 2026 exclusively at Foot Locker at $140 in men's sizing.

The Nike ST Charge Cade Cunningham Detroit Tough is the city-specific PE that announces Cunningham's Nike identity as clearly and as geographically specifically as any Player Exclusive in the 2025-26 season, a shoe for the Detroit fan and basketball enthusiast who wants to wear the silhouette that introduced the world to what a Cade Cunningham Nike shoe looks and feels like.

The Nike ST Charge Cade Cunningham Detroit Tough was released on May 20, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB University Red
description: Part of a Team Bank collection, the Nike Kobe 9 EM Protro TB 'University Red' consists of an engineered red mesh upper complemented by a white Swoosh that matches Kobe Bryant's sheath logo on the tongue. Red speckled details wrap up the foam midsole, which is assisted by a drop-in React foam insole. The white rubber outsole has a traction pattern in all directions, based on a pressure mapping of Bryant's foot.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Wolf Grey
description: Taken from the Team Bank series, the Nike Kobe 9 EM Protro TB 'Wolf Grey' carries a grey engineered mesh upper with a matching Swoosh. A padded collar keeps you comfortable from the go, while Flywire cables pair with the shoelaces to keep the midfoot locked down. Faint speckles adorn the foam midsole, which contains a resilient drop-in React foam insole. The white rubber outsole has a traction pattern based on a pressure mapping of Kobe Bryant's foot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Anthracite
description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Black Anthracite' has a blackout mesh upper that partially conceals the lacing system. The AM95's classic rippling leather overlays go from smooth to textured surfaces. A reflective coating on the lace guard and heel panel, is debossed with a Nike Air logo, allowing better visibility in low-light conditions. The black foam midsole is aided by a blue 'Big Bubble' Max Air heel unit for plush cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro Grinch
description: The Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro 'Grinch' packs that signature electric green hue, complemented with a Stadium Green overlay on the mesh upper. A diamond-patterned cage helps with containment, bolstered with a series of synthetic leather overlays on the forefoot as well as the heel. The Kobe logo lands on the tongue as well as the insoles, while the Swoosh adorns the heel. This Protro version rides on a rubber cupsole, comprised of a light Cushlon midsole and a full-length Zoom Air Strobel.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 Statue of Liberty (Women's)
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 Statue of Liberty Womens channels a strong thematic concept into Sabrina Ionescu’s signature line, using color and detail to reflect one of the most recognizable landmarks. The mint foam base creates a fresh and vibrant look, while black accents provide contrast and structure. Metallic gold elements add a subtle highlight, tying the design back to the Statue of Liberty inspiration.

Fans are drawn to this pair because it blends performance basketball design with a clear and meaningful concept. The color palette feels cohesive and intentional, making the story easy to recognize without being overly literal. It stands as a strong addition to Sabrina’s line, offering both on court functionality and visual identity.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Statue of Liberty Womens was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Ohio State
Nike Dunk Low Cacao Wow (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Dunk Low 'Cacao Wow' showcases an upper crafted from smooth leather, combining a crisp white base with rich chocolate brown overlays that extend to the iconic Swoosh logo. The midsole boasts a vintage off-white finish and houses an interior foam wedge, providing lightweight cushioning and support. The brown rubber outsole offers durability and traction for everyday wear. Old-school Nike branding can be found on the tongue tag, back tab, and sockliner.

shoeName: Nike KD 6 Peanut Butter & Jelly (PBJ) (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike KD 6 'Peanut Butter Jelly' brings back details from the 2013 release, starting with an amber synthetic upper touched with contrasting black panels. Purple knit lines the collar, matching the Swoosh on the forefoot. The full-length Phylon midsole contains an encapsulated Zoom Air forefoot unit and an exposed Max Air heel unit for responsive cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 All-Star
description:
The Nike Ja 3 All-Star brings a cool, polished look to Ja Morant’s third signature silhouette. Dressed in cobalt bliss with metallic silver and midnight navy accents, this colorway balances energy and refinement. The metallic elements add shine and dimension, while the deeper blue tones keep the design grounded and wearable.

This release highlights the Ja 3’s ability to shift between bold expression and clean styling. The cobalt base delivers vibrancy, while silver details elevate the overall look with a subtle futuristic edge. It’s a colorway that feels confident without being overwhelming, making it easy to style while still standing out in a rotation.

When the Nike Ja 3 All-Star released, it retailed for $125 and dropped on February 13, 2026. With its balanced palette and modern finish, this version adds a sleek chapter to the growing Ja Morant signature line.

shoeName: Nike Ja 4 Halloween
colorway: Oil Green/Bright Crimson/Light Lemon Twist/Black/Purple Venom/Cobalt Bliss

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Nardwuar
description: The Nardwuar x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Tam O' Shanter Hat' nods to the Human Serviette, the internet personality who became known for his watcky video interviews. Taking cues from Nardwuar's iconic hat, these shoes are dressed on a tartan plaid knit upper, using a mix of red, green, blue, and yellow. A black suede Swoosh matches the back tab for bold contrast. The see-through rubber outsole showcases Nardwuar unique catchphrase: 'Doot doola doot doo… Doot doo!'

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '01 Hellraiser Pinhead
Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pine Green (2025)
description: The 2025 edition of the Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Pine Green' nods to the 2011 original rendition, sporting an iridescent green molded Foamposite upper, stamped with a molded black Swoosh on the side. Black pops land on the nubuck eyestay and interior bootie. The hidden Phylon midsole contains a full-length Zoom Air unit, stacked with a drop-in Zoom Air heel unit for all-around cushioning. A see-through rubber outsole uses herringbone traction pods for steady traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Dodgers (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 GS 'Dodgers' rocks a royal blue micromesh upper, using foam 'islands' that constitute an eye-catching snakeskin texture. Red baseball-style stitching on the tongue makes way for Kobe Bryant's 3D sheath logo, matching the white Swoosh on the side and the heel counter. A red '8' signs off on the heel as a nod to the Hall of Famer. These shoes have a full-length Cushlon midsole bolstered with a Zoom Air forefoot unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Year of the Horse (2026)
description: The 2026 iteration of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Year of the Horse' rings in the Lunar New Year with multiple red shades on the engineered mesh upper. A golden yellow Swoosh decorates the side, matching Bryant's Sheath logo on the tongue. This Protro edition has a drop-in React foam midsole, tooled with a glass-based carbon fiber shank plate for stability. A herringbone-patterned, blue rubber outsole is designed for traction in all directions.

shoeName: Nike P-6000 Black
Nike Air Max 95 Premium Greedy (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Greedy' uses white rope laces through webbed eyelets to secure the mismatched mesh shoes, touched with leather and synthetic suede accents. The lace guard and molded heel panel on both shoes get a reflective silver finish, which helps in low-light conditions. The black foam midsole gets a 'Big Bubble' Max Air heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Max Volume
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Max Volume turns heads on and off the court with a high-energy palette of Hyper Pink, Mint Foam, Black, and Viotech. Designed for quick guards and explosive slashes to the rim, this men’s basketball shoe pairs a lightweight, breathable upper with supportive overlays that keep your foot locked in through hard cuts and step-backs. A plush, responsive midsole helps soften landings and spring you into your next move, while the padded collar and sculpted heel provide a secure, comfortable fit for full-court runs. Underfoot, its grippy outsole pattern is engineered to bite on fast stops and sudden changes of direction, giving you confident traction from tip-off to clutch time.

Style codes HF2793-600 / HF2794-600 and the bold "Max Volume" treatment make this Nike Ja 3 a standout addition to your rotation. Thoughtful details, like durable toe reinforcement, strategic ventilation zones, and a streamlined profile, balance performance with everyday wearability. Whether you’re chasing buckets at the park or pairing them with streetwear, the color-blocking amplifies every fit, while the performance build keeps pace with the game’s most dynamic playstyles. If you’re searching for a modern basketball sneaker that blends stability, cushioning, and unmistakable flair, the Nike Ja 3 Max Volume delivers.

Our team loves this product because it fuses fast-feel support, lively cushioning, and a statement colorway that energizes every step.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 ASG Hollywood 3D (2026) (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro GS '3D All-Star' was worn by Kobe Bryant during the 2011 NBA All-Star festivities. The micromesh upper is wrapped in a stereoscopic print tthat can be enjoyed with the help of 3D glasses. Red and aqua blue Swoosh logos take turns on the left and right side, respectively. More mismatched tones carry onto the heel counter and the Sheath logo on the tongue. This Protro edition sports a Cushlon midsole equipped with a Zoom Air forefoot unit for balanced cushioning.

Nike LeBron 24 Storm Drain

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Sound Check
description:
Nike Ja 3 Coconut Milk brings a softer, more balanced tone to Ja Morant’s high intensity signature line. The light neutral upper gives the shoe a clean and almost calm appearance, creating contrast with the aggressive energy that Ja brings to the game. It feels fresh and versatile, designed for players who want performance footwear that does not overpower the rest of their look.

The appeal of this colorway lies in its adaptability. The Coconut Milk finish highlights the Ja 3’s modern shape and detailing while keeping the focus on movement and flow. Collectors enjoy this pair because it shows the range of the Ja line, proving it can move comfortably between bold statements and refined everyday wear without losing its identity.

The Nike Ja 3 Coconut Milk was released on 10/09/2025with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 49ers Home (2026)
description: The Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 '49ers' nods to Deion Sanders' time in San Francisco. The white leather upper gets black nubuck details on the eyestay as well as the heel. A white Swoosh graces the wide adjustable strap on the midfoot. A red knit collar lining gets midfoot cutouts that showcase a metallic gold mesh underlay. The sculpted Phylon midsole pairs with encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Scream Ghostface Black
Nike Air More Uptempo 96 Black White (2023/2026)
Nike Ja 4 High Halloween
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut EYBL Volt
description: The Nike GT Cut 'EYBL - Volt Bright Crimson' honors the Elite Youth Basketball League. These shoes have a neon green mesh and knit upper tooled with a red EYBL logo on the heel tab of the right shoe. The drop-in React foam midsole couples with a parabolic Zoom Strobel and Zoom Air heel unit. The partially see-through rubber outsole keeps you surefooted on the court.

shoeName: Nike KD 6 Illusion (2026)
description: The design originally debuted in 2014 as part of the 'NOLA Gumbo League' collection to celebrate the NBA All-Star Game in New Orleans. These shoes have a black synthetic upper with multicolor, hand-drawn graphics. Bright teal logos match the glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole, while the plush Phylon midsole packs Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot and a Max Air heel unit for an all-around soft sensation underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Luxe University of Texas
Nike Ja 3 Zombie
description:
Nike Ja 3 Zombie leans all the way into playful chaos, giving Ja Morant’s signature line a colorway that feels pulled straight from late night arcade culture. The eerie green tones and slime inspired details instantly give the shoe personality, making it feel bold and animated before it ever touches the court. This design reflects Ja’s fearless energy and willingness to stand out, pushing the Ja line further into expressive storytelling.

Beyond the visuals, the Ja 3 continues to focus on speed, control, and responsiveness. The shape feels aggressive and ready to move, designed for players who thrive on quick reactions and confident drives. Collectors gravitate toward this pair because it blends performance with character, reinforcing why signature sneakers matter most when they truly mirror the athlete behind them.

The Nike Ja 3 Zombie was released on10/22/2025 with a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Draft Day Pack Mystery Sealed Box
description:
The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Draft Day Pack Mystery Sealed Box is a 2026 blind box collectible release from Nike Basketball celebrating the 30th anniversary of Kobe Bryant being drafted 13th overall in the 1996 NBA Draft, containing one of 14 possible Kobe 4 Protro colorways representing every team that was on the clock before the Los Angeles Lakers secured Kobe's rights — thirteen pairs representing the franchises that passed, plus the rare Lakers gold pair representing where his legacy was ultimately built — with the specific colorway unknown until the gold foil packaging inside the box is opened. The blind box mechanics replicate the uncertainty and anticipation of draft night itself, with each of the 13 non-Lakers colorways featuring a white upper with a wear-away layer that reveals the corresponding team's colors underneath over time, insoles printed with ping-pong lottery balls bearing each team's draft pick number, and outlined Swooshes in team-specific accent colors that provide subtle hints before the layer wears away. The odds are disclosed on SNKRS: the Lakers colorway carries just a 4% pull probability, making it the rarest possible outcome, while the Boston Celtics, Los Angeles Clippers, and Charlotte Hornets each carry a 6.3% probability, with the remaining ten teams ranging from 7.25% each — all sales are final with no returns given the randomized nature of the purchase. Released June 26, 2026 at $200 retail through Nike SNKRS on the exact 30th anniversary of the 1996 NBA Draft with blind box style code IV6585-900.

The Nike Kobe 4 Protro Draft Day Pack Mystery Sealed Box was released on June 26, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

shoeName: Nike P-6000 Triple White
Nike NOCTA Glide Drake White Chrome

A molded mini-Swoosh on the midfoot is accompanied by a jeweled NOCTA logo on the tongue. These kicks have a beefy Phylon midsole with a Zoom Air unit in the forefoot and the signature ‘bug eye’ embedded on the side.

Nike Air Max 95 Gore-Tex Big Bubble Light Bone Campfire Orange
Nike Vomero Premium SP Skeleton Black
Nike Air Max 90 Recraft Triple White

Built with mesh, the upper is overlaid by leather, finished entirely in white and complemented by the TPU eyelets and Air Max badges. A tonal midsole houses visible Max Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Cincinnati Reds (2026)
description: The Nike Air Griffey Max 1 'Cincinnati Reds' commemorates Ken Griffey Jr.'s time with the Cincinnati Reds. Stamped with the Hall of Famer's 24 jersey number, an adjustable ankle strap couples with standard laces to secure the white leather upper, touched with red nubuck overlays. A black Swoosh decorates the forefoot and heel areas. The plush foam midsole contains Max Air forefoot and heel units for all-around cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 At Dawn
description:
The Nike Ja 3 At Dawn brings a vibrant and energetic color story to Ja Morant’s signature line, reflecting his explosive style of play. The black base provides a strong foundation, while baltic blue, total orange, and hyper pink accents create a dynamic and layered look. The silhouette feels responsive and fast, designed to match the speed and creativity associated with Ja’s game.

Fans of the Ja line appreciate how each release captures a sense of movement and personality through bold color combinations. This version stands out for its contrast and energy, making it visually striking both on and off the court. It is a sneaker that blends performance intent with expressive design, continuing the momentum of the signature series.

The Nike Ja 3 At Dawn was released on March 19, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Hydrogen Blue
description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Protro 'Hydrogen Blue' has an ice blue engineered mesh upper tooled with a series of perforations along the side panels. Flywire cables are built into the shoelaces for a lockdown feel. Kobe Bryant's molded Sheath logo lands on the tongue, while multiple stitched lines are embroidered on the heel — a nod to his Achilles surgery. A drop-in React foam midsole works closely with a rubber outsole that uses a pressure map-inspired pattern for steady traction on the court.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus White
description: The Air Max Plus 'White' features an almost-monochromatic look on its classic running construction. The shoe's upper features a technical mesh build in white, with tonal TPU overlays on the iconic lacing cage. A synthetic toe guard supports the fit, while underfoot, the tooling includes visible Air in the forefoot and heel. A grey outsole with a varied tread pattern provides traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Dylan Harper Tri-State
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black delivers a sleek and performance focused look through a dark and layered color palette. The black base keeps the design clean, while subtle multi color accents add depth across the upper. Built for quick movements and responsiveness, the silhouette reflects Nike’s focus on modern basketball performance.

This pair stands out because it balances function with a sharp visual identity. The understated colorway makes it versatile, while the structure supports high level play. It appeals to athletes and collectors alike who appreciate a shoe that performs on court while still fitting into everyday rotation.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Black was released on February 26, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 270 White Black
description: Inspired by its Air Max 180 and the Air Max 93 predecessors, the Air Max 270 is defined by a transparent Air unit that wraps 270 degrees around the heel. This ‘White’ colorway, released in March 2018, features a white mesh upper, accented by gray heel pull tabs and Swoosh logos. Completing the look is an asymmetrical lacing unit and rubber outsole, also dressed in white.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 Low Protro Orange Frost Brilliant Orange Summit White Ice Peach
description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low EM Protro 'WNBA' celebrates the women's basketball league with a gradient orange finish decorating the knit upper, which features a soft collar and Flywire cables to secure it. Nine embroidered details nod to Kobe Bryant's legacy. This Protro version gets a React foam midsole for a responsive feel on the court.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Grey Fog Chrome
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Grey Fog Chrome' presents a cream-colored Cushlon midsole tooled with Zoom Air forefoot and heel units. The upper consists of a matching open-cell mesh hit with pale grey leather overlays touched with reflective silver details. The Swoosh and eyestay are done up in a chrome finish, matching the synthetic overlays framing the toe box.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Recraft Triple Black
description: Relesing for the 30th anniversary of the silhouette, the Air Max 90 'Triple Black' emerges with a blacked-out look. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of mesh and leather, with the tonal look continuing onto the TPU badges and eyelets. Underfoot, the midsole houses the usual visible Max Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Pearl (2025)
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Pearl' rolls out a pearlescent white Foamposite upper comprised of liquid plastic poured into a mold. A black inner bootie matches the nubuck eyestay, and the large molded Swoosh on the side panel. A full-length Zoom Air unit pairs with a Zoom Air heel unit and a carbon fiber spring plate for midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme Black
description: The Supreme x Air Force 1 Mid 'Box Logo - Triple Black' has an adjustable ankle strap securing the black leather upper. A perforated toe box and a padded collar lined in DURAPLUSH accent the look. Supreme's box logo appears on the heel, while both brand logos appear on the tongue tag and lace jewel. A black rubber cupsole completes the look.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 97 Triple White Wolf Grey
description: The Nike Air Max 97 'Triple White' strips the classic silhouette of all color, allowing the sneaker’s full-length visible Max Air unit to come to the fore. The upper, inspired by the look of radiating lines created by a water drop in a pond, is built with a traditional blend of mesh and leather. The quarter panel lets in the only hit of contrasting color, arriving on an embroidered mini Swoosh in Wolf Grey.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Home
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Lakers Home' rolls out a white engineered mesh upper accented with a purple embroidered Swoosh and a gold Kobe Bryant sheath logo on the tongue and heel. The heel counter helps keep the ankle locked down, while a drop-in React foam midsole makes every step soft and comfortable. An exposed carbon fiber shank plate provides stability, while a herringbone-patterned rubber outsole brings smooth traction.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Photon Dust Pink Foam (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Photon Dust Pink Foam' uses multiple shades of pink on a full-length Cushlon foam midsole, which equips Zoom Air forefoot and heel units. The white, open-cell mesh upper gets a metallic silver Swoosh, 3M accents and mirror-reflective details on the eyestay and forefoot for an eye-catching look.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Venice Beach (2024)
description: Celebrating Southern California beach vibes, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro ‘Venice Beach’ 2024 brings hits of red, teal and yellow into a seamless Engineered Mesh upper. A turquoise heel counter featuring Kobe's signature and an orange knit collar lining give these shoes additional color pops. A drop-in React foam midsole provides cushioning while a carbon fiber shank plate promotes midfoot stability. A see-through rubber outsole has a herringbone traction pattern for optimal traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Bakin Varsity Royal (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Bakin 'Varsity Royal' uses white rope laces to secure the black mesh upper with royal blue nubuck overlays and a black synthetic mudguard. 'Nike Air' is embroidered on the tongue and heel, while a white Swoosh decorates the collar and Phylon midsole, which has an encapsulated Air-Sole forefoot unit and a Max Air heel unit. The rubber outsole gets a herringbone pattern for steady traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 What The (Women's)
colorway: Igloo/Hot Lava/Blue Crystal/Light Atomic Pink/Dynamic Turquoise/Hyper Pink
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 What The Womens pushes color and storytelling to the forefront, combining multiple hues into a single and highly expressive design. Igloo, Hot Lava, Blue Crystal, and Hyper Pink come together in a layered palette that feels energetic and unpredictable. The silhouette remains performance focused, built to support Sabrina Ionescu’s style of play.

This pair stands out because it embraces the What The concept fully, blending contrasting elements into one cohesive look. Fans appreciate how it reflects personality and creativity while still delivering on court performance. It is a bold and dynamic release that appeals to collectors who enjoy sneakers that break from convention.

The Nike Sabrina 3 What The Womens was released on April 1, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Sound Check (GS)
Nike Air Foamposite One Stranger Things
description: The Stranger Things x Nike Air Foamposite One Premium QS 'Black Bright Crimson' celebrates the last season of the hit Netflix show. A red and black graphic print engulfs the molded Foamposite upper, a nod to the nightmarish vision of Vecna's lair. Frayed shoelaces add a touch of style, along with cracked black synthetic leather on the eyestay and collar. Penny Hardaway's inverted 1 Cent logo decorates the heel tab. The partially see-through red rubber outsole gets a a herringbone pattern for steady traction. The carbon fiber shank plate brings midfoot stability with every step.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 SP Vast Grey
Nike Kobe 8 Protro Lakers Away
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Lakers Away' rocks a black engineered mesh upper with matching no-sew overlays and a gold embroidered Swoosh. shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite Pro Red October (2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Gym Red' stays loyal to the 2015 release, presenting a red Foamposite upper macthed with the molded Swoosh on the side.
