The partially see-through rubber outsole gets herringbone traction pods and an exposed carbon fiber shank for stability.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Galaxy (2025)
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Air Foamposite One 'Galaxy' originally released during NBA All-Star Weekend in 2012. These shoes have a nebular design, using blue and purple throughout the molded Foamposite upper. Black nubuck stars on the collar and eyestay, touched with an embroidered mini-Swoosh on the forefoot. A glow-in-the-dark, see-through rubber outsole keeps every step true.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Let Me Be Ja
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Let Me Be Ja reflects Ja Morant’s fearless and expressive playing style through a colorway that feels bold and unapologetic. The Tour Yellow base brings energy and visibility, while University Red and Black accents add contrast that highlights the shoe’s structure. The Ja 3 continues to build on Morant’s growing signature line, focusing on performance while also delivering a strong visual identity that resonates with younger basketball fans.

Fans gravitate toward Ja Morant’s sneakers because they represent a new generation of athletes shaping the game both on and off the court. The Let Me Be Ja theme emphasizes individuality and confidence, aligning with Morant’s personality and style of play. Bright color palettes like this help the shoe stand out during gameplay while also making it appealing for casual wear. Basketball sneakers continue to play a major role in both performance and streetwear culture. For collectors, releases like this mark the progression of a rising signature line that continues gaining influence within the sneaker world.

The Nike Ja 3 Let Me Be Ja was released on May 12, 2026 with a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Black Multi
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Black Multi brings rising basketball star Dylan Harper's personal influence into Nike's cutting edge GT Cut Titan platform, combining black, metallic silver, cashmere, laser orange, and safety orange into a genuinely vibrant, multi tone palette. Harper has emerged as one of basketball's most exciting young prospects, and this signature colorway collaboration gives collectors a genuine piece of his rising basketball identity. The GT Cut Titan line represents Nike's most advanced basketball performance technology, built for elite level agility and responsiveness.

Dylan Harper's emergence as a top basketball prospect has generated significant excitement within both basketball and sneaker collecting circles, making any signature colorway collaboration tied to his name a genuine draw for collectors following his rising career. The multi tone orange and silver combination gives this shoe striking visual energy befitting an emerging star's personal brand identity. Fans of both cutting edge basketball performance technology and rising young talent find this Titan collaboration a compelling way to engage with basketball's next generation of stars.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Titan x Dylan Harper Black Multi was released on August 6, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Caitlin Clark Light Armory Blue
description: The Caitlin Clark x Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro 'Light Armory Blue' brings a white Cushlon midsole with a large Zoom Air forefoot unit. A nod to Kobe Bryant's 'Black Mamba' persona, these shoes sport a micromesh upper with scaly-textured 'islands' using multiple shades of light blue. The Swoosh decorates the side panel, while Bryant's shield logo graces the tongue area.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Triple White (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Triple White' rolls out a whiteout mesh upper tooled with synthetic leather overlays, a midfoot cage, and a heel counter. Reflective details allow for better visibility on the toe, midfoot, heel, and tongue areas. The Nike logo has the face of Nike co-founder Bill Bowerman. These kicks ride on a Cushlon midsole that packs Zoom Air forefoot and heel units.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Lunar New Year
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Lunar New Year Year of the Horse celebrates speed, strength, and momentum through a colorway rooted in cultural symbolism and Ja Morant’s explosive style of play. The Ja 3 silhouette already thrives on motion, and the Year of the Horse theme fits naturally, using rich light chocolate tones with metallic gold accents to suggest power and endurance. The design feels intentional and grounded, blending heritage inspiration with modern performance aesthetics in a way that feels respectful rather than surface level.

Fans love this release because it connects storytelling and performance seamlessly. Lunar New Year colorways often carry deeper meaning, and this one aligns perfectly with Ja’s relentless energy and forward drive. Collectors appreciate how the Ja line continues to expand globally, using color and theme to add emotional weight without compromising the shoe’s sharp, fast on court identity. It stands out as a celebratory release that feels purposeful, symbolic, and built for impact.

The Nike Ja 3 Lunar New Year Year of the Horse was released on January 16, 2026 with a retail price of $145.

shoeName: Nike SB Air Force 1 Low Yuto Horigome White Iron Grey
description: The Yuto Horigome x Nike SB Air Force 1 Low 'White Iron Grey' rolls out a light grey leather upper with a matching mesh side panel. A darker grey Swoosh adorns the side, matching the collar lining. Yuto's name joins the Nike SB logo on the tongue tag, while his cross-feather logo is embossed on the heel. Yuto's lucky number 7 is stamped on the heel tab. The rubber cupsole contains an inner foam wedge with an encapsulated Air-Sole heel unit.

shoeName: Nike KD 6 Brazil (2026)
description: The Nike KD 6 'Brazil' brings a black synthetic upper with a speckled multicolor Swoosh piped in a bright green trim. That same color appears on the collar lining as well as the rubber outsole. The plush Phylon midsole equips a responsive Zoom Air forefoot unit and an exposed Air-Sole heel unit for balanced cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Ja 4 Nightmare
description:
The Nike Ja 4 Nightmare brings an intense, unsettling concept into Ja Morant's signature basketball line, combining obsidian, multi color, black, voltage green, and metallic silver into a genuinely dramatic, high energy palette. The Nightmare naming suggests a design concept built around intimidation and overwhelming presence, fitting for Morant's explosive, highlight reel style of play that often leaves defenders genuinely unsettled. This fourth generation model continues the line's tradition of bold, personality driven colorway storytelling.

Ja Morant has established himself as one of the most electrifying and must watch players in the league, and this Nightmare themed colorway captures that same intense, overwhelming energy he brings to opposing defenses. The multi tone palette combining dark obsidian with vibrant voltage green creates genuine visual drama befitting the Nightmare concept. Collectors who follow Morant's rising star power and appreciate conceptually driven signature colorways find this Ja 4 release a compelling way to engage with his continued signature shoe evolution.

The Nike Ja 4 Nightmare was released on August 13, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low White Black
description: The Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'White Black' rolls out a white leather upper contrasted by a black Swoosh and a Nike-branded heel tab. The Zoom Air unit is embedded in the insoles for responsive cushioning. The rubber cupsole undergirds the design.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 TB White Gorge Green
NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Demerits (Women's)
Nike Vomero Premium Off-White Grey Fog Dark Obsidian
Nike Air Force 1 Mid Supreme White
description: The Supreme x Nike Air Force 1 Mid 'Box Logo - Triple White' dons a white leather upper with perforated details on the toe box and a padded collar lined in DURAPLUSH. A red box logo lands on the heel, while both brand logos combine on the tongue and lace fastener. These shoes have a white rubber cupsole containing an encapsulated Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low QS Terror Squad White University Red
description: The Terror Squad x Nike Air Force 1 Low QS 'University Red' was first worn by rapper Fat Joe during the 2023 BET Hip-Hop Awards. These kicks bring a crisp white leather upper tooled with red overlays and a matching Swoosh. The Terror Squad emblem adorns the heel, while the back tab showcases a 'JC' signoff that nods to 'Joey Crack' — one of Fat Joe's numerous aliases.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Light Show
description:
Light up every cut, burst, and fast break in the Nike Ja 3 Light Show, a high-energy take on Ja Morant’s third signature shoe. Wrapped in a crisp White base with electric hits of Dusty Cactus, Hyper Pink, and Star Blue, this colorway turns heads on court and off. A breathable, reinforced upper provides lightweight containment through hard plants and sudden changes of direction, while a padded collar and sculpted heel keep you centered over your foot. Underfoot, a lively midsole gives you a springy, close-to-the-court feel for quick first steps and confident landings, and the durable outsole pattern is engineered to bite on hardwood for stop-on-a-dime traction when the game speeds up.

Designed for players who thrive in the open floor, the Nike Ja 3 Light Show balances support and agility to help you stay explosive for four quarters. Dynamic lacing helps lock you in without pressure points, and strategic overlays add structure where you need it most. The bold palette pairs seamlessly with team uniforms and streetwear fits alike, and the included Blue Laces let you dial in your look with a custom touch. Finished with signature details and style code HF2794-100/HF2793-100, it’s a performance-first basketball sneaker that delivers the confidence to attack every angle and finish through contact.

Our team loves this product because it blends quick-response cushioning, trustworthy traction, and striking color pops to elevate both your game and your style.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB Purple Dynasty
description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro TB 'Purple Dynasty' rocks a black engineered mesh upper coupled with a purple knit collar for a comfortable feel. While Flywire cables are built into the lacing system for more lockdown. Kobe Bryant's Sheath logo decorates the tongue, while a drop-in React foam midsole pairs with a rubber outsole that uses a traction pattern based on a pressure map of his foot.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Cough Drop (2025)
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Air Foamposite One 'Cough Drop' carries a black Foamposite upper made with liquid plastic poured into a mold. Black nubuck lands on the eyestay, stamped with a red embroidered mini-Swoosh on the side. Penny Hardaway's 1 Cent logo decorates the tongue and heel. The matte red rubber outsole partners with an exposed carbon fiber shank plate to keep the midfoot stable.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold (Women's)
description:
Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens captures Sabrina Ionescu’s calm and calculated dominance through a colorway that feels sharp and composed. Ice Cold reflects her ability to control the game under pressure, pairing a clean visual identity with a silhouette built for precision and confidence. It feels modern and focused, mirroring Sabrina’s leadership and poise on the court.

Collectors appreciate this release because the Sabrina line has quickly become known for authenticity and intent. The Ice Cold execution reinforces that reputation, showing how performance footwear can carry personality without excess. It appeals to fans who value clarity, control, and a connection between athlete and design rather than loud expression.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Ice Cold Womens was released on 10/01/2025with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 270 Black White
Nike Kobe 6 Total Orange (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 GS 'Total Orange' sports a micromesh upper wrapped in 'islands' that recreate a reptilian texture that plays off Kobe Bryant's 'Black Mamba' persona. A metallic silver molded sheath logo adorns the tongue, matching the printed Swoosh decorating the side panel. These shoes have a matching orange Cushlon midsole bolstered with a Zoom Air forefoot unit.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White (Women's)
description:
The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White silhouette (W) continues the tradition of the 1982 Air Force 1. The sneaker features an all-white leather upper with a perforated toe box and Swoosh overlays. A Nike heel embroidery and white sole completes the design.

The women's Nike Air Force 1 Low White 2018 (W) released in January 2018 and retailed for $90. The retail price was increased to $115 in 2023.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 White Black Pebbled Leather
description: The Air Force 1 '07 'White Black' brings a classic two-tone look to its signature basketball construction. The shoe's upper is built with tumbled leather, finished in white and contrasted by black on the Swoosh branding, heel patch and tongue tag. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while underfoot, the midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning. A concentric rubber outsole is included for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon (2026) (Women's)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Women's Air Max 95 OG 'Big Bubble - Neon' dons neon webbed eyelets to secure the upper, complemented with wavy synthetic suede side panels. The Nike Air logo adorns the molded heel panel, engulfed in a 3M reflective coating for better visibility. The black foam midsole gets neon Max Air forefoot and heel units for a responsive ride.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro What The (2025)
description: The 2025 edition of the Nike Kobe 9 Elite Protro 'What The Kobe' takes inspiration from past Kobe 9 colorways, featuring a white single-layer Flyknit upper with multicolor threads woven into the vamp and side panels. Eye-catching colors land on the collar lining and heel, which include embroidered details symbolizing Kobe Bryant's Achilles' heel sutures. A drop-in Nike React insole keeps the plush feel, while a carbon fiber heel counter brings lateral stability.

shoeName: Nike Shox TL Black Max Orange (Women's)
Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl
colorway: Soft Pearl/Pure Platinum/Wolf Grey/Metallic Silver/Summit White
description:
The Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl delivers a refined and almost understated take on Durant’s latest signature model. Soft Pearl sets a smooth base, complemented by Pure Platinum, Wolf Grey, Metallic Silver, and Summit White for a clean and layered neutral palette. The sculpted upper and low cut profile emphasize speed and control, keeping the silhouette sleek and ready for high level play.

This colorway stands out because of its restraint. Instead of bold contrast, it leans into subtle tonal shifts that highlight the shoe’s structure and detailing. Fans who appreciate minimalist performance footwear will gravitate toward this version, as it blends premium feeling hues with the responsive setup that defines the KD line’s modern evolution.

The Nike KD 18 Soft Pearl was released on May 1, 2025 with a retail price of $150.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 Pink Oxford (Women's)
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 Pink Oxford Womens brings a vibrant, feminine palette to WNBA star Sabrina Ionescu's third signature basketball model, combining pink oxford, red stardust, enamel green, and coconut milk into a genuinely eye catching, multi tone presentation. Ionescu's sharpshooting, dynamic playing style continues to be reflected through considered performance construction suited for her precise, high scoring game. This colorful combination gives the shoe genuine standout presence within the broader basketball sneaker landscape.

Sabrina Ionescu has established herself as one of women's basketball's most electrifying and skilled players, and her signature shoe line continues to reflect that same polished, precise approach through vibrant, confident colorway choices. The pink oxford and red stardust combination gives this release genuine visual energy, distinguishing it from more subdued team based colorways. Fans of Ionescu's rising signature shoe legacy and the growing recognition of WNBA athletes within sneaker culture find this Sabrina 3 release a compelling addition to their collection.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Pink Oxford Womens was released on January 28, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Retro White Black Panda (GS)
description: The Dunk Low GS 'Black White' brings a classic two-tone colorway to the basketball classic. A grade-school iteration of the shoe, the upper appears in a mix of black and white on its leather construction, with a lightly padded tongue for support. Underfoot, a white low-profile midsole gives way to a concentric black rubber outsole, which takes its traction pattern from the Air Jordan 1.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Reverse Duck Camo
description: The 2024 edition of the Nike Air Max 90 SP 'Reverse Duck Camo' flips the look of the original 'Duck Camo' Atmos collaboration from 2013. A black lizard-textured Swoosh graces the upper, made from an Infrared mesh with duck camo leather accents on the midfoot overlay and mudguard. A foam midsole contains an exposed Air-sole heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Correlate Black White Grey
Nike 24.7 Cream Phantom Sail
Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Mystic Navy Grape Ice
description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low QS 'Mystic Navy' gets a glossy patent leather upper complemented with a purple Swoosh and a matching heel tab. The Nike Air logo lands on the tongue tag, heel tab, and the neon green insoles, which match the shoelaces. The cupsole has matching navy sidewalls and a green, partially see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Psychic Blue
description: The Nike Air Foamposite One 'Psychic Blue' rocks a concealed foam midsole with a full-length Zoom Air unit and a secondary Zoom Air heel unit. A see-through rubber outsole makes way for a carbon fiber shank plate for stability. A blue molded Foamposite upper gets contrasting black accents on the mesh tongue and nubuck eyestay, including a matching mini-Swoosh embroidered on the forefoot.

shoeName: Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Triple Black
description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 'Triple Black' has a sculpted heel that delivers a secure feel, while a spacious toe box keeps your feet comfortable regardless of their width. Round vents throughout the vamp allow for more breathability. The ReactX foam midsole delivers a plush feel, while the rubber outsole uses a radial pattern for traction in every direction.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver
colorway: Summit White/Light Smoke Grey/Smoke Grey/Metallic Silver
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Summit White Metallic Silver' is comprised of a cream-colored mesh upper complemented with pale grey and silver synthetic leather overlays. A silver Swoosh joins a series of reflective details on the forefoot and heel, which bring better visibility in low-light conditions. The Cushlon midsole contains Zoom Air cushioning underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Killshot 2 LTR PRM Tiempo Pack Black
Nike Air Max 95 SB Eric Koston Obsidian Speed Yellow
description: The Eric Koston x Nike SB x Nike Air Max 95 'Obsidian Speed Yellow' has a foam midsole is bolstered with yellow Air-sole units and undergirded with a revamped rubber outsole that uses a herringbone traction pattern for better board feel. shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Uncle Phil
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Uncle Phil channels basketball energy and nostalgic television culture through a playful and highly personal colorway tied to Ja Morant’s signature line. Inspired by the legendary Uncle Phil character from The Fresh Prince of Bel Air, the release embraces bold color combinations and expressive styling that reflect both basketball swagger and 1990s pop culture nostalgia. The mix of Blue Chill, Fire Red, Citron, and Blue Legend creates a loud and energetic palette that feels perfectly aligned with Ja Morant’s explosive playing style and fearless personality on the court.

Fans gravitate toward storytelling driven signature sneakers because they allow athletes to express personality and cultural influences beyond basketball alone. The Uncle Phil inspiration immediately resonates with audiences familiar with classic television and the oversized colorful fashion associated with the era. Collectors especially appreciate how the Ja line consistently experiments with vibrant palettes and emotionally driven concepts rather than relying solely on performance focused minimalism. The result feels fun, expressive, and deeply connected to both Ja Morant’s individuality and the playful spirit of 1990s basketball and entertainment culture.

The Nike Ja 3 Uncle Phil was released on May 4, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro Kobe Bryant Dodgers
description: The Kobe Bryant x Nike Air Force 1 Low Protro 'Dodgers' uses bicolor rope laces to secure the grey leather upper, which has red baseball-inspired stitching on the side panel and Kobe Bryant's jersey number '8' on the heel. Kobe Bryant's Sheath logo lands on the tongue tag, while his signature is embossed on the midsole. This Protro edition gets a plush drop-in ReactX foam midsole for a plush feel. The blue, partially see-through rubber outsole keeps you surefooted with every step.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gold Medal (2024)
description: Bringing back a 2009 colorway, the Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro 'Gold Medal' 2024 nods to Kobe Bryant's success with Team USA during the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing. White synthetic midfoot panels comprise the upper, wrapped in Flywire cables and stamped with the signature Swoosh. Metallic gold accents hit the collar, toe box and forefoot and heel counter. A lightweight Phylon midsole pairs with a Zoom Air heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 4 Protro Gift of Mamba
description: With a textured snakeskin pattern on the collar, forefoot overlay, and Swoosh, the Nike Zoom Kobe 4 Protro 'Gift of Mamba' showcases a black nubuck upper with Kobe's signature in yellow on the lateral-side TPU heel counter. A coordinating black Phylon midsole is equipped with a Zoom Air unit in the forefoot for optimal responsiveness on the basketball court.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 3 Low Protro FC Barcelona
Nike SB Dunk Low Dashawn Jordan Copperhead
description: The Dashawn Jordan x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Copperhead' nods to the skater's home state of Arizona. Using elements from the Arizona Diamondbacks uniforms, these shoes have a black suede upper with snakeskin-print forefoot and heel overlays. Purple knit lines the collar, contrasted by a teal leather back tab embroidered with the Nike logo. Dashawn Jordan's logo decorates the insoles, which houses Zoom Air heel unit, while the black rubber cupsole completes the look.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Patent Camo Pink
Nike Free Metcon 5 Black Anthracite (Women's)
Nike Air Griffey Max 1 White Fresh Water Black
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Griffey Max 1 'Freshwater' rolls out a white synthetic leather upper with contrasting black nubuck overlays. Ken Griffey Jr's jersey number lands on the adjustable ankle strap, while teal webbed tongue and heel pull tabs nod to the Seattle Mariners' colors. A foam midsole below contains Max Air forefoot and heel units for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Bluetile Skateboards
description: The Bluetile x Nike SB Dunk 'Black Marina White' nods to the monarch butterfly from the South Carolina skate shop. Fuzzy laces secure the upper, which have a shimmery blue leather upper with coated black suede forefoot and heel overlays. The latter is de-stitched and gets butterfly wing graphics printed on the inside. A subtle hexagon print wraps the teal Swoosh, which is raised to mirror the look of butterfly eyes. Orange embroidery lands on the heel tab, stamped with 'Blue' and 'Tile' on the left and right shoes. The see-through rubber outsole sports a blue and orange gradient as a nod to the setting sun.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite Pro College Football Pack FSU
Nike Dunk Low Protro Kobe Bryant Mamba Eterno
Nike Sabrina 3 Infinite
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 Infinite brings a soft, sophisticated palette into WNBA star Sabrina Ionescu's third signature basketball model, combining white, dusty purple, football grey, bleached lilac, barely green, and alabaster into a genuinely delicate, multi tone presentation. The Infinite naming suggests themes of limitless potential and endless possibility, fitting for a player whose skill set continues to expand and evolve. Ionescu's sharpshooting, dynamic playing style continues to be reflected through considered performance construction suited for her precise, high scoring game.

Sabrina Ionescu has established herself as one of women's basketball's most electrifying and skilled players, and this Infinite concept gives her signature line genuine aspirational depth beyond a standard team colorway. The soft, pastel toned palette gives this release a distinctly gentle, sophisticated quality compared to bolder basketball sneaker executions. Fans of Ionescu's rising signature shoe legacy and the growing recognition of WNBA athletes within sneaker culture find this Infinite release a compelling, conceptually rich addition to their collection.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Infinite was released on May 18, 2026 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Caitlin 1 Purple Venom (Women's)
Nike Air Force 1 Low '01 NYC Knicks
Nike KD 4 NERF (2024)
description: The 2024 version of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Nerf' brings back a sought-after Kevin Durant colorway. Loyal to the details from the 2011 release, these shoes have a synthetic upper with translucent mesh side panels and a wide midfoot strap that includes a paint splatter graphic and a large red Swoosh. Grey accents hit the heel and tongue, stamped with the Nerf and KD35 logos. Multicolor details land on the Phylon midsole, equipped with a Zoom Air forefoot unit, and anchored by a red rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 Triple Black
description: The Nike Air Max 2 CB 94 'Triple Black' delivers an entirely black sneaker made from a mix of leather and nubuck. Dark grey stitched Nike branding appears on the side, with small holes that reveal a silver mesh underneath. A black foam midsole with a visible Max Air unit in the heel provides support underfoot, and the shoe has a quick lacing system and a webbed pull tab on the back heel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Drift Black Dusty Cactus
description: The Nike Air Max 90 Drift 'Black Dusty Cactus' rocks a blackout ripstop upper with rubberized details on the midfoot overlay as well as the mudguard. A bright teal Nike tongue tag matches the Nike Air logo on the heel patch. A matching black foam midsole contains an Air-Sole heel unit for all-around cushioning

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Protro Mambacita
description: The Nike Kobe 9 EM Protro 'Mambacita' pays tribute to Gigi Bryant. The engineered mesh upper features a grey and black fade with a metallic gold Swoosh. Gold accents the 'Gigi' callout on the back heel, as well as a Kobe sheath logo on the tongue. Flywire cables are built into the lacing system for a lockdown feel. These shoes have a marbled midsole that houses a drop-in React foam midsole, replacing the Lunarlon cushioning from the OG.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Snowed In
description:
The Nike Ja 3 Snowed In captures holiday energy through a colorway that feels festive without turning gimmicky. Clean white tones form the base, while bright crimson and volt accents add contrast that feels playful and bold. The Ja 3 silhouette remains sharp and reactive, letting the seasonal theme live through color rather than altering the shoe’s core identity or performance focus.

Fans enjoy this pair because it balances fun and function so naturally. The Snowed In concept gives the shoe personality and timing, but it still feels like a serious basketball sneaker built for speed and control. Collectors appreciate seasonal Ja releases because they show how the signature line can flex creatively while staying true to Morant’s relentless style of play, making this one memorable without feeling disposable.

The Nike Ja 3 Snowed In was released on December 26, 2025 with a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Futura Laboratories Bleached Aqua
description: The Futura Laboratories x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Bleached Aqua' showcases a teal suede Swoosh contrasting the white canvas upper, bolstered with multicolor canvas overlays wrapped in Futura's abstract graphics. The artist's signature makes its way to the lateral side, while the FL logo adorns the other side. Both brand logos appear on the stuffed tongue tag, while a blue translucent rubber outsole keeps the traction smooth underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '01 Triple White
Nike Caitlin 1 Midnight Fever (GS)
Nike Air Force 1 Low Flax Wheat
Nike KD 19 Field Purple
description:
The Nike KD 19 Field Purple, nicknamed Purple Stuff, is one of the launch colorways of Kevin Durant's nineteenth Nike signature shoe, applying an almost fully monochromatic Field Purple execution to the KD 19's Y2K-inspired upper with Stadium Green insoles and University Gold in the official color specification, covering the molded TPU shell, mesh underlay, laces, tongue, liner, midsole, and outsole in a single saturated purple tone that lets the shoe's silhouette speak for itself. The KD 19 draws direct design inspiration from the Nike Zoom Hyperflight, the early-2000s Nike Basketball silhouette, with a two-piece injected TPU upper wrapping an internal mesh construction in a way that references the patent leather-adjacent, tech-forward aesthetics of Nike Basketball's Y2K era, while the Field Purple colorway specifically echoes Jason Williams' Sacramento Kings-era Hyperflight PE as an additional archival reference layered into the release. Cushioning is handled by a full-length Air Zoom Strobel unit paired with a Cushlon 3.0 foam carrier for responsive, court-level performance, with a midfoot shank providing stability and the outsole traction incorporating Durant's jersey numbers 35 and 7 as a personal identifier embedded into the shoe's functional geometry.

Released June 17, 2026 at $155 retail via Nike SNKRS, Foot Locker, and select Nike Basketball retailers with style code IH1117-500.

The Nike KD 19 Field Purple was released on June 17, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro Halo
description: The Nike Kobe 9 Elite Low Protro 'Halo' brings back Kobe Bryant's ninth signature model. These shoes have a white Flyknit upper with a low-cut collar and matching no-sew overlays. Flywire technology keeps the midfoot in place, while a carbon fiber heel counter promotes stability. A lightweight foam midsole maintains the monochromatic design.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Court Purple
description: The Kobe Bryant x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Court Purple' rocks a violet leather upper, wrapped in a matching snakeskin print as well as Bryant's Sheath logo on the tongue. His jersey numbers — 8 and 24 — take turns, embroidered on each heel tab. The rubber cupsole maintains the monochromatic design.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Wolf Grey
description: Made with a grey engineered mesh upper, the Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Wolf Grey' gets a padded collar and a heel counter to aid ankle balance. A white embroidered Swoosh adorns the side panel, while Kobe Bryant's sheath logo graces the tongue and heel. A drop-in React foam midsole replaces the Lunarlon midsole from the original Kobe 8. A herringbone-pattern rubber outsole exposes a carbon fiber shank plate for stability.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple Black
Nike Ja 3 NY vs. NY
description: The Nike Ja 3 'NY vs. NY' nods to the tournament highlighting New York's best high school basketball talent. These shoes have a black mesh upper with matching monogram logo overlays. The side has a vertical metallic gold Swoosh and a red graffiti-style 'A.' The NY vs. NY emblem is showcased on the tongue tag to highlight the signature look. These sneakers have a black rubber cupsole packed with a full-length ZoomX foam unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 What The (GS)
colorway: Igloo/Hot Lava/Blue Crystal/Light Atomic Pink/Dynamic Turquoise/Hyper Pink

shoeName: Nike Air Max 2 CB '94 Black Varsity Royal
Nike Ja 3 TB Triple White
Nike KD 19 Aunt Pearl
Nike Air Force 1 Low Drake NOCTA Certified Lover Boy
description: Drake-inspired details imbue the NOCTA x Nike Air Force 1 Low ‘Certified Lover Boy’, an understated version of the unmistakable white-on-white AF1 colorway. Asymetric NOCTA and Nike Air branding on each heel tab ornament the white tumbled leather upper, with a nod to heritage details with a perforated toe box, variable width lacing and a low-cut padded collar. Drake's final wink is ‘Love You Forever’ inscribed in embossed lettering across the lateral sidewall of its white midsole, giving this classic a 2022 twist

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Carbon Fiber
description: The Nike Air Foamposite One 'Carbon Fiber' has a black Foamposite upper finished in a faux carbon fiber print. A black synthetic nubuck eyestay matches the collar, while Penny Hardaway's 1 Cent logo graces the tongue and heel tab. A hidden foam midsole equips a full-length Zoom Air unit and an additional Zoom Air heel unit. The partially see-through rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction and an exposed carbon fiber spring plate underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite Pro College Football Pack LSU
Nike Air Foamposite One Deep Royal
description: The Nike Air Foamposite One 'Deep Royal' differs from the 1997 original release, using a darker blue matte finish on the molded Foamposite upper. Black synthetic nubuck accents on the eyestay and collar bolster the bold look. A smaller Swoosh is embroidered on the forefoot, along with Penny Hardaway's 1 Cent logo on the tongue badge and heel tab. The foam midsole contains a full-length Zoom Air unit and an additional one stacked under the heel, undergirded by a carbon fiber spring plate for midfoot stability. These shoes have a partially see-through rubber outsole made for swift traction on the court.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Halo
description: Presenting the Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Halo,' also known as the 'Triple White,' a reimagined iteration of Kobe Bryant's eighth signature shoe in a clean, pristine colorway. This low-top sneaker is designed by Eric Avar and features an all-white engineered mesh upper, intersected by Swoosh branding in a matching white tone. Paying homage to Kobe Bryant, his personal logo adorns the tongue while the external heel counter is inscribed with his signature. Performance-wise, the shoe offers exceptional features such as a drop-in React midsole and a carbon fiber shank atop an outsole with herringbone-patterned tread.

shoeName: Nike KD 19 Blueberry Blast
description:
The Nike KD 19 Blueberry Blast brings a vibrant, fruit inspired concept into Kevin Durant's latest signature basketball model, combining still blue and stadium green into a genuinely energetic, high contrast palette. This Blueberry Blast naming suggests a fresh, playful concept tied to fruit imagery, giving the shoe a distinctly different personality compared to more standard team colorway releases. The KD line continues its tradition of combining Durant's smooth, versatile scoring ability with genuinely innovative performance construction.

Kevin Durant's signature line has remained one of basketball's most respected and consistently well received franchises, and playful, fruit inspired naming conventions like Blueberry Blast give collectors fresh, fun ways to engage with each new colorway release. The still blue and stadium green combination offers genuine visual energy, distinguishing this KD 19 from more subdued team based releases. Fans of Durant's legendary scoring legacy and signature shoe evolution find this Blueberry Blast execution a compelling, playful addition to their KD collection.

The Nike KD 19 Blueberry Blast was released on July 29, 2026 with a retail price of $155.

shoeName: Nike Vomero Plus Orange Pulse
colorway: Orange Pulse/Black/Hot Lava/Total Orange/Orange Chalk/Metallic Dark Grey
description: The Nike Vomero Plus 'Orange Pulse' gets an orange engineered mesh upper complemented by a metallic grey Swoosh. Reflective accents on the forefoot and tongue enhance nighttime visibility. Fiery orange pops land on the full-length ZoomX foam midsole, made with a high-stack profile and a rocker shape for a natural stride.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus 7 Black
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins captures the fearless energy of one of the brightest rising stars in basketball. Coconut Milk lays a smooth base across the upper, while Amarillo accents inject bold contrast and Chrome detailing adds a sleek finish. The low cut silhouette stays quick and agile, built for sharp changes of direction and explosive play.

The GT Cut line has become a favorite among hoopers who prioritize responsiveness and court feel, and tying it to JuJu Watkins feels like a natural fit. Her game is dynamic and confident, and this colorway reflects that same attitude without overcomplicating the design. For fans who follow the next generation of talent, this release blends performance innovation with star power in a way that feels authentic.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo JuJu Watkins was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Metallic Rose Gold Dylan Harper PE
Nike Air Zoom Huarache 2K4 Penny Hardaway Knicks
Nike Dunk SB Low Krampus
description: The Nike Dunk Low SB 'Krampus' uses ideas from the central European figure who punishes misbehaving children during the Christmas season. The grey leather upper is contrasted by subtle glowing orange pops along the raw edges of the overlays, Swoosh and Nike-branded back tab. The inside of the tongue showcases a 'Not Surprised' label, while holiday-themed graphics engulf the insoles. The crackle theme carries onto the midsole, anchored by an orange, partially see-through rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 23 Masked Menace
description:
The Nike LeBron 23 Masked Menace leans into a darker and more aggressive aesthetic, using an all black palette to create a bold and imposing presence. The layered construction and performance driven design reflect LeBron’s power and versatility on the court, while the monochromatic execution keeps the focus on shape and structure. It feels strong, controlled, and intentional.

Fans of LeBron’s signature line appreciate releases that capture his dominance through design, and this pair reflects that clearly. The Masked Menace theme adds a layer of attitude, reinforcing the shoe’s identity beyond just performance. It is a sneaker that combines presence and purpose, appealing to collectors who value both impact and legacy.

The Nike LeBron 23 Masked Menace was released on March 24, 2026 with a retail price of $200.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Laser Orange Indigo Burst
colorway: Laser Orange/Indigo Burst/Citron Pulse/Volt Ice/Vivid Purple/Sapphire
description: Made for marathons and half-marathons, the Nike Alphafly NEXT% 3 'Laser Orange' uses an orange and yellow gradient on the Atomknit upper, secured with notched shoelaces and a built-in knit tongue with lofted padding for a comfortable feel. A large Swoosh dips into part of the high-stacked ZoomX foam midsole, which packs a full-length carbon fiber plate for a propulsive feel and a smooth transition. A Zoom Air forefoot unit brings a plush, cushioned feel.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low The Wizard of Oz Poppy Field
description: The Wizard of Oz x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Poppy Field' nods to the classic 1939 film. Red satin lines the upper, which is wrapped in a poppy field of Oz allover print. The silky top layer is made to be torn away, revealing a red suede surface, mirroring Dorothy's ruby slippers. The Nike SB and 'The Wizard of Oz' logos star on the tongue, while 'No place like home' is stitched on the heel. Nike SB-branded insoles depict the Wicked Witch of the West with one of her flying monkeys. The lively poppy print extends to the midsole, anchored by a red rubber outsole underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Leather Triple White
description: The Air Max 90 LTR 'Triple White' washes out its classic construction. The shoe's upper is built entirely with leather, finished tonally in white, matched by the Air Max badges. Underfoot, the foam midsole continues the one-tone look, with visible Max Air in the heel for cushioning. A waffle rubber outsole provides traction.

shoeName: Nike KD 19 Candy Paint Black
Nike Air Force 1 Low Patent Leather Dark Team Red Safety Orange
colorway: Dark Team Red/University Gold/Safety Orange/Challenge Red
description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Patent Leather Dark Team Red' rocks a burgundy patent leather upper touched with an orange Swoosh and heel tab. The latter gets a yellow 'Nike Air' embroidered details, as more Nike logos appear on the tongue tag and insoles. The maroon midsole contains an encapsulated Air-Sole heel unit below. A red, partially see-through rubber outsole ensures swift traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Nike Nationals
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Nike Nationals connects the original Greater Than basketball silhouette with a showcase for emerging players. A black upper establishes the foundation, while Green Glow and Blue Glow bring bright contrast to the lower portion of the shoe. The blue-to-green treatment gives the cushioning platform a distinctive appearance beneath the darker upper, making the color transition a central feature of this edition.

The low-to-the-ground construction uses lightweight layered mesh with reinforcement designed to support containment during lateral movement. A plush interior adds cushioning around the foot, while the low-cut collar preserves freedom around the ankle. Traditional laces secure the upper, maintaining the performance-focused arrangement associated with the original GT Cut. Nike ties the bright accents to the next generation of players using Nike Nationals as a stage for their development.

The combination of a restrained upper and vivid sole treatment gives this edition its strongest visual identity. Its tournament connection adds context for basketball collectors. Released on August 27, 2026, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Nike Nationals retailed for $210.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Pink Foam (GS)
description: The Nike Ja 3 GS 'Pink Foam' uses orange shoelaces to complement the pink knit upper, bolstered with scratch-like overlays comprised of raised, pink Ja Morant logos. A metallic fuschia vertical Swoosh encroaches into the midsole, which has caged sidewalls for lateral stability. The rubber outsole contains traction pattern for multi-directional grip.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Pegasus Pack Phantom
Nike Mind 001 Slide Light Smoke Grey (Women's)
description: The Women's Nike Mind 001 'Light Smoke Grey' sports a grey upper with a series of perforations. The outsole contains 22 nodes that move to activate sensory areas of the brain. These shoes contains a soft foam midsole for cushioning and a stretchy footbed that keeps you comfortable as you go about your day. Red accents on the nodes add the final touch to this neutral design.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low SE Triple Black
description: The Nike Dunk Low SE 'Triple Black' uses rope-style laces to secure the all-black suede upper, including Nike logos on the tongue tag, heel tab and insoles. A rubber cupsole couples with an outsole that keeps the authentic, hardwood-ready traction pattern underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat pushes the GT series forward with a more fluid and futuristic design language. Persian violet and glacier blue tones create a cool and dynamic palette, while chrome accents introduce a reflective edge that highlights the shoe’s structure. The silhouette feels fast even when standing still.

This version stands out because it leans fully into modern performance design. The shape, materials, and color all work together to create something that feels engineered for movement. Fans of the GT line appreciate how each iteration evolves, and this pair continues that progression with a bold and expressive look.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Preheat was released on February 3, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Book 2 Halloween
Nike Kobe 5 Year of the Mamba Eggplant (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 5 GS 'Year of the Mamba - Eggplant' commemorates the Lunar New Year, rolling out an iridescent purple synthetic upper. True to the Year of the Snake theme, a metallic gold serpent graphic coils around the signature Swoosh. Integrated Flywire cables promote a locked down feel, while the heel counter keeps the ankle stable. A Cushlon foam midsole contains Zoom Air on the forefoot for a responsive feel. A see-through rubber outsole reveals a glass/carbon fiber shank plate for midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Green Noise Watermelon
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Phoenix Suns
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Phoenix Suns brings Phoenix’s orange and purple palette to a performance basketball shoe. White mesh gives the upper a bright foundation, while Total Orange and violet-toned panels provide the team-inspired color. The split of colors across the shoe makes the reference clear without requiring a team logo to carry the entire design.

The GT Cut 3 Turbo is made for players who rely on quick changes of direction. A dual-layer ZoomX midsole provides responsive cushioning, while a carbon-infused forefoot plate adds structure during cuts. The traction pattern extends across the sole for grip through stops, starts, and lateral movement. Large Swoosh branding completes the sharp, modern shape. For Suns fans, the appeal goes beyond matching team gear: this is a court-ready shoe whose design works with the speed and movement of basketball.

Released on November 1, 2025, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Phoenix Suns retailed for $210. With its Suns colors and responsive construction, it brings team spirit to a technical basketball silhouette.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Jurassic Park Explorer (GS)
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut Nova
Nike Kobe 5 Dodgers (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro GS 'Dodgers' has a royal blue synthetic upper complemented with a grey Swoosh. No-sew forefoot and heel overlays have a scaly texture that nods to Kobe Bryant's Mamba Mentality. Red baseball stitching honors the great American pastime, while an embroidered Sheath logo adorns the tongue. The Cushlon midsole packs Zoom Air cushioning in the forefoot for a springy sensation on the court.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Photon Dust (Women's)
description: The Wmns Dunk Low 'Photon Dust' brings a subdued look to its classic construction. Built entirely with leather, the shoe's upper appears with a white base, complemented by Photon Dust overlays, including on the Swoosh branding. The toe box includes perforations for breathability, while underfoot, the two-tone look continues onto the rubber cupsole that anchors the build, which includes a concentric outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue
description:
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue brings a clean and focused look to one of Nike Basketball’s most precision driven silhouettes. The white base keeps the design sharp and uncluttered, while photo blue accents inject energy that mirrors the shoe’s quick and reactive identity. It feels purpose built for guards who rely on control and timing, with a visual language that emphasizes clarity and confidence rather than excess.

Collectors appreciate the GT Cut because it represents a modern shift toward feel and responsiveness over flash. The streamlined shape and balanced color blocking highlight the performance roots of the design, making it just as respected among hoopers as it is among fans of minimalist basketball footwear. It feels like a shoe designed to disappear on foot while still holding strong visual presence on shelf.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Photo Blue was released on 11/21/2025 with a retail price of $190.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Sail All-Star (GS)
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 6 GS 'Sail', also known as 'All-Star 2.0', rolls out an off-white micromesh upper, covered in embossed stars in place of the traditional snakeskin-like texture. A contrasting black Swoosh graces the side panel, matching Kobe Bryant's shield logo on the tongue. A see-through heel counter offers ankle stability, while the lightweight Cushlon midsole has a Zoom Turbo forefoot unit for on-court responsiveness.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 6 Protro Grinch (2020)
description: Originally released in 2010 for a Christmas Day collection, the Zoom Kobe 6 Protro 'Grinch' dropped in December 2020. The shoe's upper features a Green Apple and Volt look, with polyurethane detailing creating a snakeskin-style texture throughout the construction. Crimson on the branding and laces adds to the holiday aesthetic, while underfoot, the midsole incorporates Zoom Air to provide cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Patent Leather Beef And Broccoli
Nike Free Metcon 5 Black White
Nike Air Foamposite Pro Black Voltage Yellow
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Foamposite Pro 'Voltage' consists of a black Foamposite upper complemented with nubuck details on the eyestay. A neon green Swoosh decorates the side, matching the smaller ones on the forefoot and heel. A hidden foam midsole gets full-length Zoom Air cushioning along with a Zoom Air heel unit, all undergirded by a carbon fiber shank plate.

shoeName: Nike Vomero Plus Cow Print (Women's)
Nike Sabrina 3 Me vs. Me (Women's)
colorway: White/Metallic Dark Grey/Wolf Grey/Photon Dust/Black/University Red
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 Most Valuable Mascot Womens brings a playful and narrative driven approach to the silhouette, combining multiple tones to create a layered and expressive design. White and metallic dark grey form the base, while wolf grey, photon dust, black, and university red accents add depth and variation. The overall look feels dynamic and slightly unexpected.

This pair resonates because it leans into storytelling. The Most Valuable Mascot theme adds personality, making the shoe feel more than just a performance model. Fans appreciate how Sabrina’s line continues to explore different concepts while maintaining a strong on court identity.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Most Valuable Mascot Womens was released on December 19, 2025 with a retail price of $135.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Premium Big Bubble Joker
Nike Kobe 8 Mambacurial (GS)
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro GS 'Mambacurial' draws inspiration from the Nike Mercurial soccer boot silhouette. Designed for grade school wearers, the shoe showcases a mesh upper in fuchsia and violet gradient tones. An oversized lateral Swoosh in Electric Green and a white block-lettered Nike wordmark on the medial side provide striking contrast. The shoe is cushioned underfoot by a Lunarlon midsole, while a translucent neon green rubber outsole ensures reliable grip.

shoeName: Nike A'ja Wilson A'Two Pink Beam (Women's)
description:
The Nike Aja Wilson ATwo Pink Beam Womens introduces a signature basketball model tied to one of the game’s most dominant and influential players. The Pink Beam and Black colorway gives the shoe a bold and confident look, reflecting Aja Wilson’s presence on the court and her growing impact within the sport. The silhouette combines performance focused design with personal branding, creating a sneaker that feels connected to both play and identity.

Fans gravitate toward signature models because they represent the athlete’s style and influence beyond the game itself. The Pink Beam tone adds energy and individuality, making the shoe stand out within a category often dominated by darker palettes. The structure of the model supports performance while still maintaining a strong visual identity. Basketball sneakers continue playing a major role in both sport and streetwear culture. For collectors, releases like this mark important moments as new signature lines emerge and expand the representation of athletes within the sneaker world.

The Nike Aja Wilson ATwo Pink Beam Womens was released on May 2, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low SB Light Orewood Brown Pink
Nike Shox R4 Black Metallic Silver (2025)
Nike V5 RNR White Vast Grey College Grey Black

Nike Sabrina 2 White Noise (Women's)
description:
The Nike Sabrina 2 White Noise (Women's) revamps WNBA player Sabrina Ionescu’s second signature basketball shoe. It boasts a crisp white colorway with Glacial Blue and Metallic Silver accents.

Although the colorway is reminiscent of the SB Dunk Low Diamond Supply Co. White Diamond from 2018, the women's Nike White Noise Sabrina 2 offers a sleeker silhouette and performance-enhancing tech for the basketball court. An example, the sneaker replaces the Sabrina 1’s React cushioning with a responsive Air Zoom unit on the forefoot and two types of Cushlon foam underfoot. The firmer foam provides a supportive feel, while the softer variety protects against impact. Finally, cables with reinforced stitching and fitted a band contain the midfoot without restricting movement.

Our experts at StockX like the inspiration behind the name "White Noise." It references Ionescu’s ability to ignore negative criticism. The women’s size Nike Sabrina 2 White Noise (Women's) was released on October 1, 2024, and sold for $130.

This Protro version gets a revised cushioning system, consisting of a plush Cushlon 3.0 midsole and a full-length Zoom Air Strobel unit.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 270 White Black (Women's)
Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Triple White

Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Champagne
description: The NOCTA x Nike Hot Step Air Terra 'Champagne' rolls out an off-white leather upper with matching stitch lines and perforations. A metallic gold heel panel adds a shiny element. The tooling is taken from the Nike Terra Humara, which includes a molded foam midsole with an Air-Sole heel segment. The partially see-through rubber outsole uses Nike's G-Tek technology for steady traction.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 4 Light Work (Women's)
Nike KD 18 Slim Reaper
description:
Nike KD 18 Halloween leans into seasonal storytelling by giving Kevin Durant’s latest signature silhouette a darker and more playful edge. The Halloween theme brings a sense of mystery and fun to the KD 18, using contrast and mood to reflect the energy of late October hoops. It feels expressive without becoming costume like, letting the design communicate atmosphere rather than relying on obvious gimmicks, which is something KD fans tend to appreciate.

What makes this pair resonate is how naturally the theme fits Durant’s game. The KD line has always balanced precision and creativity, and this colorway highlights that duality through a look that feels intense yet controlled. Collectors gravitate toward themed KD releases because they add personality to a performance driven shoe, turning it into a piece that feels just as meaningful on display as it does in rotation.

The Nike KD 18 Halloween was released on 10/22/2025 with a retail price of $170.

Using elements from the papaya salad known as 'Som Tum,' beige and dark tan colors adorn the canvas upper, which has a woven texture that resembles bamboo rice baskets. Red stitching throughout matches the Nike SB emblem on the tongue tag. A silver 'Nike' signoff is stamped in Thai letters on the back tab, a nod to the steel pots used to cook sticky rice. The rice bag graphic decorates the foam insoles enhanced with a Zoom Air heel unit underfoot.

shoeName: Nike KD 4 Easter (2025)
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Easter' uses a plush Phylon midsole and a Zoom Air forefoot unit for a propulsive feel. These shoes have a shiny, mint green synthetic upper with see-through mesh side panels and an adjustable midfoot strap for a lockdown feel. Kevin Durant's jersey number rests on the tongue, while the KD logo lands on the heel.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 White Label
description:
The Nike Ja 3 White Label brings a clean, elevated take on Ja Morant's signature basketball line, finished in sail, cobalt blue, and metallic silver for a fresh, distinguished presentation. The White Label designation suggests a more premium or refined version within the Ja signature lineup, giving this release added visual sophistication compared to standard colorway drops. Morant's explosive, highlight reel style of play has made his signature shoes a genuine collector favorite among basketball sneaker enthusiasts.

Ja Morant has established himself as one of the most electrifying players in the league, and his signature shoe line continues to reflect that same explosive energy through bold performance construction. The White Label concept gives collectors a more elevated version to chase within an already popular signature line, appealing to fans who want a premium alternative to standard team colorway releases. Collectors who follow Morant's growing signature catalog find this release a meaningful addition given its distinguished, more refined presentation.

The Nike Ja 3 White Label was released on July 24, 2026 with a retail price of $150.

These training sneakers have a red and white leather upper, secured with a midfoot strap and tooled with cutout details that reveal a gold mesh underlay. Equestrian-inspired details reference a 2012 charity auction in which the teammates bid for a thoroughbred race horse named Sempre Mio. shoeName: Nike Air Griffey Max 1 Varsity Royal (2021/2026)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Air Griffey Max 1 'Varsity Royal' carries a white leather upper with blue nubuck overlays. A black Swoosh lands on the forefoot, while Ken Griffey Jr.'s jersey number adorns the adjustable ankle strap. A neon-hued Air-Sole unit bolsters the foam midsole for a soft and responsive feel.

shoeName: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs
description: Embracing the idea that footwear can be valued just for its function, the Tom Sachs x NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe ‘Studio’ is marketed as a sneaker for everyday wear. The classic simplicity of the shoe is delivered via a knit upper in cream with overlays in a contrasting off-white suede. The signature Swoosh appears in a subtle print while pull tabs on the tongue and at the heel provide an unexpected shock of brilliant royal blue. shoeName: Nike Dunk Low White Midnight Navy
description: The Nike Dunk Low 'Midnight Navy' 2025 mirrors the colors from the 'Villanova' release, which was part of the 'Be True to Your School' series from 1985. These shoes have a white leather upper with navy overlays and a matching Swoosh. The Nike tongue tag meets an embroidered Nike wordmark on the leather back tab, keeping the branding items intact from the original design.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black
description:
The Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black returns with its low-profile style, and heritage basketball looks.

The nearly 1-to-1 remake of the Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black features crisp leather on the upper with soft suede and synthetic details for added durability and throwback styling. The ultra-clean colors, simple lines, and low-cut, padded collar continue the look, which is wrapped up by an outsole fused with the midsole. The solid rubber outsole with herringbone pattern adds traction, durability, and heritage styling.

The Nike Blazer Low 77 Vintage White Black was released in December 2020 and originally retailed for $85.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 Blueprint (Women's)
colorway: Glacier Blue/Neptune Blue/Light Armory Blue/Metallic Gold/Still Blue/White
description:
Engineered for the speed, vision, and sharp cuts of Sabrina Ionescu’s game, the Nike Sabrina 3 Blueprint (Women’s) blends precision design with standout style. The Glacier Blue, Neptune Blue, and Light Armory Blue palette is layered in cool gradations, while Metallic Gold hits deliver a refined finish that catches the light with every move. A streamlined low-top silhouette supports agile footwork, with structured sidewalls and a secure lacing system that help lock in your midfoot during quick changes of direction. Underfoot, responsive cushioning softens hard landings and helps you spring into your next step, while a sculpted heel and padded collar add comfort through the full run of a game or workout.

Built for performance on hardwood or blacktop, the Sabrina 3 features a grippy, multidirectional traction pattern designed to keep you connected to the floor when you plant, pivot, and stop on a dime. Breathable materials keep airflow steady, and durable overlays reinforce high-wear zones so you can push the pace without worrying about breakdown. Style codes HF2881-400 and HF2882-400 mark this colorway as part of the Blueprint story, pairing modern performance with a clean, versatile look that pairs easily with team kits and streetwear alike. From high-intensity drills to everyday rotation, this pair delivers the balance of stability, responsiveness, and effortless polish that today’s two-way players demand.

Our team loves this product because it combines secure support, quick-rebounding cushioning, and confident traction in a striking blue-and-gold palette that performs on court and elevates your off-court fit.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Flyknit 2 Black Pure Platinum
description: The Air Force 1 Flyknit Low 2.0 'Oreo' emerges with a classic two-tone look on its lightweight build. The shoe's upper replaces the usual leather build with breathable Flyknit, which works a mix of black and white into the construction. Maintaining the usual design lines, the black Swoosh, heel patch and eyestay present a more traditional material build. Underfoot, the cored-out midsole adds to the lightweight design.

Nike Air Griffey Max 1 HBCU Swingman Classic
Nike Dunk Low St. Johns (2025)

Like its predecessor, the leather upper has eye-catching red accents on the forefoot and heel overlay, as well as the Swoosh. A padded collar keeps the feel comfortable, while perforated details on the toe box keep the look true to the original design. A sturdy rubber cupsole completes this classic look.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Rodeo Tourmaline
description: The Dunk Low SB 'Rodeo',also known as 'Tourmaline', rolls out a green suede upper secured with braided laces. A black suede Swoosh adorns the side panel, while unique Sonora-style embroidery graces the heel. Orange piping, a yellow knit lining, and an orange leather back tab bring a touch of radiant color. The insoles have custom artwork depicting a cowboy herding cattle. A partially see-through rubber outsole underfoot completes the look.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond
description:
The Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond brings elegance and confidence to one of LeBron James’ most refined signature silhouettes. The LeBron 20 is known for its low profile control and responsiveness, and the pink diamond colorway adds a sense of celebration and strength through shimmering pink tones and metallic silver accents. It feels polished and expressive without compromising performance intent.

Fans love this release because it highlights LeBron’s evolution. The colorway feels bold but composed, reflecting longevity, achievement, and continued dominance. Collectors appreciate how the LeBron 20 blends modern performance design with emotional storytelling, making this pair feel special without leaning into nostalgia. It stands as a reminder that even deep into his career, LeBron’s signature line continues to push forward with confidence and clarity.

The Nike LeBron 20 Pink Diamond was released on August 1, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Court Purple
description: The Dunk Low SB 'Court Purple' brings subdued accents to its classic skating construction. Reminiscent of the brand's pink and silver box eras, the shoe's upper is built with a white leather base, contrasted by the black overlays that mark the forefoot, eyestay and collar. The heel instead complements the look in Court Purple, while underfoot, the sockliner incorporates Zoom Air for cushioning. A final hit of Court Purple marks the rubber outsole, which provides traction.

Nike Vomero Premium Gridiron Black
Nike Ja 3 Swarovski Warning Label

The Nike Ja 3 Swarovski takes Ja Morant’s third signature sneaker into luxury territory with a bold, statement-driven finish. The crystal accents catch light from every angle, adding texture and shine without overpowering the shoe’s sharp lines and streamlined profile.

This release represents a crossover between performance-inspired design and high-end embellishment, tapping into a growing trend of sneakers doubling as statement pieces. Swarovski collaborations have long been associated with exclusivity, and pairing that legacy with Ja Morant’s rising cultural influence gives this colorway a unique presence. The all-black base keeps the look grounded, while the crystal detailing elevates it beyond a standard colorway into collectible territory.

When the Nike Ja 3 Swarovski released, it retailed for $235 and dropped on February 13, 2026. With its luxe materials and limited feel, this version stands apart as one of the most visually striking entries in the Ja Morant signature line.
