description:
The Nike Air Force 1 Mid White '07 features a smooth white leather upper with matching overlays and Swooshes. From there, a velcro strap with Nike Swoosh embroidery and a matching Air sole completes the design.

The Nike Air Force 1 Mid White '07 was re-released in December of 2015 and retailed for $95.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Limosine Skateboards
description: The Limosine Skateboards x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Football' have a brown pebbled leather upper with a printed black Swoosh piped in shiny silver. A Nike SB tongue tag joins a series of white football shoelaces that highlight the pigskin vibe. Limosine Skateboards' logo adorns the heel, while the flipside is stamped with a debossed 'Paymaster' wordmark. Mismatched back tabs showcase the Nike and Limo logos.

shoeName: Nike Vomero Premium Pale Ivory Jade Horizon
description: The Nike Vomero Premium 'Pale Ivory' has a sand-colored engineered mesh upper, accented with a black Swoosh and a stitched 'AIR' wordmark. The ZoomX foam midsole is stacked to 55mm for strong cushioning. Green Zoom Air forefoot and heel units bring a springy sensation to every step. The gum rubber outsole ensures swift traction.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Why So Sad?
description: Scottish skateboarder John Rattray brings his commitment to mental health research and suicide prevention into shoe form with the Why So Sad? x Nike Dunk Low SB ‘The Predatory Bird.’ The bird graphic that inspired this low-top's name embellishes the lateral heel, while a lone question mark in yellow adorns the red suede heel tab. The leather upper in cheerful pastel blue and contrasting navy suede overlays has a Swoosh in Coastal Blue fading to Speed Yellow. The interior tongue tag features ‘Why So Sad?’ reflecting Rattray's crusade to bring issues of depression to light. The outsole in clear rubber provides grippiness whether in the bowl or on the street.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Fresh Mint (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Air Max 95 'Big Bubble - Fresh Mint' features laces threading through mint-toned webbing eyelets that secure a white mesh upper. Textured synthetic suede overlays in gradient grey tones enhance the design, while an embroidered Air Max insignia sits on the tongue and debossed Nike Air branding marks the heel counter. The black polyurethane midsole incorporates a mint green Air-Sole unit, anchored by the signature 'Big Bubble' heel cushioning from the original AM95.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Woven Multi
colorway: White/Pearl Grey/Light Charcoal Grey/Hyper Pink/Green Strike

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Neon Paisley Bandana
description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Big Bubble - Paisley Neon' has shoelaces feed through volt-colored webbed eyelets to secure the upper, which has paisley-print panels in red, green, navy, and black. The layered design gets a black ripstop forefoot overlay and a reflective silver molded heel panel. The black foam midsole is aided by a 'Big Bubble' Max Air heel unit for springy cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Cool Grey Wolf Grey
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Cool Grey' has a floating white Swoosh decorating the grey mesh upper, with matching suede overlays, midfoot cage and a molded heel counter. These shoes sport a Cushlon midsole aided by springy Zoom Air forefoot and heel units. The rubber outsole keeps the traditional waffle traction pattern for smooth traction.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 White Phantom Summit White (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Zoom Vomero 5 'White Gum' rocks a whiteout upper consisting of an open-cell mesh upper with leather overlays and a midfoot cage that's built into the laces. A molded heel counter helps keep the ankle stable. The sculpted Cushlon midsole contains springy Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel. The gum rubber outsole ensures swift traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 Welcome to the Garden
Nike A'ja Wilson A'One All-Star Hyper Pink (Women's)
description:
The Nike A'ja Wilson A'One All-Star Hyper Pink brings a celebratory concept into WNBA superstar A'ja Wilson's debut signature basketball model, combining hyper pink and black to honor the league's marquee All Star showcase event. Wilson has established herself as one of women's basketball's most dominant and decorated players, and this All Star themed colorway gives collectors a genuine way to celebrate her participation in the sport's biggest annual showcase. This debut signature model represents a foundational moment within Wilson's growing basketball footwear legacy.

A'ja Wilson's rise as a signature athlete represents a significant moment for women's basketball within sneaker culture, and this All Star themed release gives fans a genuine way to celebrate her continued dominance and participation in the league's premier showcase event. Hyper pink and black together create a bold, celebratory color story fitting for this special occasion themed colorway. Fans of both Wilson's legendary career and the growing recognition of WNBA stars within sneaker culture find this A'One All Star release a compelling, historically significant addition to their collection.

The Nike A'ja Wilson A'One All-Star Hyper Pink (Women's) was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $110.

shoeName: Nike Air VaporMax Plus White
description: Diverting from the path of its predecessors (the 1998 Air Max Plus and 2017 VaporMax), the Air VaporMax Plus 'White Platinum' features a perforated nubuck and neoprene upper, TPU overlays for additional comfort, and flame-inspired designs—all in white. Completing the look are a foggy and fully-exposed translucent Vapormax Air Unit, and covert branding on the tongue and heel.

shoeName: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Triple Red
description: The Nike Air VaporMax Plus 'Triple Red' keeps the same red upper taken from the 1998 Air Max Plus, using a satin-like mesh upper with a wavy plastic cage built into the lacing system. Reflective details on the tongue and vamp allow for enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. The VaporMax platform maintains the monochromatic design.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Premium NYC Knicks
Nike Air Max 2017 Triple Black
description: The Air Max 2017 has molded foam wraps and a seamless Flymesh upper to bring a breathable sensation. The Cushlon midsole contains a full-length Air unit for responsive cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cow Print (Women's)
Nike Ja 3 Hustle & Flow
description:
Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow feels like a direct reflection of Ja Morant’s mindset, blending relentless drive with creative rhythm. The colorway tells a story about balance, where effort and instinct meet on the court, and the design carries that narrative through layered tones and dynamic visual energy. It feels expressive and intentional, built to match the pace of players who never slow down.

What makes this pair resonate with fans is how closely it aligns with Ja’s personality. The Ja 3 silhouette thrives on motion, and Hustle and Flow amplifies that with a look that feels alive even when standing still. It is a favorite among collectors who appreciate storytelling in sneakers, where performance and personal narrative are tightly connected.

The Nike Ja 3 Hustle and Flow was released on 09/10/2025 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro Radiant Emerald
description: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro ‘Radiant Emerald’ has an engineered mesh upper monogramed with the two jersey numbers Kobe Bryant wore through his NBA career. An embroidered teal Swoosh appears the side, while the Mamba’s sheath logo embellishes the tongue and Bryant's signature graces the heel counter. A drop-in React foam midsole makes every step soft and lightweight on and off the court. The herringbone-patterned rubber outsole reveals a visible carbon fiber shank plate to aid midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 Essential White Pure Platinum Black
Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Platinum Tint
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Platinum Tint' is anchored by a full-length Cushlon midsole that packs responsive Zoom Air forefoot and heel. The white mesh upper gets grey synthetic leather overlays. Grey overlays frame the midfoot cage, engineered for containment. Reflective accents on the forefoot and heel bring a high-visibility element to this classic design.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Tennessee Titans
Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Victor Wembanyama Gold Panther
description: The Victor Wembanyama x Nike GT Cut 4 'Gold Panther' has a seamless black synthetic upper adorned with a series of metallic gold panther spots. A molded black overlay in a semi-translucent finish extends from the medial midfoot and over the toe box. The 'VW' and 'Nike' wordmarks are embossed in stylized red lettering on the heel of each shoe. A Cushlon foam carrier includes a drop-in ZoomX 3.0 midsole and a full-length, parabolic Zoom Strobel. The rubber outsole features a generative pattern for optimal traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Black Volt
description: The Nike Air Foamposite One 'Black Volt' sports a black Foamposite upper while a neon green mini-Swoosh appears on the nubuck eyestay and Penny Hardaway's 1 Cent logo embroidered on the back of the knit collar. A concealed foam midsole contains a full-length Zoom Air unit, while a carbon fiber shank under the midfoot provides stability with every step.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Total 90 Burgundy Crush
Nike Blazer Mid 77 White Black (GS)
description: The Nike Blazer Mid '77 GS 'White Black' sports a white leather upper contrasted by a black retro Swoosh, touched with suede overlays in high-stress areas. The Nike logo lands on the tongue tag as well as the back tab. A white vulcanized rubber midsole works in tandem with a herringbone-pattern gum rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut EYBL Player Exclusive Peach Jam
Nike Air Diamond Turf 2 Patent Black Gym Red
Nike Air Force 1 Low World Tour White
Nike Dunk Low Triple Pink (GS)
description: The Dunk Low GS 'Triple Pink' also known as 'Barbie' updates the traditional design of the vintage Nike basketball shoe. The sneaker goes against the traditional two-tone color blocking with an all-leather upper in light pink for both the base and overlays. Hot pink highlights Nike branding along the Swoosh, tongue tag, and heel. While the rubber outsole secures the build, a breathable nylon tongue gives comfort.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Grateful Dead University of Oregon Grateful Ducks
description: The Grateful Dead x University of Oregon x Nike Air Max 90 'Grateful Ducks' commemorates the Ducks' October 2025 'tie-dye out' game at Autzen Stadium, which celebrated the Grateful Dead's 60th anniversary. These kicks have an off-white mesh and leather upper, tooled with a bright chenille green Swoosh piped in yellow. A multicolor tie-dye print engulfs the canvas mudguard., while the customary Nike tag adorns the tongue. The Grateful Dead logo patch lands on the heel as a nod to the classic rock band. The foam midsole packs an Air-sole heel unit framed within a yellow foam carrier.

shoeName: Nike Air Diamond Turf Emerald
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Air Diamond Turf 'Emerald' was previously retroed in 2017 after its original release in 1994. These cleats have a padded collar with a black nubuck upper and white synthetic leather overlays. Green touches hit the tongue, webbed heel loop and an embossed Swoosh on the adjustable midfoot strap. A metallic gold Nike Air logo arrives on the black nubuck heel panel, while a black foam midsole contains Air-sole cushioning in the forefoot and heel areas.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Championship Court Purple
description: The Nike Dunk Low 'Championship Purple' is rendered in two-tone OG-inspired color blocking. The silhouette features an all-leather white upper with violet overlays and a matching Swoosh. A woven Nike tongue tag and branded embroidery appear on the heel. The low-top is mounted on a durable rubber cupsole, complete with a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe Tom Sachs Bricolage (Women's)
description: The Tom Sachs x NikeCraft General Purpose Shoe 'Summit White' nods to a bricolage concept — the art of making something with the few resources available. These sneakers have a white knit upper tooled with a yellow Swoosh and bolstered with grey suede overlays. Taken from automotive seat belts, green nylon tongue and heel pull tabs allow for quick on and off. The Nike emblem decorates the tongue tag and black suede back tab, while a hand-drawn NikeCraft logo lands on the insoles. The black rubber outsole uses a classic waffle pattern for swift traction.

shoeName: Nike Shox R4 Brazil
Nike Air Max 95 SE Big Bubble Obsidian Work Blue
Nike Dunk Low Rose Whisper (Women's)
description: The Wmns Dunk Low 'Rose Whisper' refreshes the classic style of the retro basketball shoe in a light-hearted hue. The sneaker's leather upper is constructed entirely from a white base complemented by Rose Whisper overlays and Nike Swoosh. A breathable nylon tongue provides comfort while the rubber outsole anchors the build.

shoeName: Nike Free Run 5.0 Black White
description: The Nike Free Run 5.0 'Black White' has laser-cut grooves in the white foam sole unit. The modified waffle-traction outsole uses sturdy rubber in high-wear areas. A foot-hugging Flyknit upper uses a mix of black and dark grey hues. A printed white Swoosh decorates the side, while reflective details on the forefoot allow for better visibility in low-light conditions.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow carries forward one of Nike’s most meaningful initiatives, blending performance design with a message tied to breast cancer awareness. The pink driven color palette takes center stage, with Pinksicle and Vivid Pink tones layered across the upper alongside metallic silver and black accents. The result is a shoe that feels vibrant and intentional, standing out both visually and symbolically.

Fans of the Kay Yow series appreciate how each release connects sport with purpose. The GT Cut 4 platform delivers responsiveness and speed, while the color execution ensures the message remains front and center. It is a pair that resonates beyond performance, appealing to collectors who value both design and the story behind it.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Kay Yow was released on March 18, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature Panda (Women's)
description: Incorporating at least 20% recycled content by weight is the Nike women's Dunk Low Next Nature 'Panda.' The synthetic leather upper complements the clean white base with contrasting black overlays. Standard branding elements are featured, including a woven Nike tongue tag and an embroidered Nike wordmark on the heel tab. A pop of neon green finish appears on the sockliner and is accented in Nike's pinwheel logo. The low-top is built on a durable rubber cupsole with white sidewalls and a black rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Mercurial Superfly 10 Elite FG Scary Good Pack
Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Realtree Rattan Rocky Tan Seal Brown Camo
description: The Nike Air Force 1 '07 'Realtree Rattan' rolls out a tan suede upper with caramel brown nubuck forefoot and heel overlays. A camo canvas Swoosh matches the back tab, as well as the Nike tag adorning the tongue. A light beige rubber cupsole gets encapsulated Air-sole cushioning in the heel and a pivot-point outsole for steady traction.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 23 Miami Twice (Translucent Outsole)
description: The Nike LeBron 23 'Miami Twice' recognizes LeBron James' tenure with the Miami Heat, channeling Miami Vice vibes with a teal-colored jacquard upper tooled with a palm tree graphic. A beveled reverse Swoosh sporting a metallic rose hue nods to the LeBron 10. An iridescent pink hue decorates the Crown Containment System, a 360-degree frame that works alongside a full-length drop-in ZoomX foam midsole for plush cushioning and a carbon fiber plate for stability.

shoeName: Nike Vomero Plus Sail Baroque Brown
Nike Dunk Low Green Strike (Women's)
Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Reflective
description: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Black Reflective' uses reflective threads woven into rope-style laces to secure the blackout mesh upper. A series of leather overlays are wrapped in reflective details. An Anthracite leather Swoosh is stitched onto the midfoot cage, while a Nike Vomero tag decorates the tongue. A matching black Cushlon midsole contains Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel for a plush feel with each step.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Hot Curry
Nike Air Trainer 1 SP Travis Scott Grey Haze
description: Travis Scott works with Nike Sportswear on slight redesign of the classic Air Trainer 1. Replacing the traditional leather build and familiar panels, Scott opts for a textile finish in Grey Haze hue. 'Cactus Corporation' appears on the forefoot strap and back heel area, where a zippered stash pocket can be found. Scott's signature reverse Swoosh is found on the medial side, and Cactus Jack branding appears on the perforated nubuck tongue. Tiny holes can be found all over the upper, which are attachment points for a removable ripstop shroud (that can be stored in the pocket when not in use). Finally, the midsole shape stays the same, but the outsole traction is covered with rows of little nubs, forming a unique grippy pattern.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Low Platform White Black (Women's)
description: The classic basketball shoe emerges with a lifted look on the Wmns Blazer Low Platform 'White Black.' Built with leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, contrasted by black Swoosh branding on the side wall and complemented by tonal suede on the lateral forefoot and toe. Exposed foam on the tongue contributes to a retro feel, while underfoot, a platform midsole with a reinforced to bumper anchors the fit. A herringbone rubber outsole is included for traction.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low EMB NBA 75th Anniversary Chicago
description: The Nike Dunk Low EMB ‘Bulls’ is one pair in a collection celebrating the 75th anniversary of the NBA, delivered in the unmistakable palette of the Chicago Bulls. Chili Red and black overlays at the heel and forefoot intersect the all-white leather base while the signature Swoosh appears in a contrasting black leather. Branding saluting the anniversary appears on the tongue tag and with diamond imagery on the lace dubrae. The heel tab is adorned with ‘Nike’ in red.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low SP Syracuse
description: Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the silhouette, the Dunk Low Retro SP 'Syracuse' brings back a look from 1985's Be True to Your School series. Built with leather, the upper gives the nod to Syracuse University in white and Orange Blaze. Perforations on the toe box provide breathability, while Zoom Air in the sockliner provides cushioning. The sole unit underfoot continues the two-tone look.

shoeName: Nike M2K Tekno Cool White (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's M2K Tekno 'White Grey' takes design elements from the Nike Monarch model. The white leather upper gets a series of cut-out panels revealing a knit underlay. A small white Swoosh piped in grey embroidered details adorns both sides. A sculpted foam midsole keeps every step soft and resilient.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Dn8 SE Black Dark Grey
Nike Air Max 270 Black (GS)
Nike Dunk Low PRM Vintage Navy (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Dunk Low Premium 'Vintage Navy' recalls the iconic 1985 'Be True to Your School' color block in a low-top design whose sleek white leather upper is perfectly complemented by overlays in Midnight Navy. The Swoosh and robust rubber outsole echo the navy hue, while the cupsole showcases vintage sidewalls in Coconut Milk.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves Noise Aqua (with Bracelet)
description: Patta and Nike came together again to bring the Patta x Nike Air Max 1 'Noise Aqua.' The standout feature is a wavy suede mudguard, rendered in a bright blue finish with an embroidered mini-Swoosh on the lateral forefoot. The remaining upper is made from matte silver mesh with white leather overlays and a blue suede Swoosh. The mesh tongue features a woven Patta tag, and an embroidered Nike Air branding rests on the back heel. Lightweight cushioning is featured by a pre-yellowed polyurethane midsole with a visible Air unit under the heel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Family Reunion Hong Kong
description: The Nike Air Max 95 'Big Bubble - Family Reunion Hong Kong' is one of four-special edition 'City Pack' colorways commemorating the silhouette's global influence. Taking elements from Hong Kong's neon-lit streets, the upper has multiple shades of red on the rippling side panels, which are made from a mix of nubuck, shaggy suede, leather and knit. A matching leather toe cap is wrapped in embroidered speckles. Neon green touched arrive on the webbed eyelets as well as the Nike Air logo on the heel panel. A black foam midsole gets Air-Sole cushioning, including a green 'big bubble' heel unit.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low PRM Vintage Team Red (Women's)
description: The Nike Dunk Low Premium 'Vintage Red' for women combines a timeless color block design with a distressed look. The basketball-inspired shoe is made of smooth leather, with a predominantly white upper and contrasting dark red accents on the overlays and Nike Swoosh. The same vintage red hue can be seen on the woven tongue label. The midsole arrives in Coconut Milk and features a stitched sidewall design, while the outsole is made of durable burgundy rubber.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Black Game Royal
Nike SB Dunk Low HUF San Francisco
description: Recalling the first retail store opened by late professional skateboarder Keith Hufnagel, the HUF x Nike Dunk Low SB ‘San Francisco’ celebrates the Golden City and designer's iconic streetwear brand. The upper appears in tumbled leather in black and white. Against that low-key backdrop the SF Giants get a cameo with their ubiquitous font appearing on the heels in black and orange stitching above the etched SF skyline. On the toe box, HUF branding partners with a sparkling Swoosh while alternating Nike SB and HUF logos adorn the sockliners, in the brand's trademark lime-green. ‘Keith Forever’ is stitched on the heel tabs in the Giants’ trademark font in black and orange font.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Undefeated Hall of Fame
description: Celebrating the Black Mamba's induction into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame, the Undefeated x Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'Hall Of Fame' emerges in the colors of the only team he ever played for. Built with a mesh base and underlaid by snakeskin-textured leather, the shoe's upper appears in gold, complemented by a purple Swoosh on the right side of both shoes, with pink on the left. The left shoe also includes 24, 10 and 8 on the pink Swoosh as a nod to his NBA and Olympic jersey numbers, while the tongue and heel include mismatched Kobe Bryant and Five Strikes branding. Underfoot, Zoom Air provides cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Soft Pearl Brown Croc
Nike Air Max Plus 3 Triple White
description: A clean colorway, the Air Max Plus 3 'Triple White' released in March 2020. The retro runner is built with a mix of mesh and synthetic leather, supported by the distinctive external heel counter. Underfoot, the midsole houses visible Max Air in the forefoot and heel for cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Protro College Navy (GS)
Nike Air Max Plus Shark Attack
Nike Air Max 1 Chili 2.0
description: The Nike Air Max 1 'Chili 2.0' showcases an upper in white mesh for enhanced breathability complemented by a scarlet Swoosh for a vibrant touch. Synthetic suede overlays in a soft grey shade combine with eye-catching black accents adorning the mudguard and the interior textile lining. The classic wedge-shaped polyurethane midsole appears in white and provides lightweight cushioning, while the heel features a Max Air unit with a reddish hue for added impact absorption.

Nike Premier 3 TF Black White
Nike ACG LDV Brilliant Blue Turf Orange

colorway: Black/Metallic Dark Grey/Cool Grey/Dark Smoke Grey

Nike Kobe 9 EM Low Mambacita (GS)
Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 4 Total Orange Hyper Crimson
Nike Vomero 18 Disrupt Pack
Nike Air Max Dn8 Black Volt
Nike Air Foamposite One Penny PE
description: The Nike Air Foamposite One ‘Penny PE’ is a colorway originally worn by Penny Hardaway during the 1996-1997 NBA season as a player exclusive. The shoe features a white Foamposite upper with the eyestay and collar appearing in black tumbled leather. The heel tab is embroidered with Penny's 1 Cent logo, while the royal blue sockliner features Nike branding. The semi-translucent white rubber outsole provides torsional support via a visible carbon fiber shank.

shoeName: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Hot Lava (2024)
description: The 2024 version of the Nike Air Tech Challenge 2 'Hot Lava' remixes the Tinker Hatfield 1990 design made for tennis legend Andre Agassi. A white leather upper gets bold black overlays, a red Swoosh and grey support wings. The two-tone splatter print appears on the lower underlays, coupled with a pre-yellowed, Air-sole foam midsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Black Buff Gold
Nike Air Max 97 Black White
description: The Nike Air Max 97 rolls out a blackout leather and mesh upper, touched with subtle texture details and white accents on the Swoosh as well as the midsole. The Air unit and rubber outsole maintain the monochromatic aesthetic.

shoeName: Nike SB Zoom Nyjah 4 White Black
Nike Vapor Street Off-White Black Laser Fuchsia (Women's)
description: Dropping in November 2019 as part of Virgil Abloh’s ‘Athlete in Progress’ collection, the OFF-WHITE x women’s Vapor Street ‘Laser Fuchsia’ gives the nod to Nike’s track and field heritage. The stylized running shoe features a translucent overlay atop a black nylon upper, accented with Laser Fuchsia detailing and Virgil’s signature touches, including a plastic zip tie and printed text on the medial sidewall.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Travis Scott Cactus Jack
description: The Travis Scott x Air Force 1 Low 'Cactus Jack' showcases a unique patchwork build on the upper, reflecting the Houston rapper’s upbringing and personal style. The rugged materials give the nod to traditional workwear, including a removable zippered overlay atop the tongue, while the various earth tones draw inspiration from the great outdoors. A gum rubber outsole anchors the eclectic design.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Cannon
Nike SB Dunk High Antihero Skateboards
description: The Antihero x Nike Dunk High SB 'Wolf Grey' sports a subtle, ivory cracked leather upper with white tumbled leather panels on the heel and Swoosh. A stripped-down collar and an exposed foam tongue remix the look, while the heel rocks the Antihero logo. These shoes have a traditional cupsole with white sidewalls and a sturdy black rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated 5 On It Blue Yellow Croc
description: Undefeated drew inspiration from the sneaker style of the '90s and 2000s with their mixed material Undefeated x Air Force 1 Low SP. The lateral side has a yellow canvas quarter panel with a white patent leather Swoosh while its adjacent side features a yellow canvas Swoosh and a white leather base. With added details of croc-embossed blue leather overlays and a matching nylon tongue. The classic Five Strikes of Undefeated appear on the heel and tongue tag with a cream-hued rubber cupsole and Air-sole cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Penny 2 Stussy Black
description: The Stussy x Nike Air Penny 2 ’Black’ presents a heritage silhouette in a noir finish. The white Stussy logo appears on the lateral quarter panel of the otherwise all-black upper, which is constructed from hemp canvas and embellished with tonal stitching. The black Phylon midsole features a Zoom Air unit in the forefoot, a Max Air unit in the heel, and a carbon fiber shank which provide optimal support underfoot. The sneaker is easy to put on and take off with pull tabs at the heel and tongue.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 2 TB Game Royal Deep Royal Blue Photo Blue White (Women's)
Nike Air Max 90 White Light Crimson
Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise 2.0
description: The G-Dragon x Air Force 1 '07 'Para-Noise 2.0' released in November 2020 as a follow-up to a 2019 collaboration with the Korean hip-hop star. The shoe's upper is built with a white leather base designed to wear away, revealing G-Dragon's artwork underneath. A black Swoosh contrasts the side wall, and perforations on the toe box provide breathability. The tongue includes an embroidered daisy, while underfoot, the Air midsole includes a brushstroke effect.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Smoke
description: The Nike GT Cut 3 'Black' sports a white Swoosh contrasting a white knit upper secured with Flywire cables that are built into the lacing system. A thin, molded tongue and a padded collar provide a comfortable feel the minute you lace them up. A black-and-white fading effect on the Zoom X foam midsole provides energy return with every step.

shoeName: Nike Dunk High Bodega Legend Fauna Brown
description: Drawing from Americana, old-world craftsmanship and the collective spirit of a like-minded team, the Bodega x Dunk High 'Legend' released in collaboration with the Boston retailer. Modeled after the look of a baseball mitt, the shoe's upper is built with smooth leather, pebbled leather and hairy suede, with moccasin-style rawhide stitching throughout. A jewel Swoosh stands out on the lateral side-wall, with debossed Bodega branding on the medial. A semtranslucent concentric rubber outsole offers traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Bakin SP Supreme Black Gradient
description: The Supreme x Nike Air Bakin 'Black Gradient' is a revival of a 1997 performance basketball silhouette. The shoe's upper arrives in a gradient finish of lavender and yellow on pebbled leather which layers over a ventilated black mesh base, with crimson rope laces delivering contrast. The mudguard in black synthetic nubuck merges into a matching Phylon midsole, featuring a red jeweled Swoosh and an exposed Max Air unit in the heel. The webbing pull tab is decorated with the Supreme wordmark while the back heel is adorned with an embroidered 'NYC' graphic.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Mid '77 Vintage White
Nike Free Metcon 5 White Aquarius Blue (Women's)
Nike Air Max Command Triple Black
Nike Free Metcon 5 Lilac Bloom Barely Grape (Women's)
Nike Cortez TXT Midnight Navy
Nike Vomero Plus White Black Cool Grey
Nike Shox TL White Metallic Silver Max Orange (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's Shox TL 'White Silver' 2023 utilizes an upper in a textured white mesh reinforced by matching TPU overlays. The metallic silver molded Swoosh is stitched and intriguing color pops arrive in the form of Max Orange Nike Shox branding adorning both the tongue and the rear heel. The shoe's foundation rests on a robust rubber outsole while a series of polyurethane Shox pillars provide innovative cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 1 Protro City of Champions
description: The Nike Zoom Kobe 1 Protro 'City of Champions' references The Forum, which was home to the Los Angeles Lakers from 1967 to 1999. These shoes sport a blue leather upper with shiny metallic gold eyelets. A cracked white leather Swoosh matches the forefoot overlay as well as the heel tab. This Protro edition rides on a plush Phylon midsole, coupled with a carbon fiber shank plate and a full-length Zoom Air unit. The partially see-through rubber outsole brings traction to every step.

shoeName: Nike Total 90 3 SP Black
description: The Nike Total 90 3 SP 'Black' uses asymmetrical laces to secure the black patent leather upper, tooled with a quilted vamp and a silver Swoosh on the side. The opposite side showcases a metallic silver logo patch with a large '90' signoff, true to the original design. A black herringbone traction outsole is contrasted by a white foam midsole.

shoeName: Nike Ava Rover Black Muslin
description: The Nike Ava Rover 'Black Muslin' brings a black knit upper tooled with embroidered mini-Swoosh and a synthetic mudguard that has a blocky, pixel-like texture monogrammed through the React foam midsole. A sturdy rubber outsole uses a modified waffle pattern for steady traction.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Triple Black
Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Light Orewood Brown
colorway: Light Orewood Brown/Light Orewood Brown-Light Orewood Brown
description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 'Light Orewood Brown' sports a molded Swoosh on the side, while a Nike React signoff appears on the footbed. Vent holes throughout the vamp bring an airy feel. The ReactX foam midsole brings a springy feel, while the rubber outsole has a radial pattern for smooth traction.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Metallic Silver Platinum Violet (Women's)
Nike Book 1 Flagstaff
description:
The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff is a performance shoe designed as part of a partnership with American basketball star Devin Booker. 
       
This iteration of the Nike Book 1 has a smooth, durable upper in a Fir green color that represents the mountain paths and forests of Flagstaff, where Devin Booker goes to escape the desert heat. Decorative stitching crosses the upper for visual interest. A white outline of the Swoosh appears on each side. The tongue contains a Book branding patch and pays homage to Humphrey’s Peak, the highest point in Flagstaff. The heels are adorned with gold lettering reading "Flagstaff" on one heel and "no service" on the other. An Air Zoom unit under the heel allows for responsiveness and quick movements. 

What we like best about this shoe is the woven tongue tag, paying homage to Humphrey’s Peak, which provides a nice contrast to the green color of the rest of the shoe. The Nike Book 1 Flagstaff was released on February 1, 2025, for $140.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Electric Pack Olympic Safari
description: The Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'Electric Pack' nods to skateboarding returning to the 2024 Paris Olympics. These sneakers have a grey suede upper with Nike's Safari print wrapping the forefoot and heel overlays. Contrasting black accents touch the leather Swoosh, collar and back tab, alongside an embroidered orange Nike wordmark, matching the collar lining. These shoes rock a traditional rubber cupsole with white sidewalls and a black outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 SB Cactus Flower
colorway: Summit White/Photon Dust/Cool Grey/Cactus Flower/Gum Yellow
description: The Nike SB x Nike Air Max 95 'Cactus Flower' dons a white foam midsole equipped with hot pink Max Air units and anchored by a modified gum rubber outsole. These skate-inspired kicks have navy suede side panels with a gradient design that makes the black top layer go into lighter shades of grey. Fuchsia pops arrive on the webbed eyelets, embroidered Swoosh, and the embossed Nike SB logo on the reflective silver heel panel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Wolf Grey
Nike Sabrina 2 Mirrored (Women's)
description:
The Nike Sabrina 2 Mirrored (Womens) gives a bold look and advanced support that's designed for women athletes who value performance but want to look stylish doing it. This innovative sneaker combines Nike’s signature materials with elegant, reflective accents, creating a striking silhouette.

The Mirrored Sabrina 2 (Women's) by Nike is built with a supportive mesh upper that gives you breathability while holding its structure. Reflective detailing on the side panels and midsole adds a unique mirrored effect, improving the shoe’s visual appeal. A deep-silver base with metallic accents complements its streamlined design, while the mirrored Swoosh gives you the branding you're looking for. Inspired by WNBA’s Sabrina Ionescu’s on-court performance, this model features Nike’s responsive Zoom Air cushioning for impact support, all on a durable rubber outsole built for traction.

We love the reflective side panels and the Zoom Air cushioning in the Nike Sabrina 2 Mirrored (Womens), which combine visual appeal with responsive comfort. Released on August 15, 2024, it retailed at $130.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer (Women's)
description:
The Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer Womens delivers electric contrast through a bold mix of Green Shock, Vapor Green, and Vivid Purple. Black accents ground the vibrant palette, while Neon Yellow highlights intensify the dynamic feel of the upper. The streamlined construction keeps the silhouette fast and agile, built for high tempo play. Every detail feels charged with movement and personality.

This colorway speaks to players who bring flair and fearlessness to the court. The layered greens and purples create visual depth that stands out instantly. It blends competitive focus with expressive style, capturing the energy of a locked in gamer mindset. Loud and dynamic, this pair demands attention from tip off to final buzzer.

The Nike Sabrina 3 Gamer Womens was released on October 16, 2025 with a retail price of $145.

shoeName: Nike V5 RNR White Black Metallic Silver
Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise
description:
The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise leans into contrast and texture, pairing a lightning yellow base with wolf grey and denim turquoise accents that create a layered and slightly rugged feel. The denim elements add depth to the upper, giving the shoe a different visual texture compared to standard leather builds. It feels both vibrant and grounded at the same time.

This pair stands out because of its material mix. SB Dunk releases often experiment with fabrics, and this version uses denim to shift the overall look while keeping the silhouette familiar. It is a bold but wearable option for those who want something more expressive without losing structure.

The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro Muni Lightning Denim Turquoise was released on May 1, 2026 with a retail price of $130.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Minnesota Timberwolves
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Minnesota Timberwolves brings a vibrant, high energy colorway to Nike's cutting edge basketball performance platform, tied directly to the Timberwolves franchise. Venom green, light lemon twist, light current blue, and multi color accents combine into a genuinely eye catching palette that channels the team's energetic identity through a bold, contemporary lens. The GT Cut line has built its reputation on delivering elite level agility and responsiveness, giving players the quick, explosive movement capability the modern game demands.

The Timberwolves have generated significant recent excitement within the NBA, and performance basketball collaborations tied to the franchise consistently draw interest among both sneaker collectors and devoted fans following the team's competitive rise. The GT Cut 3's advanced cushioning and traction technology reflects Nike's continued innovation within basketball footwear, giving this Timberwolves themed colorway genuine on court credibility alongside its collectible appeal. Fans of both the Timberwolves and elite performance basketball shoes find this release particularly compelling for how it merges team pride with cutting edge athletic technology.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Turbo Minnesota Timberwolves was released on February 15, 2025 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Ja 2 Nightmare
description:
The Nike Ja 2 Nightmare is focused on all the aspects that made Ja Morant an NBA star. It's designed to provide lots of responsive support for quick turns, with a bouncy feel in the sole to help you get up high.

This model upgrades the Nike Ja 1 with extra padding at the ankles and a characteristic waterfall collar lining. The nightmare colorway features a shiny red upper with contrasting black swathes that give a racing stripes effect. The under-sole traction pattern is modeled on the lorry tires that Ja trained with as a youngster.

Our experts like this new version of a shoe that made a real splash when it was first introduced. It's extremely visually attractive, but what makes it special is the underlying technology. It features modern gizmos like a sidewall guardrail and a dynamic ankle sleeve for optimal on-court performance. The Nike Ja 2 Nightmare was released on 25 October 2024 and retailed at $120.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus Obsidian Aluminum
Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Hyper Pink Bordeaux (Women's)
description: Designed for marathons and half-marathons, the Nike Women's Alphafly 3 'Hyper Pink' uses notched shoelaces and a plush knit tongue. A hot pink AtomKnit upper engulfs the large Swoosh that makes way for the stacked ZoomX foam midsole, which contains a Zoom Air forefoot unit for energy return.

shoeName: Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD Equity
description: The Nike Zoom LeBron NXXT Gen AMPD Equity is a cutting-edge performance sneaker designed for the modern basketball player. Featuring a sleek white, black, and gold colorway, these shoes combine style with functionality. The innovative Zoom Air technology in the midsole provides responsive cushioning, allowing for explosive movements on the court. The upper is crafted with breathable materials to keep your feet cool during intense gameplay. Engineered with LeBron James' playing style in mind, the NXXT Gen AMPD offers superior stability and support. The durable rubber outsole features a multidirectional traction pattern, ensuring excellent grip on various court surfaces. With its lightweight construction and adaptive fit, this shoe allows players to move with agility and confidence. Our team thinks this product is great for serious basketball players looking to elevate their game with a shoe that delivers both performance and style.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Tiffany & Co. 1837
description: An historic union brings together New York's renowned jewelry house with the sportswear giant in the Tiffany & Co. x Nike Air Force 1 Low ‘1837.’ This release goes beyond the 2005 "Diamond" Dunk SB tribute and solidifies the partnership with a black suede upper and tumbled leather Swoosh in the iconic robin's-egg blue hue. ‘Tiffany’ script appears on the tongue tag while each heel tab displays the classic ‘Nike Air’ branding in black. The shoe is completed with an engraved Tiffany silver badge. The look is completed with a range of accompanying sterling silver accessories available separately, including a shoe horn, brush, whistle chain, and lace dubrae.

shoeName: Nike Air Flightposite Metallic Gold (2024)
description: The Nike Air Flightposite 'Metallic Gold' shoes have an iridescent metallic gold molded Foamposite upper with a stretchy black neoprene sleeve on parts of the upper and the collar. A full-length zipper opens to reveal the lacing system. A drop-in foam insole contains a Zoom Air unit on the forefoot and heel for all-around cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Black Reflective Silver
Nike Book 1 Moss Point (Translucent Outsole)
description: The Nike Book 1 'Moss Point' honors the high school Devin Booker graduated from. The knit and leather upper gets a pale blue hue, contrasted by a grey suede eyestay and a metallic silver heel overlay. The latter is stamped with 'Yes Ma'am' on one side, while the opposite side reads 'No Sir.' The size tag moves to the front of the tongue. A full-length Cushlon 2.0 midsole pairs with Zoom Air heel unit for balanced cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Dirty Denim
description: The Nike Air Max 1 Premium 'Dirty Denim' takes its inspiration from well-worn jeans and revives a vintage theme from a 2003 iteration. The shoe's upper mixes faded indigo denim with worn blue suede on the front and sides, while the leather Swoosh, Nike tongue tag, and inside lining appearing in Deep Royal Blue. The midsole displays a Lemon Wash color, is supported by a gum rubber outsole and has visible Air cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Obsidian
Nike Vapor Edge Kobe 6 SE Grinch
description: The Nike Vapor Edge Kobe 6 SE 'Grinch' morphs Kobe Bryant's signature basketball shoes into performance football cleats. A Grinchy-green upper is decorated with a raised scaly texture and a printed black Swoosh. Bryant's red shield logo graces the tongue, while his signature is etched onto the heel. The outsole plate has wide studs placed strategically for swift cuts on the gridiron.

shoeName: Nike Air Vapormax Plus Cool Grey Black
Nike SB Dunk Low StrangeLove Skateboards
description: The StrangeLove x Dunk Low SB QS 'Valentine's Day' released as part of a collaboration with Sean Cliver's skate brand. Dropping in February 2020, the upper is built with white crushed velvet, overlaid by pink suede and complemented by a red velvet Swoosh. The lateral heel sports Cliver's Heart Skull graphic, while underfoot, a series of red and blue hearts are visible through the translucent rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim
description:
The Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim introduces a more lifestyle driven concept into Devin Booker’s signature line, using denim inspired textures and tones to shape the overall design. The multi color palette blends blues with sail and Game Royal accents, creating a layered look that feels casual but intentional. It shifts the silhouette away from pure performance and into a more expressive space.

Fans are drawn to this release because it reflects Booker’s off court style as much as his game. The denim theme adds personality without overcomplicating the structure, making it stand out within the signature lineup. It is a pair that blends storytelling with wearability, appealing to collectors who appreciate a more personal approach to basketball footwear.

The Nike Book 2 Must Be The Denim was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $140.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Coconut Milk Deep Royal Blue
colorway: Coconut Milk/Legion Pine/Light Orewood Brown/Deep Royal Blue

shoeName: Nike Air Trainer Huarache Challenge Red
description: The Nike Air Trainer Huarache 'Challenge Red' brings a red suede upper secured with a combo of standard laces and an adjustable midfoot strap comprised of a partially see-through mesh. Cutouts in the collar and side panel showcase the neoprene sleeve below. An embroidered Nike Air logo decorates the heel. The foam midsole contains an encapsulated Air-sole unit for plush cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Kobe Offcourt Slide Triple White
description: The Kobe Bryant x Nike Offcourt Slide 'Triple White' is crafted with white synthetic leather. The padded strap upper is wrapped in a snakeskin print and accented with Kobe Bryant's iconic shield logo. Wavy lines are etched into the white, contoured footbed, which rides on a matching foam midsole. The synthetic outsole has pronounced grooves for better traction and flexibility.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Black Patent (Women's)
Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 4 CM White Racer Blue
Nike Dunk Low Retro SE White Blue Void
Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue
description:
The Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue brings explosive color to one of Nike Basketball’s most responsive silhouettes. Furious blue dominates the upper, giving the GT Cut 3 a fast and aggressive presence that mirrors the way the shoe is meant to perform. Metallic and dark accents add contrast that sharpens the look, reinforcing speed and control as the core themes.

Hoopers love this release because it feels built for modern play. The GT Cut line is respected for its court feel and responsiveness, and this colorway adds confidence without distraction. Collectors appreciate how Nike keeps the design focused on movement and precision, making Furious Blue feel like more than just a color swap. It is a sneaker that looks and feels locked in, appealing to players who rely on quick reactions and constant pressure.

The Nike GT Cut 3 Furious Blue was released on February 1, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise 3.0
description: The G-Dragon x Nike Air Force 1 '07 'Para-Noise 3.0' rocks a black leather upper with mismatched Swoosh logos in hot pink, blue, yellow and teal. An embroidered daisy embellishes the tongue, while the Nike Air logo stars on the back tab. These shoes have a white rubber cupsole with prominent black scuff marks across the midsole.

shoeName: Nike LeBron Witness 9 Bronny James Desert Pink (Translucent Outsole)
description: The Nike LeBron Witness 9 'Bronny James' is the player edition made for LeBron James' oldest son. A pink, synthetic leather upper is etched with radiating lines. Stacked reverse Swoosh logos in white and dark grey decorate the side. A 'Bronny' signoff is stamped on the toe box, while LeBron's logo is embedded on the heel. The caged ReactX foam midsole works in tandem with a partially see-through rubber outsole below.

shoeName: Nike Mac Attack QS SP Travis Scott Cactus Jack
description: Updating the '80s tennis shoe John McEnroe used to wear, the Travis Scott x Nike Mac Attack SP 'Cactus Mac' features breathable mesh in black and grey showcasing a reverse black Nike Swoosh on the side. Leather overlays in grey adds extra support to the front and back of the shoe, and the cushioned mid-cut collar is wrapped in black leather. Underfoot, a sturdy rubber cupsole with white sides rests on a grey rubber outsole. A checkered Nike tongue tag pairs with a Cactus Jack logo stitched on the back heel.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Team Gold
description: The Nike Dunk Low 'Team Gold' is a tribute to the classic 'Be True to Your School' series from 1985, featuring the iconic color blocking of that era. The shoe's low-profile upper is constructed from smooth leather and boasts a white base with dull yellow overlays and a matching Swoosh. The toe box features perforated detailing for increased ventilation, while comfy fit is delivered by the padded low-cut collar. The sneaker provides lightweight cushioning via a sturdy rubber cupsole with an interior foam wedge.

shoeName: Nike Air Tech Challenge II Pixel Court (2025)
description: Brough to fame by Andre Agassi, the Nike Air Tech Challenge 2 'Pixel Court' has a white leather upper with perforated details on the toe box and side panel. A blue Swoosh matches the embroidered Nike Air logo on the heel. More blue hits the forefoot and heel, contrasted by bright red pixelated graphics. An off-white foam midsole pairs with Air-sole cushioning in the heel for a plush feel.

shoeName: Nike KD 18 Rain City
description:
The Nike KD 18 Rain City pays tribute to Kevin Durant’s roots with a color story that feels moody and grounded. Dressed in Black with University Gold, Anthracite, Fir, and Dark Smoke Grey, the layered upper reflects the overcast skies often associated with the Pacific Northwest. The streamlined build and responsive cushioning platform give the silhouette a quick and aggressive stance, built for fluid scoring and sharp movement.

Rain themed releases always carry deeper meaning for Durant fans, symbolizing the environment that shaped his early grind. The darker tones dominate the look, while subtle hits of gold and green add dimension without overpowering the design. It feels focused and intense, much like Durant’s game, blending personal narrative with modern basketball performance aesthetics.

The Nike KD 18 Rain City was released on July 22, 2025 with a retail price of $155.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Washed Coral Dusty Cactus Metallic Silver Chalk
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Washed Coral Dusty Cactus Metallic Silver Chalk brings a vibrant edge to one of Nike’s most respected performance basketball lines. Washed Coral sets the tone across the upper, balanced by sharp hits of Dusty Cactus and Metallic Silver that give the shoe a fast and futuristic feel. The low cut silhouette keeps it agile, while the sculpted midsole and visible cushioning setup signal that this model is built for quick cuts and explosive movement.

Players and collectors alike gravitate toward the GT Cut series because it blends court level performance with standout design. This colorway feels energetic without losing control, using soft coral tones against cooler accents for contrast that pops under arena lights. It captures that modern Nike Basketball identity where innovation and bold color stories move together in sync.

The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Washed Coral Dusty Cactus Metallic Silver Chalk was released on March 27, 2025 with a retail price of $190.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Shattered
description:
Crisp, white, and light on your feet, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Shattered basketball performance sneakers bring an exceptional spring to every dunk. Full perforation brings a breathable freshness for stamina on the court.

With lightweight materials, Flywire cables and a minimal shank inside the shoe, the Nike Zoom GT won’t weight down your game. Containing full-length ZoomX foam inside the midsole, the spring in your step is plush and bouncy. Translucent soles made of rubber give a sticky step and stability on the court. Pure white with subtle black accents, such as the ZoomX text on the midsole, outline on the white glossy Swoosh and the GT 03 logo on the tongue, while subtle branding keeps it sophisticated.

We love how light these shoes are, for both on the court and off. If you prefer your shoes for lifestyle use, the clean white textile delivers on style. The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Shattered trainer was released on March 1, 2025, priced at $190.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low LX Metallic Silver Pink Foam (Women's)
colorway: Photon Dust/Metallic Silver-Pink Foam-Medium Soft Pink

shoeName: Nike Zoom Hyperflight Jason Williams
Nike Dunk Low Miami Dolphins
description: The Nike Dunk Low ‘Miami Dolphins’ stays true to the NFL franchise's colors with a white upper accented by turquoise heel and forefoot overlays. Contrasting orange pops land on the Swoosh and back tab. Perforations on the toe box keep the signature look, while a padded collar provides a comfortable feel the minute you lace them up. A foam wedge housed inside a sturdy cupsole keeps you comfortable, while a grippy rubber outsole delivers solid traction underfoot.

shoeName: Nike KD 4 Galaxy (2024)
description: The 2024 version of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Galaxy' throws it back to one of Nike's 2012 NBA All-Star Collection releases. These sneakers have an Adaptive Fit strap to secure the mesh upper, bolstered with fused synthetic overlays in a matching metallic silver and contrasted by an orange Swoosh. A starry graphic on the black Phylon midsole keeps it true to the cosmic theme, while a bouncy Zoom Air forefoot unit keeps the balance. A glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole completes the look in style.

shoeName: Nike Air Foamposite One Eggplant (2024)
description: The 2024 iteration of the Nike Air Foamposite One ‘Eggplant’ is made with a metallic purple molded Foamposite shell. The upper mixes contrasting black pops on the mesh collar and nubuck eyestay. An embroidered mini-Swoosh adorns the forefoot, while Penny Hardaway’s logo appears on the tongue and the back of the heel. These shoes have full-length Zoom Air cushioning for a soft feel underfoot and a carbon fiber spring plate to promote stability.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 '86 Jacquemus White (Women's)
description: The Jacquemus x Nike Women's Air Max 1 '86 'Big Bubble - Summit White' shoes rock a white leather upper accented with a quilted textile, using perforated side panels and a mini, molded chrome Swoosh. Both brands adorn each tongue, while the heel overlay showcases a debossed Jacquemus logo. A light grey suede mudguard introduces an off-white foam midsole, equipped with an Air window that shows through the sidewall. A rubber outsole wraps up the toe to finish the look.

shoeName: Nike NOCTA Glide Drake Black
description: Introducing an attention-grabbing design within the collaborative collection of NOCTA x Nike, the Glide 'Black White' showcases a striking silhouette under Drake's Nike sub-label. Drawing inspiration from the classic Nike Zoom Flight 95, this retro-inspired model stands out with its wavy foam midsole, featuring unique 'bug eye' accents embedded in the sidewall, and a translucent rubber outsole for added style. The upper combines breathable black mesh with black and white woven textile side panels. The tongue displays NOCTA branding, while each decorative eyelet proudly spells out 'NIKE.'

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Morse Code Cargo Khaki Croc
Nike Hot Step Air Terra Drake NOCTA Black Yellow
description: The NOCTA x Nike Hot Step Air Terra ‘Black University Gold’ adorns a black tumbled leather upper with 3M reflective accents bordering the tongue and eyestay. Yellow eyelets match the color of the mini-Swoosh on the toe box, NOCTA badge on the tongue, and the jeweled G-TEK heel logo on the outsole. A black and gold midsole takes cues from the Air Terra Humara, including an exposed Nike Air heel unit underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 NY vs. NY
description: The Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 'NY vs. NY' honors the annual streetball tournament showcasing New York's top high school basketball talent. The black leather upper is contrasted by a white leather mudguard and an Air Uptempo insignia on the heel. A powder blue trim pipes the white leather Swoosh, while another Swoosh decorates the black foam midsole, assisted with Air-sole cushioning in the heel and forefoot areas.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Year of the Horse
Nike SB Dunk Low Verdy Visty
description: The Verdy x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Visty' takes design cues from the Japanese artist's Visty character, using a furry green upper with textured pastel blue suede overlays. Hits of pink land on the leather Swoosh and hairy collar. The inside of the tongue tag sports a Visty graphic, while a cream yellow midsole rides on a light green rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 PRM Valentine’s Day Playful Pink
description: Part of the 'Valentine's Day Pack,' the Nike Air Max 1 Premium 'Playful Pink' dons a red mesh upper with a matching Swoosh and glossy pink synthetic overlays. 'It's not you, it's me' — is stamped throughout the laces, while a pink molded 'Nike' lace jewel nods to Valentine's Day balloons. These shoes have a red foam midsole equipped with an Air-sole heel unit underfoot.

shoeName: Nike KD 4 Christmas (2024)
description: The 2024 version of the Nike Zoom KD 4 'Christmas' brings to life Kevin Durant's signature holiday-themed colorway. Inspired by Christmas cookie cutters, these shoes have a copper-colored mesh upper with no-sew overlays. The 'KD' logo decorates the back heel, while the Swoosh graces the Adaptive Fit strap. A Phylon midsole keeps things soft underfoot, while a Zoom Air unit provides lightweight cushioning.

shoeName: Nike GT Cut 3 Bright Mango Bleached Coral
description:
The Nike GT Cut 3 Bright Mango Bleached Coral brings a vibrant, tropical inspired palette to this cutting edge basketball performance silhouette, combining bright mango, bleached coral, lightning, and mint foam into a genuinely energetic, warm weather appropriate presentation. The GT Cut line represents Nike's most advanced basketball performance technology, built for elite level agility and responsiveness. This third generation model continues refining the GT Cut's construction, delivering the vibrant, high visibility color storytelling the line has become known for.

The GT Cut line has established itself among basketball's most technically advanced performance platforms, giving players genuine quick cutting agility and responsiveness at the highest competitive levels. Bright mango and bleached coral together create a genuinely vibrant, tropical color story that distinguishes this release from more standard team colorway executions. Fans of both cutting edge basketball performance technology and vibrant, energetic colorways find this GT Cut 3 release a compelling way to engage with Nike's continued innovation in performance footwear.

The Nike GT Cut 3 Bright Mango Bleached Coral was released on July 1, 2025 with a retail price of $200

shoeName: Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low Supreme White Gum
description: The Supreme x Nike SB Air Max 2 CB '94 Low 'White Gum' has a layered white leather upper with round perforations that reveal a reflective mesh underlay. The Air Max and Supremelogos join forces on the rubberized tongue patch, while 'Nike SB Air' is embossed on the heel tab. The Supreme wordmark adorns the webbed heel pull tab, while a red Swoosh is debossed on the side of the white foam midsole — right above the Max Air heel unit. The gum rubber outsole brings surefire traction to every step.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Metallic Silver (2020/2025) (Women's)
description: Releasing for Air Max Day 2020, the Wmns Air Max 90 'Metallic Pack - Chrome' released as part of a three-shoe Metallic Pack. Celebrating 30 years of the retro runner, the shoe's upper features a chrome finish throughout its classic construction. Underfoot, the contrasting white midsole houses visible Air in the heel for cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Black Canvas
Nike ReactX Rejuven8 Smoke Grey
description: The Nike ReactX Rejuven8 'Smoke Grey' rolls out a one-piece design accented with wavy lines etched across the sides and vent perforations throughout the upper. A molded Swoosh decorates the side panel, while a 'Nike React' signoff is debossed on the footbed. The ReactX midsole couples with a rubber outsole that uses a radial pattern for surefire traction.

shoeName: Nike ZoomX Invincible Run 3 Oreo
description: The Nike ZoomX Invincible Run Flyknit 3 'Oreo' rocks a Flyknit upper comprised of black and white yarns. Those yarns are woven with targeted zones that help prevent feet from overheating. Black speckles dust the full-length ZoomX foam midsole, shaped specifically to support all three phases of a runner's stride.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Drive Drake NOCTA Summit White
description: Bringing a running silhouette back from 1999, the NOCTA x Nike Air Zoom Drive 'Summit White' rocks a white knit and mesh upper, accented by leather panels and 3M reflective underlays. An embroidered mini-Swoosh embellishes the toe box, while the NOCTA logo graces the webbed pull tabs at the heel and tongue. A sculpted foam midsole is equipped with an exposed Zoom Air heel unit for lightweight cushioning.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 23 LeBronto
description: The Nike LeBron 23 'LeBronto' nods to the franchise LeBron James has tormented in the playoffs. The red knit upper has an allover pattern depicting a streaking meteorite. A copper Crown Containment System gets a scaly texture throughout and a raptor skull graphic on the heel. A drop-in ZoomX foam midsole keeps things plush underfoot, while a partially see-through rubber outsole swift provides traction on the court.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Smoke Grey Black Photon Dust
Nike Air Force 1 Low Shadow Black Pink Spell (Women's)
Nike Air More Uptempo Low Black Photon Dust
Nike Air Max 1 CLOT Kiss of Death (2021)
description: Bringing back a collaborative colorway from 2006, the CLOT x Air Max 1 ‘Kiss of Death’ 2021 released in 2021. The shoe’s upper features the same deconstructed tan suede upper as its predecessor, with transparent paneling on the toe box and a scaly Swoosh. Underfoot, a visible Max Air unit provides cushioning, giving way to a translucent rubber outsole that sports an updated multicolor reflexology-inspired graphic.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Harris Tweed Sesame (Women's)
description: The Harris Tweed x Nike Women's Dunk Low 'Sesame' replaces the classic leather build in favor of an upper crafted from Harris Tweed wool. The beige upper has a minimalist herringbone pattern, while brown forefoot and heel overlays match the Swoosh to maintain the earthy palette. Exposed zigzag stitching surrounds a the Harris Tweed label. A pre-yellowed midsole stays true to the worn-in aesthetic, anchored by a dark brown rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 8 Year of the Horse (2026) (GS)
description: The 2026 version of the Nike Kobe 8 Protro GS 'Year of the Horse' takes after the 2014 release, sporting a patterned red mesh upper with a metallic gold Swoosh. Kobe Bryant's iconic Sheath logo decorates the tongue, while a blue collar lining matches the herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. This Protro edition gets a drop-in React foam midsole, housed within a plush Phylon carrier.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Low 77 Black White
Nike SB Dunk Low Polaroid
description: Inspired by the original instant camera, the Nike Dunk Low SB x Polaroid delivers a colorful take on the lifestyle skate shoe. The upper arrives in black nubuck, with white leather on the back heel piece featuring a debossed Polaroid photo logo. A stacked trio of colored Swooshes in red, yellow and blue adorn the profiles, while a small line of embroidery continues the technicolor theme. Co-branding can be found on the sockliner, along with 'Nike' and 'Polaroid' stitched on the back heel.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Summit White Daybreak
description: The Kobe Bryant x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Summit White Daybreak' has a snakeskin print engulfing the white leather upper, contrasted by a purple knit lining. A purple Sheath logo lands on the tongue tag, heel, vamp and outsole. Kobe Bryant's '8' and '24' jersey numbers are embroidered on the heel tabs of the left and right shoe, respectively.

shoeName: Nike Ja 3 SE Outer Space (GS)
description: The Nike Ja 3 GS 'Outer Space' rocks a grey mesh upper complemented with mismatched colors on the tongue as well as a red and a blue Swoosh. The lateral side of both shoes has the name 'Ja' spelled out with a black vertical Swoosh piped in red, along with a blue overlay comprised of raised Ja logos. Mismatched insoles showcase a lunar surface graphic on the left shoe and a nebula scene on the right. The pale blue rubber outsole engulfs the sidewalls of the ZoomX foam midsole for more all-around traction.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Setsubun (2022)
description: An annual festival that celebrates the first day of spring in Japan's old calendar inspires the Nike Dunk Low Premium ‘Setsubun.’ The essence of the festival, which is intended to dismiss bad luck and evil spirits from the previous year, is echoed in the low-top's details. The leather upper in beige has a lightly crackled surface with brown and tan overlays. An image of Japanese warrior Tsuno Daishi is stitched on the lateral heel in purple, with playful Swooshes-as-horns. Additional purple hits appear in the signature Swoosh and lining of the collar. Artist Utagawa Kuniyoshi created the sockliner graphics that picture folk hero Kintarō.

shoeName: Nike P-6000 Anthracite Smoke Grey
description: The Nike P-6000 Premium 'Anthracite Smoke Grey' uses drawcord-style laces on a weather-resistant black mesh upper. The latter is bolstered with grey suede and nubuck overlays, while reflective details adorn the toe cap, heel counter and Swoosh for better visibility in low-light conditions. A full-length Phylon midsole makes every step soft and responsive.

shoeName: Nike Free RN 5.0 Next Nature White Obsidian
Nike Dunk Low Off-White Lot 1
description: The Off-White x Dunk Low 'Dear Summer - 01 of 50' is the debut colorway of the Dear Summer collection. Built with a mix of canvas and leather, the shoe's upper appears in white, with silver Swoosh branding highlighting the side wall. Rope laces worked through Flywire cables secure the fit alongside traditional laces, while an exposed-foam tongue and pre-yellowed midsole come together to add to the aesthetic. A white plastic zip tie, off-center tongue tag and Helvetica text on the medial side add signature Virgil Abloh hits.

shoeName: Nike SB Dunk Low Light Carbon Monarch
description: The Nike Dunk Low SB 'Light Carbon Monarch' uses suede on the upper instead of traditional leather. The orange base is contrasted by slate grey accents on the forefoot and heel overlay. A beige Swoosh sweeps serves as a break from the stark contrast. The off-white midsole contains a Zoom Air heel unit, undergirded by a green rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 LV8 Phychic Blue White Patent
Nike SB Dunk Low Club 58 Gulf
description: Releasing as a follow-up to the Blazer Mid 'Club 58' from 2018, the Dunk Low Pro SB 'Gulf' was made in collaboration with four prominent Western European skate shops. The shoe's upper is built with suede, finsihed in Blue Chill and contrasted by the Swoosh branding and '58' graphic. A stuffed mesh tongue supports the fit, while underfoot, Zoom Air provides cushioning. A Safety Orange finish on the rubber outsole completes the look.

shoeName: Nike KD 17 Light Iron Ore Metallic Gold
description:
The Nike KD 17 Light Iron Ore Metallic Gold is a stunning addition to Kevin Durant's signature line, combining performance and style in one sleek package. This men's basketball shoe features a light iron ore upper, accented with eye-catching metallic gold details that add a touch of luxury to the court. The innovative design incorporates Nike's latest technology to provide superior comfort, support, and responsiveness for players of all levels.

Engineered for optimal performance, the KD 17 boasts a responsive cushioning system that adapts to your movements, ensuring a smooth and explosive game. The durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction on various surfaces, while the breathable upper keeps your feet cool during intense play. With its stylish colorway and advanced features, the Nike KD 17 Light Iron Ore Metallic Gold is perfect for both competitive games and casual wear.

Our experts state this product is great for basketball enthusiasts and sneaker collectors alike, offering a perfect blend of performance, comfort, and style that lives up to Kevin Durant's high standards on and off the court.

shoeName: Nike Kobe 5 Protro Bruce Lee
description: Released in November 2020, the Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'Bruce Lee' brings back a 2010 colorway. Inspired by Bruce Lee, whose style and mindset in turn inspired Kobe Bryant, the shoe's upper draws from Lee's jumpsuit in Enter the Dragon. The black and Del Sol look is highlighted by Comet Red scratch marks the forefoot, while Flywire cables support the fit. Underfoot, the two-tone midsole houses Zoom Air in the forefoot for cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Retro Premium Philly
description: The Nike Dunk Low Premium 'Philly' honors the City of Brotherly Love by rocking green shoelaces, marked with Philadelphia's geographic coordinates. These shoes have a white tumbled leather upper and contrasting greyscale accents like a hairy suede heel overlay and a mottled leather forefoot overlay. The Swoosh gets a light grey cracked leather, while the back tab is stamped a 'Philly' multicolor signoff. Thoese same colorful touches land on the Nike-branded tongue tag and knit lining. A white midsole, anchored by a dark grey rubber outsole wraps up the look.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Off-White Volt
description: The OFF-WHITE x Air Force 1 ‘Volt’ goes a different direction from Virgil Abloh’s Nike previous designs, emphasizing a neon hue from the Swoosh’s custom palette that the designer had left untouched. It dresses the sneaker's mixed-material upper as well as its laces and midsole. Hits of black bring a subtle variety to the Swoosh and medial-side quarter panel, which displays Virgil’s trademark text.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 Crepe Soft Grey
description: The Nike Air Max 1 Premium 'Crepe Soft Grey' elevates the classic '87 running shoe with a deluxe construction that exudes a muted and versatile greyscale color scheme. The upper’s grey woven canvas base is complemented by overlays in matching pigskin leather. Tonal Nike branding is present on the tongue tag and heel overlay while a crisp white leather Swoosh creates a striking contrast on the quarter panel. The shoe's lightweight cushioning system is delivered by a foam midsole in off-white that houses an exposed Max Air unit in the heel. The midsole is anchored by a sturdy crepe rubber outsole that offers excellent traction and durability.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Tattoo Light Violet Ore (Women's)
Nike SB Dunk High Pro Ishod Wair x Magnus Walker
description: The Ishod Wair x Magnus Walker x Dunk High Pro SB 'Urban Outlaw' was released with the help of pro skater Ishod Wair and fellow LA car enthusiast Magnus Walker. Getting its name from Walker's short film, which features a custom Porsch 911 in the same hues and designs that appear on the shoe, a Union Jack makes an appearance on the model, with various racing-style visuals appering throughout the cracked white leather upper. The upper itself includes a wearaway outer layer that reveals gold, while the collar linings of the shoes sport mismatched red and blue tartan plaid. Underfoot, the midsole incorporates a distressed finish, with a tritone rubber outsole included for traction.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 20 PRM Mimi Plange Ceremony
description:
The Nike LeBron 20 Premium Mimi Plange Ceremony was released to honor culture and mark two decades of collaboration between LeBron James and Nike.

Dressing a textile knit on the upper, the Nike LeBron 20 features vibrantly colored bright crimson floral patterns on the vamp. More scarlet flowers are embroidered on the quarter panels, covering most of the midfoot. Also on the panels are the Nike swooshes, which intertwine on the lateral side. The heel extends the bright Crimson-on-White colorway but introduces some branding. LeBron’s crown logo is plastered on a reed patch on the heel counter, while Mimi Plange’s brand motif is embroidered on the red mustache in a bold berry tone.

The lace-up closure on the Nike LeBron 20 Premium Mimi Plange Ceremony is among its most outstanding features. Multicolor laces inspired by the Maasai community of Tanzania rest on a woven, bold-berry-colored tongue. This shoe was released on September 9th, 2023, for $250.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Cactus Plant Flea Market Fuchsia Dream
description: The Cactus Plant Flea Market x Nike Air Force 1 Low Premium 'Fuchsia Dream' sports a tumbled leather upper in different fuchsia hues. Large logos, inspired by the Air More Uptempo, are piped in reflective details for an eye-catching look. 'Air' is inscribed on one side of the right shoe, while a wraparound 'Sunshine' wordmark adorns the left shoe. These kicks have a sturdy rubber cupsole that matches the upper.

shoeName: Nike Shox Ride 2 Black
description: The Nike Shox Ride 2 'Black' brings a blackout mesh upper complemented with synthetic leather and synthetic overlays for support. Round Nike Shox badges on the tongue and heel tab denote the signature design. The midsole contains Air-Sole units in the forefoot and four Shox pillars under the heel for springy cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Phoenix Black Anthracite
description: The Nike Air Max Phoenix 'Triple Black' carries a minimalist black knit upper wrapped in a matching pin-dot pattern. The heel counter is stamped with a retro-inspired Air Max logo for a vintage aesthetic. A matching black foam midsole contains a 270-degree Max Air heel unit for impact protection and a comfortable feel.

Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Laser Paisley Graphite
Nike Dunk Low Retro SE Pale Ivory Baroque Brown
description: The Nike Dunk Low SE 'Baroque Brown Pale Ivory' has a rubber cupsole with stitched sidewalls. The off-white leather upper is complemented with brown suede overlays and a matching suede Swoosh. The Nike logo appears on the tongue tag, back tab and insoles, while a perforated toe box keeps the classic Dunk look intact.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Vintage Green
description: The Nike Dunk Low 'Vintage Green' carries a white leather upper with dark green overlays and a matching Swoosh. The Nike logo appears on the tongue tag, back tab and insoles. These shoes have a white midsole undergirded by a green rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Book 2 SE Detroit Lions
