Nike GT Future .SWOOSH Swooshman
description:
The Nike GT Future SWOOSH Swooshman is a March 2026 release of Nike's GT Future basketball lifestyle silhouette in the Swooshman colorway, featuring a Metallic Silver upper with University Red and Black accents that applies the GT Future's elongated, futuristic low-profile design to a high-contrast metallic and red color story with the Swooshman branding identifying this as a specific graphic-driven execution within the GT Future's seasonal colorway range. The GT Future is a lifestyle basketball silhouette from Nike's Greater Than line that translates the performance basketball design language of the GT series into a lower-profile, lifestyle-ready format, with the extended midsole geometry, layered upper construction, and elongated toe profile giving the GT Future its distinctive appearance that reads as a basketball shoe evolved for off-court wearing rather than on-court competition. The Metallic Silver base creates the most reflective and most visually striking expression of the GT Future's upper paneling, with the large-scale Swoosh and branding elements reading with maximum contrast against the silver ground and connecting to the shoe's identity through the University Red Swoosh that serves as the primary color accent. Released March 20, 2026 at $210 retail via SNKRS and select Nike Basketball retailers.

The Nike GT Future SWOOSH Swooshman was released on March 20, 2026 with a retail price of $210.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Black Metallic Dark Grey Croc
Nike Air Max 1 Patta Waves White Hyper Crimson (With Bracelet)
Nike P-6000 Phantom Mink Brown (Women's)
Nike Air Force 1 Low Kobe Bryant Forever Lower Merion Away
description: The Kobe Bryant x Nike Air Force 1 Low 'Lower Merion' honors the Lakers legend's high school alma mater. These sneakers have a red leather upper wrapped in a snakeskin print. Bryant's Sheath logo graces the tongue tag and heel, while mismatched back tabs are stamped with a spade symbol on the left shoe and Bryant's high school jersey number '33' on the right. 'Mamba Forever' lace dubraes complete this classic look.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Flight 95 OG Black Metallic Silver (2022)
Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Sapphire
Nike Air Max 90 Animal Pack (Women's)
Nike Air Force 1 Low Gore-Tex Vibram Clay Green
description: The Nike Air Force 1 GORE-TEX 'Clay Green' makes use of a waterproof GORE-TEX membrane covering the muted green leather upper, contrasted with a black leather Swoosh and heel tab. The latter rocks a debossed Nike Air logo, while lace jewels are stamped with mismatched AF1 and GORE-TEX logos. A black foam midsole contains encapsulated Air-Sole cushioning, anchored by an updated Vibram rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Uptempo 95 Black Volt
description: The 2025 version of the Nike Air Max Uptempo 'Black Volt' makes use of a speed lacing system to secure the black nubuck upper, tooled with a matching Swoosh piped in a fluorescent embroidery. 'Air' is spelled out on the eyestay is neon letters. A black patent leather mudguard makes way for a matching black Phylon midsole equipped with a full-length visible Max Air unit.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Mid Stussy Light Bone Black
description: The Nike Air Force 1 Mid collaboration with Stussy, in the 'Black White' colorway, showcases a minimalistic, two-tone design. The mid-top silhouette features an upper in all-white leather intersected by black overlays and matching Swoosh. The sneaker features co-branded tongue tags, an embroidered Stussy logo on the ankle strap, and the 'SS' emblem on the heel tab, which is also perforated on the toe box. The classic rubber cupsole is white with a black pivot point tread outsole for comfort and grip underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low PRM Halloween (2023)
description: Designed for Halloween, the Nike Air Force 1 Low Premium 'Headless Horseman' features a black tumbled leather upper with snakeskin-textured forefoot and heel overlays in the same tone. The sturdy rubber cupsole with black sidewalls rests on a marbled rubber outsole in vivid Green Strike. Silver Jack-o'-lantern dubrae charms adorn the waxed black laces, and the custom sockliners feature an illustration of a Jack-o'-lantern set against a haunted forest. To introduce a subtle pop of color, an orange Nike tag adorns the tongue.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Off-White MCA University Blue
description: The OFF-WHITE x Air Force 1 Low '07 'MCA' released to help celebrate Virgil Abloh's exhibit at the Museum of Contemporary Art in Chicago in June 2019. Bruce Kilgore's basketball classic gets reimagined with Abloh's signature deconstructed look, sporting prominent stitching on the Swoosh and an exposed-foam tongue and collar. The leather upper appears primarily in University Blue, while the usual over-the-top branding emerges on the laces and medial side. A tonal sole unit includes the usual Air cushioning and concentric traction pattern.

shoeName: Nike Air Tailwind 79 Antarctica
description: The Air Tailwind 79 'Antarctica' features a neutral look on the first Nike shoe to house Air technology. The shoe's upper is built with nylon and suede overlays, finished in Wolf Grey. The leather Swoosh and heel patch accent the look in Antarctica, while underfoot, the midsole includes the signature Air cushioning, giving way to a waffle pattern on the outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 4 Bruce Lee
Nike Shox TL Hyper Royal
description: The Nike Shox TL 'Hyper Royal' rolls out a blue nylon upper with a matching cage and synthetic leather heel overlay. Piped in blue, a metallic silver Swoosh decorates the side panel, while a Nike Shox logo lands on the reflective silver heel panel. A soft foam midsole contains foam pillars for impact protection and a comfortable feel underfoot. The rubber outsole gets a modified waffle tread for enhanced traction.

shoeName: Nike C1TY Black Summit White
description: The Nike C1TY 'Black Summit White' carries a black mesh and suede upper with a contrasting white leather Swoosh. Green touches land on the Nike tongue tag and insoles, while reflective details land on the toe box and midfoot perforations. A matching black cupsole has an inner foam wedge and a lugged rubber outsole for sturdy traction.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Pink Velvet (GS)
description: The Nike Dunk Low GS 'Pink Glaze' is built for older kids and features a leather upper that pairs a clean white base with soft pink overlays. The latter hue is repeated on the plush textile lining and velvet heel tab, branded with an embroidered Nike wordmark in red lettering. Extra crimson accents are on the woven tongue tag and sockliner with the shoe being mounted on a white rubber midsole with an underfoot that has a lightly speckled pink rubber made with 15% Nike Grind.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 9 Big Bang (2022)
description: LeBron James debuted this colorwary during the 2012 All-Star Game, featuring a space theme. Returning true to form, the LeBron 9 ‘Big Bang’ arrives in a bright orange hue, with the interior lining and insole display cosmic imagery, while the outsole glows in the dark. The upper features Hyperfuse technology while a large volume Max Air bag in the heel offers lightweight cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Rift Leather Triple Black (Women's)
Nike SB Zoom Blazer Mid Black White
Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Elite FG Black Deep Jungle
description: Part of the 2024 'Shadow Pack,' the Nike Tiempo Legend 10 Elite FG 'Black' carries a blackout FlyTouch Plus engineered leather upper. The strike zone contains All Conditions Control, a grippy texture that enhances your touch on the ball, even in wet conditions. Soft, stretchy Flyknit surround the ankle for a snug feel. The outsole plate has a series of bladed studs in the forefoot and cone studs in the heel, bringing you the ideal traction for short-grass pitches.

shoeName: Nike KD 18 B.A.D.
colorway: Washed Purple/Fire Pink/Lilac Hemp/Cave Purple/Pearl White
description: The Nike KD 18 'Washed Purple Pink Lilac' honors Kevin Durant's grandmother, Barbara A. Davis, who once told a young KD his height was a gift. The beige open-cell mesh upper gets hairy lavender suede overlays. A lilac-hued midfoot cage is built into the shoelaces for midfoot lockdown. Durant's logo adorns the tongue, while the inside portion displays his grandmother's initials: 'B.A.D.' A Cushlon foam midsole is tooled with a springy Zoom Air forefoot unit for a springy feel on the court.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low SP Undefeated Ballistic Dunk vs. AF1
description: The Undefeated x Air Force 1 Low SP released as part of the Dunk vs. AF-1 pack. Inspired by a very limited Dunk HIgh collaboration from 2003—and reissued in 2013—the shoe emerges with a ballistic mesh construction on the upper, finished in olive green and overlaid by tonal leather. Black Swoosh branding contrasts the side wall, while the lateral heel and woven tongue tag include a Five Strikes logo. 'Dunk vs. AF-1' emerges on the insole, and underfoot, the off-white midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a concentric rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 2 The Bridge (Women's)
Nike Air Force 1 Low Fauna Brown Croc
Nike Kobe 6 Protro Challenge Red All-Star (2021)
description: Reintroducing a colorway that Kobe Bryant wore during the 2011 NBA All-Star Game, the Nike Zoom Kobe 6 Protro 'All-Star' 2021 is a low-top that features a full-length Cushlon midsole with a large Air Zoom Turbo unit in the front for enhanced comfort. The shoe's upper is made of micro-mesh with polyurethane scales, and showcases a red-and-black gradient blend. Kobe’s personal logo is on the tongue and his signature adorns the molded heel counter.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low LAAMS Please Post Bills
description: The LAAMS x Nike Air Force 1 'Please Post Bills' is inspired by New York's ubiquitous plywood walls, painted green and as a way to tuck away buildings that are under construction or renovations. These shoes have a forest green leather upper accented with a subtle woodgrain graphic. Cream-hued leather details are present on the Swoosh as well as the Nike-branded back tab. The insoles have a collage of original artwork taken from five years of event flyers made by the LAAMS team.

shoeName: Nike Air DT Max '96 Colorado Away White Black
description: The Nike Air DT Max '96 'Colorado Away' showcase Deion Sanders' signature shoes inspired by the Buffaloes' road uniforms. The leather upper is secured with an adjustable midfoot strap, getting a contrasting black leather underlay. A gold mini-Swoosh is embroidered on the side of the ankle for an eye-catching look. A lightweight foam midsole comes equipped with a visible Max Air heel unit for plush cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low Off-White Black White
description: Virgil Abloh launches a fairly upfront redesign of Bruce Kilgore’s silhouette with this OFF-WHITE x Air Force 1 Low. Yet there are plenty of new flourishes on the rebuild: in addition to a blend of ripstop and suede, the upper uses taped seams and a white Swoosh attached via zigzag stitching. Exposed foam and unusually placed tags appear on the tongue, while the final postmodern touch arrives with the word ‘LOGO’ printed on the heel tab.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Next Nature White Black (Women's)
Nike Air Max 90 Speed Red
Nike Ja 1 USA
description:
The Nike Ja 1 USA brings Ja Morant's debut signature basketball model into a patriotic team USA themed colorway, combining midnight navy with white and university red for a genuine national pride presentation. This USA theming ties Morant's explosive, highlight reel signature shoe to broader themes of American basketball excellence and national team representation. As his first signature model, the Ja 1 represents a foundational moment within Morant's growing basketball footwear legacy.

Ja Morant has established himself as one of the most electrifying and must watch players in the league, and this debut signature shoe captures that same explosive energy through considered performance construction. The USA colorway gives this foundational release genuine patriotic significance, appealing to collectors who appreciate national team themed basketball footwear. Fans of both Morant's rising star power and his growing signature shoe legacy find this Ja 1 USA release a meaningful, historically significant addition to their collection given its status as his debut model.

The Nike Ja 1 USA was released on July 1, 2024 with a retail price of $120.

shoeName: Nike Air DT Max '96 Black White (2024)
description: The 2024 version of the Nike Air Diamond Turf Max '96 'Black Varsity Maize' is a throwback Deion Sanders model. These shoes have an adjustable midfoot strap, which secures a white leather upper with black nubuck overlays. Embroidered gold Swooshes embellish various portions of the upper, while webbed pull tabs on the back allow for easy entry. A full-length foam midsole packs an exposed Max Air heel unit for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus Triple Black (GS)
Nike Dunk Low SE Gone Fishing Rainbow Trout
description: Delivered in an extravagant fish-inspired design, the Nike Dunk Low SE 'Gone Fishing - Rainbow Trout' reimagines the classic basketball shoe with inspiration from various trout species such as brook, rainbow, and cutthroat. Its ripstop upper is adorned with intricate spotted patterns and complemented by shaggy suede overlays in a deep green shade, adding texture and depth. Branding details include an orange suede Nike wordmark debossed on the back tab, a woven trout tag prominently displayed on the vibrant orange ripstop tongue and a scaly iridescent leather Swoosh. The heel and custom sockliner display hits of pink. Anchoring the sneaker underfoot is a cream-colored rubber cupsole that stands out with contrasting orange stitching, combining style and durability.

shoeName: Nike Air Trainer SC High LA Rams
description: Originally made famous by Bo Jackson, the Air Trainer SC High 'Los Angeles Rams' gives the nod to the Los Angeles Rams. The shoe's upper is built with leather, finished in navy and highlighted by Aqua on the Swoosh branding and forefoot overlay. Yellow mesh straps are worked into the brown pebbled leather eyestay, while underfoot, a white EVA midsole with visible Air in the heel provides cushioning and contrast.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Premium Realtree Camo Off Noir
Nike Air Max Plus French Football Federation
description: The Nike Air Max Plus 'French Football Federation' has a gradient blue mesh upper complemented with a plastic cage inspired by palm trees swaying in the wind. A metallic copper Swoosh matches the Gallic rooster graphic on the tongue. These shoes sport a navy foam midsole with forefoot and heel Air-Sole units that bring plush cushioning. The plastic shank underfoot enhances arch support and midfoot stability.

shoeName: Nike Shox TL Fade Off Noir White (Women's)
Nike Vomero Plus Running is Mental

shoeName: Nike Air Trainer 1 White Midnight Navy Medium Grey
description: The Nike Air Trainer 1 ‘Midnight Navy’ sports a white leather upper with grey suede overlays and an adjustable navy forefoot strap for a bit of contrast. A matching Swoosh adorns the sides, while red Nike Air letters grace the heel. The foam midsole packs encapsulated Air-sole cushioning and an outrigger for a stable feel with every step.

shoeName: Nike Air DT Max '96 Love Letter to Connie
description: A tribute to Deion Sanders' mother, the Nike Air DT Max '96 'Love Letter to Connie' has an Air-sole foam midsole that matches the red nubuck upper. Irregular cutouts showcase a red tumbled leather underlay, while Deion Sanders' emblem adorns the tongue tag. A white mini-Swoosh graces the midfoot strap, heel, and both sides of the ankle.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 720 Undercover Red
description: The Undercover x Air Max 720 ‘University Red’ brings Jun Takahashi’s unique design vision to Nike’s maximalist lifestyle runner. The sneaker’s synthetic upper is finished in a bold shade of University red, accented with speckled detailing on the podular insert and midsole. Lightweight cushioning comes courtesy of the 720 Air unit, printed with Takahashi’s tagline, ‘WE MAKE NOISE NOT CLOTHES.’

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 USA (2024)
Nike Air Force 1 High Triple Black
description:
The Nike Air Force 1 High Triple Black (2017-2020) is a high-top Air Force 1 sneaker in a ‘Triple Black’ colorway.

This sneaker features an all-black smooth leather upper with a tonal Swoosh on the laterals and medials. Other details include tonal laces, an ankle strap, a perforated toe box, tonal branding on the tongue tag, and an oval-shaped silver dubrae with the trademark ‘AF1’ branding. The traditional Air Force 1 sole unit in an all-black tone matching the upper rounds out this sneaker’s design. 

The Nike Air Force 1 High Triple Black (2017-2020) was made available on January 1, 2017 for a retail price of $100.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 270 Black
Nike Air Max 90 Futura Tan (Women's)
Nike Vaporwaffle sacai Sesame Blue Void
description: Made in collaboration with Chitose Abe's Tokyo fashion label, the sacai x VaporWaffle 'Sesame Blue Void' emerges with retro and modern inspiration. Drawing from the 1983 Pegasus and the VaporFly, the shoe's hybrid construction is built with textile on the upper, overlaid by leather and suede and finished in neutral tones. Blue Void marks one of the Swooshes and the heel patch, while two tongues add to the double aesthetic. Underfoot, a layered foam midsole provides cushioning, split at the heel, giving way to a waffle rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Vomero 5 Gym Red Chrome
description: The Nike Zoom Vomero 5 'Gym Red Chrome' rolls out a red mesh upper with a matching red midfoot cage. Gleaming metallic silver accents land on the signature Swoosh, along with synthetic leather overlays that frame the toe. Matte silver synthetic overlays complete the look, while the Cushlon midsole is aided by Zoom Air technology in the forefoot as well as the heel.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Dawn Coconut Milk Red Navy
Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White
description:
The Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White is a slide that borrows design inspiration from the Nike Air More Uptempo sneaker.

The Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White features black synthetic leather upper with white accents. The slide boosts a full-length foam midsole that provides lightweight cushioning and support. In addition, the foam midsole is designed to absorb impact and improve energy return, ensuring that every step feels comfortable and effortless. The sole has a flexible design that allows for natural movement of the foot and the outsole is made of durable rubber that provides grip and traction on various surfaces.

We think the biggest draw of this shoe is the iconic "AIR" branding on the sides, which pays homage to the classic Nike Air Max design. This bold branding gives this sneaker a unique and unmistakable look. The Nike Air More Uptempo Slide OG Black White was released on April 4th, 2023 at a retail price of $85.

shoeName: Nike GT Future LX All-Star Warning Label
description:
The Nike GT Future All Star Warning Label embraces bold experimentation through a multi color palette built for the spotlight. Black anchors the design, while vibrant tones layer across the upper with dynamic contrast. The futuristic silhouette emphasizes sharp angles and performance intent, aligning with the forward thinking identity of the GT series. Every detail feels tuned for high energy moments.

All Star releases are meant to stand apart, and this pair fully leans into that mindset. The mix of colors creates movement and visual intensity that mirrors the pace of the game’s brightest stage. It captures innovation and spectacle in equal measure. Daring and expressive, this edition represents the future of on court style.

The Nike GT Future All Star Warning Label was released on February 13, 2026 with a retail price of $240.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 2 Black Phantom Orange
description:
The Nike Air Zoom G.T. Cut 2 Black Phantom Orange comes in black and uses an athletics-inspired design with a well-thought-out color scheme to establish its character.

On the tongue of the Nike Air Zoom G.T. Cut 2 is a cheerful mascot that sets the tone for the rest of the shoe. Black webbing eyelets hold laces of a similar color and drop downwards to a black upper. The vamp has a degree of opacity, showing orange hues beneath. The mudguard features a dark-toned material that tucks under a black outsole. The outer rubber sole is a multi-color with black, white, and orange instances.

Our experts think the best feature of the Nike Air Zoom G.T. Cut 2 Black Phantom Orange is its design-heavy heel. The heel notch is orange and features black triangular perforations. A bulge of the heel counter displays a black ribbed pattern on a white heel stabilizer. This shoe retailed at $170 on March1st, 2023 when it was released.

shoeName: Nike LeBron 8 Space Jam
description: Dropping to celebrate the release of Space Jam: A New Legacy, the Space Jam x LeBron 8 'A New Legacy' brings a contrasting look to LeBron James' retro 2010 model. Built with nubuck, the shoe's upper appears in black, with iridescent Flywire-infused paneling securing the fit. Hits of orange highlight the look throughout, including the outline of the Swoosh branding, while the collar and lateral quarter panel add circuit board graphics to call out the movie's antagonist. A Tune Squad tongue tag adds to the thematic look, as do Bugs Bunny on the right heel and LeBron James' cartoon likeness on the left. Underfoot, visible Max Air in the midsole provides cushioning, with a glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: Nike KD 3 Christmas (2023)
description: Originally released in 2010, the Nike KD 3 'Christmas' brings back a holiday-inspired colorway of Kevin Durant’s third signature sneakers. They have a yellow leather upper and an orange-and-blue Swoosh that nod to the Oklahoma City Thunder. These shoes have a comfortable Phylon midsole that rides on a Zoom Air unit while Flywire technology keeps the laces snug.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Mid 77 Vintage Black Sail
Nike Air Force 1 Low Ducks of a Feather University of Oregon Duck or Egg
description: The Nike Air Force 1 DOAF Oregon 'Duck or Egg' PE brings a "hatchling" theme to the iconic silhouette. The design features a soft yellow and gold suede upper with a fuzzy flocked textile Swoosh and a lush terry cloth lining. A hatched duck egg is embroidered on the heel, while alternating "DOAF" and "Nike Air" logos land on the tongue tags. The inside of the tongue features the playful "Which Came First?" signoff, completing the storytelling design.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Cortez SP sacai White University Red Blue
description: Presented with a modern twist by designer Chitose Abe, the sacai x Nike Zoom Cortez SP 'OG' marks the 50th anniversary of the classic running shoe. The unique double-themed design is back, featuring a white nylon upper with a second collar and tongue in navy. The retro leather Swoosh and the heel tab with both brand logos are red, while stacked layers in royal blue and gray suede give the shoe depth. The foam midsole is updated with a raised heel piece and exposed Zoom Air cushioning at the front.

shoeName: Nike Zoom Mercurial Superfly 9 Elite FG Lemonade
Nike Air Max 90 Infrared (2020)
description: Releasing to celebrate 30 years of the silhouette, the Air Max 90 'Infrared' 2020 features the silhouette's OG colorway. Built with a white mesh base, the shoe's upper includes grey synthetic suede overlays and a black leather mudguard. The TPU badges and lower eyelets highlight the look in Radiant Red, matched underfoot by the Max Air window that surrounds the signature cushioning system. A waffle rubber outsole is included for traction.

shoeName: Nike Air Max Plus Desert Sunset
Nike Air Max Plus OG Voltage Purple (2024)
Nike Book 1 1995 All-Star
description: The Nike Book 1 '1995 All-Star' takes cues from the jerseys worn by the 1995 Eastern Conference All-Star Team, which was held in Phoenix. The purple-colored upper is made from a mix of suede, mesh, and leather. Teal embroidery pipes the black patent leather Swoosh, while four embroidered orange stars adorn the heel. A 'Book' signoff on the tongue tag decorates the minimalist design, while Devin Booker's jersey number '1' is embroidered on the forefoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 London
description: Part of a two-shoe pack alongside an 'Amsterdam' colorway, the Air Max 1 City Pack 'London' draws from the capital of England. The shoe's upper features a mixed-material build in a series of grey hues, complemented by Valerian Blue on the Swoosh branding. River Thames embroidery runs through the heel branding, while the forefoot overlay includes depictions of the London Eye and Big Ben. Underfoot, Max Air in the heel provides cushioning.

shoeName: Nike KD 17 Penny
description:
The Nike KD 17 Penny merges Nike's cutting-edge technology with nostalgic design elements, giving you a fresh take on basketball shoes. The shoe redefines comfort and style for the modern athlete by combining a bold aesthetic with performance-focused materials.

The Penny version of the KD 17 by Nike features a striking upper made with lightweight mesh and synthetic overlays that increase breathability and add to the structure. This edition comes with a deep-blue and black palette with sleek silver accents, a small nod to Penny Hardaway’s classic colors. The midsole uses full-length Nike Zoom Air cushioning for responsive support, which adds stability for dynamic movements, while a sturdy rubber outsole offers multidirectional traction. This model is an excellent addition to Nike’s basketball heritage, thanks to the innovative use of materials and bold color accents.

We appreciate the classic upper pattern resembling waves, and the round toe cap that is part of the line. Released on April 26, 2024, the Nike KD 17 Penny retailed at $150.

shoeName: Nike Sabrina 2 TB College Navy Dark Obsidian Photo Blue White (Women's)
Nike SB Dunk Low Staple Panda Pigeon
description: The Jeff Staple x Dunk Low Pro SB ‘Panda Pigeon’ extends Staple’s enduring collaboration with Nike SB. The moniker lives up to its name with a black and white pattern on the leather and suede upper, finished with the integral pigeon on the lateral heel. A translucent outsole displays a collage of newspaper headlines referring to the legendary Pigeon Dunk launch from 2005.

shoeName: Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 Barely Volt
description:
The Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 Barely Volt is a cutting-edge basketball shoe designed for optimal performance on the court. Featuring a vibrant Barely Volt/Volt/Metallic colorway, this shoe combines style with functionality. The upper is crafted with lightweight, breathable materials that provide excellent support and flexibility, allowing players to move swiftly and comfortably during intense gameplay.

At the heart of the Nike Zoom GT Cut 3 is its advanced cushioning system, which includes Zoom Air units strategically placed for responsive energy return and impact protection. The low-profile design enhances court feel and agility, while the durable rubber outsole offers excellent traction for quick cuts and sudden changes in direction. With its sleek silhouette and eye-catching color scheme, this shoe is sure to turn heads both on and off the court.

Us at StockX believe this product is great for basketball players seeking a high-performance shoe that delivers speed, agility, and style in one package.

shoeName: Nike Air VaporMax Plus Aluminum
description: The Air VaporMax Plus 'Aluminum' features a gradient look on its hybrid performance construction. The shoe's fabric upper appears in a mix of black and Aluminum, with an Aluminum Swoosh standing out on the heel. Solid black TPU overlays support the fit, as do the toe bumper and heel overlay. Underfoot, the tooling includes a shank plate for stability, with a full-length VaporMax unit providing cushioning.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Slate
description: The 2026 edition of the Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble 'Slate' uses rope laces to secure the white mesh upper, which gives way to rippling suede side panels in a gradient design that goes from navy to aqua blue. The Nike Air logo is debossed on the reflective silver heel panel. The white foam midsole is undergirded by a green 'Big Bubble' Max Air heel unit.

shoeName: Nike Air Max TL 2.5 White Neon
Nike Moon Shoe OG Midnight Navy Gum Light Brown Soft Pearl (Women's)
Nike Ja 2 Induction
description:
The Nike Ja 2 Induction is a low-top basketball shoe featuring an upper in Taupe Grey animal print, overlaid with sheer Cobalt Bliss fabric with a scratched lines print. The lace panel and vamp are also Taupe Grey, accented by Ja 2 branding. The midsole in Cobalt Bliss coordinates with the upper, accented by the Swoosh. Midnight Series and 12:AM branding appear on the rear and inner heel.

Nike, the world’s largest athletic shoe producer, has been a significant entity in outfitting NBA players and collaborating with them to create signature shoes since the 1980s. To celebrate Memphis Grizzlies’ point guard Ja Morant’s induction into the Murray State Hall of Fame, Nike made the Ja 2 Induction, which features a color palette and patterns in honor of his achievements.

In our opinion, the shoe's best feature is its dual-patterned upper, which highlights its uncommon colorway. The Nike Ja 2 Induction was released on September 26, 2024, and retailed for $120.

shoeName: Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime
description:
The Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime takes a more contrast driven approach, pairing clear jade with liquid lime to create a bright and modern look. The black elements ground the design, allowing the vibrant tones to stand out without overwhelming the silhouette. The structure remains performance focused, built for movement and support on the court.

This version resonates with players and collectors who appreciate bold but balanced colorways. The combination of greens gives it a fresh and energetic feel, while the darker accents maintain structure. Nike continues to refine the KD line through both design and technology, and this release reflects that balance clearly. It is a standout option that blends performance with visual identity.

The Nike KD 18 Clear Jade Liquid Lime was released on April 18, 2025 with a retail price of $160.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Valentine's Day (2026) (Women's)
description: The 2026 iteration of the Nike Women's Air Max 95 OG 'Valentine's Day' sports a rich burgundy hue on the tongue and mesh panels, along with wavy synthetic leather side panels in multiple shades of pink. A detachable heart-shaped charm bring a romantic pop to the design. The pastel pink foam midsole contains visible Max Air cushioning for a plush feel underfoot.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome
description:
The Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome brings quick-reaction performance to the hardwood with a sleek, minimalist palette that pairs crisp white with polished chrome accents. Built for players who change pace and direction in a heartbeat, this low-top features responsive cushioning anchored by a full-length Zoom Air Strobel for instant energy return, layered over a plush drop-in midsole to keep you fresh deep into the fourth quarter. A contoured heel clip and lateral sidewall help lock in your foot on sharp cuts, while the lightweight textile upper promotes airflow and reduces weight without sacrificing support. The metallic Swoosh and subtle chrome details deliver a clean, modern finish that looks as sharp courtside as it does in motion.

Underfoot, a precision-engineered traction pattern grips the floor for confident stops, starts, and step-backs on any surface. Strategic padding around the collar enhances comfort, and the low-profile design offers excellent court feel so you can read the defense and react faster. Thoughtful touches, like reinforced eyelets for durable lockdown and a smooth internal lining to minimize distractions, round out a shoe made for speed, stability, and all-game control. Whether you’re running the pick-and-roll or spacing the floor, the Nike Air Zoom GT Cut White Chrome blends high-caliber tech with streamlined style to elevate your game and your rotation.

Our team loves this product because it combines explosive cushioning, secure containment, and a versatile white-and-chrome look that transitions seamlessly from intense runs to everyday wear.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Anthracite Iron Grey Violet Ore
description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 'Anthracite Iron Grey Violet Ore' brings a pre-distressed aesthetic, showcased on the greyscale suede upper graced with a series of frayed knit overlays. The customary perforations on the toe box are replaced by purple embroidered details, while a matching ribbon is overlaid on the tongue and heel. The cracked leather back tab is stamped with a Nike Air emblem, while a blue-hued, partially see-through rubber cupsole undergirds the classoc design.

shoeName: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3 FK Ekiden Pack

Taken from the Air Streak Spectrum Plus from 2002, a flame graphic decorates the white Flyknit upper, using engineered zones in the forefoot for an airy feel. shoeName: Nike A'ja Wilson A'One Indigo Girl (Women's)
description: The Nike Women's A'One 'Indigo Girl' uses multiple shades of blue on the mesh upper tooled with synthetic leather accents. A pearlized Swoosh adorns the sides, while A'ja Wilson's logo decorates the tongue. description: The Nike KD 18 'International Blue' takes cues from the OG Foamposite One 'Royal,' a highly-coveted release in Kevin Durant's DMV stomping grounds. Nike Sabrina 2 Oregon (Women's)

The Nike Sabrina 2 Oregon (Women's) arrives in a lively mix of green and yellow, paying tribute to Sabrina Ionescu's strong ties to the University of Oregon.

Our experts love the Nike Sabrina 2 Oregon (Women's) tribute to Sabrina Ionescu's legendary career at the University of Oregon, celebrating her record-breaking triple-doubles and championship mindset. The women's sneaker was introduced for $130 on October 24, 2024.

shoeName: Nike Shox NZ Triple Black
description: The Nike Shox NZ 'Triple Black' rolls out a black leather upper with a matching suede overlay wrapped in a reptilian texture. A jeweled Nike Shox emblem decorates the tongue and heel. shoeName: Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum
description:
The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is one of the most historically significant colorways in the ongoing 2025-26 P-Rod 1 retro program, a premium black suede and gum sole pair that recalls the original 2005 colorway spirit of Paul Rodriguez's debut Nike SB signature shoe, the first and most foundational in a signature line that has since grown to over ten models and established Rodriguez as the athlete with the deepest signature footwear legacy in Nike SB's entire history. Rodriguez famously demanded a signature shoe be written into his Nike SB contract before he would sign, a negotiating position that reflected his leverage as professional skateboarding's most technically complete street skater of the 2000s era and that ultimately launched a series that includes some of the most celebrated skate shoes ever produced. The Black Gum colorway applies a flooded black upper in premium suede to the P-Rod 1's rounded toe box and cupsole construction, the two foundational design decisions that gave the original shoe its silhouette-defining character and which the retro preserves in near-exact form. The PR monogram print on the heel panel appears in the same monochrome black as the upper, the subtle luxury detail that identifies the shoe without announcing itself across the room, while the Gum Light Brown outsole provides the contrasting base note that makes the entire colorway work: the warmth of the gum against the depth of the black creating the specific visual relationship that makes black-and-gum the most reliably satisfying colorway application in skate shoe history. An added plate in the cupsole construction cushions heavy impacts, and Air Zoom technology delivers the snappy, quick-off-the-ground responsiveness that has made the P-Rod 1 feel appropriate for actual skating as well as lifestyle wear across both its original release cycle and its 2025-26 retro. Style code IQ6827-001.

The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is the definitive P-Rod 1 retro colorway for the skater and collector who wants the most foundational and most historically evocative execution of the shoe that launched professional skateboarding's most significant Nike SB signature legacy.

The Nike SB Zoom Air Paul Rodriguez 1 Black Gum is available at a retail price of $125.

shoeName: Nike Blazer Low 77 Jumbo White Black Sail
description: The classic streetwear favorite is reinterpreted with the Nike Blazer Low ‘77 Jumbo ‘White Black.’ An exaggerated Swoosh in black leather is layered by the eyestay and vulcanized off-white rubber midsole. Oversized laces and suede overlays on the heel and toe cap bolster the upper in white leather and herringbone-patterned traction on the outsole provides grip underfoot. Branding appears at the heel and jagged stitching at the heel adds visual emphasis.

shoeName: Nike Dunk Low Next Nature White Gym Red (Women's)
description: Classic details and an eco-friendly build distinguish the Nike women’s Dunk Low Next Nature ‘Gym Red.’ Reminiscent of the 1985 ‘Be True to Your School’ series, the upper features bright red overlays atop a leather upper in white which is composed of at least 20% recycled content by weight. Underfoot, cushion and support are ensured by the red rubbber outsole which is constructed from Nike Grind. The sockliner reveals Nike’s pinwheel logo indicating its commitment to sustainability against a neon Volt background.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 95 OG Big Bubble Black Green Shock
description: The Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Black Green Shock' dons a blackout upper accented with wavy knit, leather and suede side panels. Lush green webbed eyelets match the Air Max tongue patch and the embroidered Swoosh on the collar. shoeName: Nike Vomero Premium Black Volt
description: The Nike Vomero Premium 'Black Anthracite' rocks a black engineered mesh upper, accented with a dark grey Swoosh and an 'Air' wordmark spelled out in large letters. A black ZoomX foam midsole is tooled with a 55mm stack height and green Zoom Air forefoot and heel units for a plush feel.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 3 Volt Concord
description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly NEXT% 3 ‘Fast Pack’ road racing shoes roll out a vibrant neon Atomknit 3.0 upper that includes a stretchy cuff and lofted Flyknit heel pods for a plush feel underfoot. The seamless build includes a tall, stacked ZoomX foam midsole, equipped with a full-length carbon fiber Flyplate and two forefoot Zoom Air units. A Fast Shot outsole provides precise traction mile after mile.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 1 Essential British Tan Light Bone
Nike Lahar Low Black (Women's)
description: Released in January 2021, the Wmns Lahar Low 'Triple Black' features a look inspired by the 1989 Lahar Escape Boot. Built with suede, the shoe's upper appears in black, with rope laces and metal eyelets securing the fit. A heel pull-loop provides easy on and off, while underfoot, the lightly speckled midsole houses Air in the heel for cushioning, giving way to a decoupled outsole with a rugged traction pattern.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low '07 Premium Black White Metallic Dark Grey
description: The Nike Air Force 1 '07 Premium 'Black White Metallic Dark Grey' sports a black tumbled leather upper decorated with a matching Swoosh piped in a white trim. Quilted white knit lines the collar, while round metal studs take the place of the customary perforated details on the toe box. Two molded metal stars decorate the side panel, while the cupsole gets white sidewalls contrasted by a black rubber outsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 Vapor Green
description:
The Vapor Green Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 delivers a modern edge to Nike’s basketball lineup with its dynamic look and precision-focused design. This shoe is a top choice for high-performance athletes and collectors, thanks to its vibrant hues and advanced engineering.

The Vapor Green Air Zoom GT Cut 3 by Nike features a breathable mesh upper with a gradient green finish and a translucent outsole that gives you court grip, while a TPU shank adds midfoot stability. Subtle Nike branding includes a clean white Swoosh contrasting the vivid green and beige base. Nike’s storied basketball heritage shines through, reinforcing the GT Cut 3’s reputation as a leader in sports innovation.

One thing we love about the Vapor Green Nike Air Zoom GT Cut 3 is its integrated heel counter, which provides a secure fit during intense play. We also value the double-stacked Zoom Air units underfoot, giving you unmatched responsiveness. Released on 19th January 2024, this model debuted at a retail price of $190.

shoeName: Nike Air Force 1 Low G-Dragon Peaceminusone Para-Noise
description: The G-Dragon x Air Force 1 '07 'Para-noise' showcases the K-pop star’s unique take on the venerable Nike silhouette. The black coating on the sneaker’s leather upper is designed to wear away with time, revealing a colorful design created by G-Dragon himself. Additional personal touches include an embroidered daisy on the tongue and black brush-stroke effects on the white midsole.

shoeName: Nike Air Max 90 Off-White
description: Part of The Ten collection, the OFF-WHITE x Air Max 90 'The Ten' was part of the first five pairs released. The shoe's white leather upper is complemented by ice blue and grey suede overlays, with the stitched Swoosh sporting reflective detailing.
